Bava Batra 78b:10-79a:3: Gemara hechi dame? i deamar leh: "hi uvenah" – afillu para uvenah name! i dela amar leh "hi uvenah" – afillu chamor name la!

Amar rav pappa: deamar leh: "chamor menika ufara menika ani mocher lach"; bishlama para – ikka lememar lachalavah bae la; ella chamor – may kaamar leh? shema minna – hi uvenah kaamar leh; veammay kare leh "seyach" – shemmehallech achar sicha naa.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "al ken yomru hammoshlim vegomer"?
"Hammoshlim" – ellu hammoshlim beyitzram. "bou cheshbon" – bou unechashshev cheshbono shel olam; hefsed mitzva keneged secharah, usechar avera keneged hefsedah.

"Tibbane vetikkonen" – im atta ose ken, tibbane baolam hazze vetikkonen laolam habba. "ir sichon" – im mesim adam atzmo keayir ze, shemmehallech achar sicha naa – ma ketiv acharav? "ki esh yatza mecheshbon vegomer" – tetze esh mimmechashshevin, vetochal et sheenan mechashshevin.

"Velehava mikkiryat sichon" – mikkiryat tzaddikim shennikreu "sichin". "achla ar moav" – ze hamehallech achar yitzro, keayir ze shemmehallech achar sicha naa. "baale bamot arnon" – ellu gasse haruach, deamar mar: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach, nofel begehinnam.
"Vanniram" – amar rasha: en ram, "avad cheshbon" – avad cheshbono shel olam; "ad divon" – amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hameten ad sheyyavo din, "vannashshim
Ad nofach" – ad shettavo esh sheenah tzericha nippuach, "ad medva" – ad shettadiv nishmatan. veamri la: ad deaved may devae.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol happoresh middivre tora – esh ochalto, shenneemar: "venatatti [et] panay bahem, mehaesh yatzau vehaesh tochlem".

Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yonatan: kol happoresh atzmo middivre tora – nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "adam toe midderech hasekel, bikhal refaim yanuach". veen refaim ella gehinnam – shenneemar: "velo yada ki refaim sham, beimke sheol kerueha.
Berakhot 23a:3-8: Tanu rabbanan: hannitzrach linkavav — al yitpallel, veim hitpallel — tefillato toeva. amar rav zevid veittema rav yehuda: lo shanu ella sheeno yachol lishhot beatzmo, aval im yachol lishhot beatzmo — tefillato tefilla.

Vead kamma? amar rav sheshet: ad parsa. ikka dematne la ammatnita: bamme devarim amurim — kesheen yachol laamod al atzmo. aval im yachol laamod al atzmo — tefillato tefilla. vead kamma? amar rav zevid: ad parsa.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: hannitzrach linkavav — hare ze lo yitpallel, mishshum shenneemar: "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael".

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv: "shemor raglecha kaasher telech el bet haelohim"? shemor atzmecha shello techta, veim techta — have korban lefanay. "vekarov lishmoa divre chachamim", amar rava: heve karov lishmoa divre chachamim, sheim chotim meviim korban veosim teshuva. "mittet hakkesilim zavach" — al tehi kakkesilim shechotim umeviim korban, veen osim teshuva.

"Ki enam yodim laasot ra" i hachi tzaddikim ninhu! ella, al tehi kakkesilim shechotim umeviim korban, veenam yodim im al hattova hem meviim, im al haraa hem meviim. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ben tov lera enan mavchinim, vehem meviim korban lefanay?!
Rav ashe veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa amar: shemor nekavecha beshaa sheatta omed bitfilla lefanay.
Eruvin 17a:16-17b:7: Gemara tanu rabbanan: machane hayyotzet lemilchemet harshut muttarin begezel etzim yeveshim. rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: af chonin bechol makom. uvimkom shennehergu sham nikbarin.
Muttarin begezel etzim yeveshim. hay takkanta dihoshua hava? deamar mar, asara tenaim hitna yehoshua: sheyyehu marin bachorashin, umelakketin etzim missedotehen!
Hatam — behizme vehige, hacha — bishar etzim.
I name: hatam — bimchubbarin, hacha — bitlushin.
I name: hatam — belachin, hacha — biveshim.
Rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: af chonin bechol makom, uvimkom shenneheragim sham nikbarim. peshita, met mitzva hu, umet mitzva kone mekomo!
Deit leh kovrin, detanya: ezehu met mitzva? kol sheen lo kovrin. kore vaacherim onin oto — en ze met mitzva.
Umet mitzva kana mekomo? vehatanya: hammotze met mutal bisratya — mefannehu limin isratya o lismol isratya.
Sede vur usede nir — mefannehu lisde vur. sede nir usede zera — mefannehu lisde nir. hayu shetehen nirot, shetehen zeruot, shetehen burot — mefannehu lechol ruach sheyyirtze!
Amar rav bivi: hacha bemet muttal al hammetzar askinan. mittoch shennittena reshut lefannoto min hammetzar — mefannehu lechol ruach sheyyirtze.
Ufeturin merchitzat yadayim. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella mayim rishonim, aval mayim acharonim chova.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe: mippene ma amru mayim acharonim chova? mippene shemmelach sedomit yesh, shemmesamme et haenayim.
Amar abbaye: umishtachcha kekureta bechora. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: kayel milcha, may? amar leh: [ha] la mibbaya.

Ketubot 86a:6-86b:1: Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav chama: hay man deikka aleh ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov, veit leh ara veit leh zuze — levaal chov mesallekinan leh bezuze, leishsha mesallekinan la beara, hay ki dineh vehay ki dineh.
Vei la ikka ella chad ara vela chazya ella lechad — levaal chov yahavinan leh, leishsha la yahavinan la. may tama — yoter mimma shehaish rotze lissa, ishsha rotza lehinnase.

Amar leh rav pappa lerav chama: vadday deamritu mishshemeh derava, hay man demasseki beh zuze, veit leh ara, vaata baal chov veka tava minneh, veamar leh: "zil shekol meara", amrinan leh: "zil zabben at, veayyti hav leh"? amar leh: la.
Ema li gufa deovada hechi hava. amar leh: tole meotav begoy hava, hu asa shello kahogen — lefichach asu bo shello kahogen.

Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappa: ledidach deamrat periat baal chov mitzva, amar: "la nicha li deebed mitzva", may? amar leh, tenena: bamme devarim amurim — bemitzvat lo taase, aval bemitzvat ase, kegon sheomrin lo ase sukka veeno ose, lulav veeno ose —
Menachot 99b:15-100a:2: Gemara tanya: rabbi yose omer, afillu sillek et hayyeshana shacharit vesidder et hachadasha arvit – en bechach kelum, ella ma ani mekayyem "lefanay tamid"? shello yalin shulchan belo lechem.
Amar rabbi amme: middevarav shel rabbi yose nilmod, afillu lo shana adam ella perek echad shacharit uferek echad arvit – kiyyem mitzvat "lo yamush (et) sefer hattora hazze mippicha".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: afillu lo kara adam ella keriyyat shema shacharit vearvit – kiyyem "lo yamush", vedavar ze asur leomro bifne amme haaretz, verava amar: mitzva leomro bifne amme haaretz.

Shaal ben dama, ben achoto shel rabbi yishmael, et rabbi yishmael: kegon ani, shellamadti kol hattora kullah, mahu lilmod chochmat yevanit? kara alav hammikra hazze: "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha vehagita bo yomam valayla". tze uvedok shaa sheenah lo min hayyom velo min hallayla, ulemod bah chochmat yevanit.

Ufeliga derabbi shemuel bar nachmani, deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: pasuk ze eno lo chova velo mitzva, ella beracha. raa hakkadosh baruch hu et yehoshua sheddivre tora chavivim alav beyoter, shenneemar: "umesharto yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel". amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: yehoshua, kol kach chavivin alecha divre tora? "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha".
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: divre tora lo yehu alecha chova, vei atta rashshay liftor atzmecha mehen.

Amar chizkiyya: may dichtiv "veaf hasitcha mippi tzar rachav lo mutzak tachteha"? bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam adam mesit et chavero middarche chayyim ledarche mita, vehakkadosh baruch hu mesit et haadam middarche mita ledarche chayyim, shenneemar "veaf hasitcha mippi tzar" miggehinnam, sheppiha tzar, sheashanah tzavur
Betochah. veshemma tomar keshem sheppiha tzar kach kullah tzara – talmud lomar "heemik hirchiv".

Veshemma tomar lammelech lo huchena – talmud lomar "gam hi lammelech huchan", veshemma tomar en bah etzim – talmud lomar "meduratah esh veetzim harebe", veshemma tomar ze hu secharah – talmud lomar "venachat shulchancha male dashen".
Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:11-4:2:
Hammafkid maot etzel shulchani, im tzerurin, lo yishtammesh bahem, lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beacharayutan, muttarin, yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu chayyav beacharayutan. etzel baal habbayit, ben tzerurin uven muttarim lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beacharayutan. chenvani kevaal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, chenvani kashshulchani: 
Hashsholeach yad befikkadon, bet shammay omrim, yilke vechaser uveyater. uvet hillel omrim, kishat hotzaa. rabbi akiva omer, kishat hattevia. hachoshev lishloach yad befikkadon, bet shammay omrim, chayyav. uvet hillel omrim, eno chayyav ad sheyyishlach bo yad, shenneemar (Shemot 22) im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu. ketzad. hitta et hechavit venatal hemenna reviit, venishbera, eno meshallem ella reviit. higbihah venatal hemenna reviit, venishbera, meshallem deme chullah: 
Hazzahav kone et hakkesef, vehakkesef eno kone et hazzahav. hannechoshet kona et hakkesef, vehakkesef eno kone et hannechoshet. maot haraot konot et hayyafot, vehayyafot enan konot et haraot. asimon kone et hammatbea, vehammatbea eno kone et asimon. mittaltelin konim et hammatbea, vehammatbea eno kone et hammittaltelin. ze hakkelal, kol hammittaltelin konin ze et ze: 
Ketzad. mashach hemennu ferot velo natan lo maot, eno yachol lachazor bo. natan lo maot velo mashach hemennu ferot, yachol lachazor bo. aval amru, mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umiddor happallaga, hu atid lehippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo. rabbi shimon omer, kol shehakkesef beyado, yado al haelyona:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:7-10:
Hammafkid perot etzel chavero, hare ze yotzi lo chesronot. lechittin uleorez, tisha chatzae kabbin lechor, lisorin uledochan, tisha kabbin lechor, lechusmin ulezera pishtan, shalosh sein lechor. hakkol lefi hammidda, hakkol lefi hazzeman. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, vechi ma ichpat lahen laachbarin, vahalo ochlot ben meharebe uven mikkima. ella eno motzi lo chesronot ella lechor echad bilvad. rabbi yehuda omer, im hayta midda merubba, eno motzi lo chesronot, mippene shemmotirot: 
Yotzi lo shetut leyayin. rabbi yehuda omer, chomesh. yotzi lo sheloshet luggin shemen lemea, log umechetza shemarim, log umechetza bala. im haya shemen mezukkak, eno motzi lo shemarim. im hayu kankannim yeshanim, eno motzi lo bala. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammocher shemen mezukkak lachavero kol yemot hashshana, hare ze mekabbel alav log umechetza shemarim lemea: 
Hammafkid chavit etzel chavero, velo yichadu lah habbealim makom, vetiltelah venishbera, im mittoch yado nishbera, letzarko, chayyav, letzarkah, patur. im mishshehinnichah nishbera, ben letzarko ben letzarkah, patur. yichadu lah habbealim makom, vetiltelah venishbera, ben mittoch yado uven mishshehinnichah, letzarko, chayyav, letzarkah, patur: 
Hammafkid maot etzel chavero, tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav, o shemmesaran livno ulevitto hakketannim, venaal bifnehem shello charauy, chayyav, shello shamar kederech hashshomrim. veim shamar kederech hashshomrim, patur:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:12-5:3:
Hattaggar notel mechamesh geranot venoten letoch megura achat. mechamesh gittot, venoten letoch pittam echad. uvilvad shello yehe mitkavven learev. rabbi yehuda omer, lo yechallek hachenvani kelayot veegozin lattinokot, mippene shehu margilan lavo etzlo. vachachamim mattirin. velo yifchot et hashshaar. vachachamim omrim, zachur latov. lo yavor et haggerisin, divre abba shaul. vachachamim mattirin. umodim shello yavor meal pi megura, sheeno ella chegonev et haayin. en mefarkesin lo et haadam velo et habbehema velo et hakkelim: 
Ezehu neshech veezehu tarbit. ezehu neshech. hammalve sela bachamishsha dinarin, satayim chittin beshalosh, mippene shehu noshech. veezehu tarbit, hammarbe beferot. ketzad. lakach hemennu chittin bedinar zahav hakkor, vechen hashshaar, amdu chittin bishloshim dinarin, amar lo ten li chittay, sheani rotze lemachran velikkach bahen yayin. amar lo hare chittecha asuyot alay bishloshim, vahare lecha etzli bahen yayin, veyayin en lo: 
Hammalve et chavero, lo yadur bachatzero chinnam, velo yiskor mimmennu befachot, mippene shehu ribbit. marbin al hassachar, veen marbin al hammecher. ketzad. hiskir lo et chatzero, veamar lo, im meachshav atta noten li, hare hu lecha beeser selaim leshana, veim shel chodesh bechodesh, besela lechodesh, muttar. machar lo et sadehu, veamar lo, im meachshav atta noten li, hare hi shellecha beelef zuz, im laggoren, bishnem asar mane, asur: 
Machar lo et hassade, venatan lo miktzat damim, veamar lo ematay shettirtze have maot vetol et shellecha, asur. hilvahu al sadehu, veamar lo, im i atta noten li mikkan vead shalosh shanim hare hi shelli, hare hi shello. vechach haya baytos ben zonin ose al pi chachamim:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:3-7:
Haonaa, arbaa chesef meesrim vearbaa chesef lassela, shetut lammikkach. ad matay muttar lehachazir. ad kede sheyyare letaggar o likrovo. hora rabbi tarfon belod, haonaa shemona chesef lassela, shelish lammikkach, vesamchu taggare lod. amar lahem, kol hayyom muttar lehachazir. amru lo, yanniach lanu rabbi tarfon bimkomenu, vechazru ledivre chachamim: 
Echad hallokeach veechad hammocher, yesh lahen onaa. keshem sheonaa lehedyot, kach onaa letaggar. rabbi yehuda omer, en onaa letaggar. mi shehuttal alav, yado al haelyona, ratza, omer ten li meotay, o ten li ma sheonitani: 
Kamma tehe hassela chasera velo yehe vah onaa. rabbi meir omer, arbaa issarin, issar ledinar. rabbi yehuda omer, arbaa fundeyonot, pundeyon ledinar. rabbi shimon omer, shemona fundeyonot, shene fundeyonot ledinar: 
Ad matay muttar lehachazir, bakkerakkim, ad kede sheyyare leshulchani, uvakkefarim, ad arve shabbatot. im haya makkirah, afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh mekabbelah hemennu, veen lo alav ella taromet. venotnah lemaaser sheni veeno choshesh, sheeno ella nefesh raa: 
Haonaa arbaa chesef, vehattaana shete chesef, vehahodaa shave feruta. chamesh perutot hen. hahodaa shave feruta, vehaishsha mitkaddeshet beshave feruta, vehannehene veshave feruta min hahekdesh maal, vehammotze shave feruta chayyav lehacheriz, vehaggozel et chavero shave feruta venishba lo, yolichennu acharav afillu lemaday:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:8-11:
Chamishsha chumshin hen. haochel teruma, uterumat maaser, uterumat maaser shel demay, vehachalla, vehabbikkurim mosif chomesh. vehappode neta revai umaaser sheni shello, mosif chomesh. happode et hekdesho, mosif chomesh. hannehene veshave feruta min hahekdesh, mosif chomesh. vehaggozel et chavero shave feruta venishba lo, mosif chomesh: 
Ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa. haavadim, vehashshetarot, vehakkarkaot, vehahekdeshot. en lahen lo tashlume chefel velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, shomer chinnam eno nishba, venose sachar eno meshallem. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim shehu chayyav beacharayutan, yesh lahen onaa, vesheeno chayyav beacharayutan, en lahen onaa. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammocher sefer tora, behema umargalit, en lahem onaa. amru lo, lo amru ella et ellu: 
Keshem sheonaa vemikkach umimkar, kach onaa vidvarim. lo yomar lo bechamma chefetz ze, vehu eno rotze likkach. im haya vaal teshuva, lo yomar lo zechor maasecha harishonim. im hu ven gerim, lo yomar lo zechor maase avotecha, shenneemar (Shemot 22) veger lo tone velo tilchatzennu: 
En mearvin perot beferot, afillu chadashim bachadashim, veen tzarich lomar chadashim bishanim. beemet, beyayin hittiru learev kashe verach, mippene shehu mashbicho. en mearvin shimre yayin beyayin, aval noten lo et shemarav. mi shennitarev mayim beyeno, lo yimkerennu vachanut ella im ken hodio, velo letaggar af al pi shehodio, sheeno ella lerammot bo. mekom shennahagu lehattil mayim bayyayin, yattilu:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:4-8:
En moshivin chenvani lemachatzit sachar, velo yitten maot likkach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar, ella im ken noten lo secharo kefoel. en moshivin tarnegolin lemechetza, veen shamin agalin useyachin lemechetza, ella im ken noten lo sechar amalo umezono. aval mekabbelin agalin useyachin lemechetza, umegaddelin otan ad sheyyehu meshullashin. vachamor, ad shettehe toanet: 
Shamin para vachamor vechol davar shehu ose veochel lemechetza. mekom shennahagu lachalok et havveladot miyyad, cholkin, mekom shennahagu legaddel, yegaddelu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shamin egel im immo useyach im immo. umafriz al sadehu, veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit: 
En mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael, mippene shehu ribbit. aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min hannachrim, velovin mehen umalvin otan beribbit, vechen beger toshav. malve yisrael meotav shel nachri middaat hannachri, aval lo middaat yisrael: 
En poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar. (yatza hashshaar, poskin, veaf al pi sheen laze yesh laze). haya hu techilla lakkotzrim, posek immo al haggadish, veal heavit shel anavim, veal hammaatan shel zetim, veal habbetzim shel yotzer, veal hassid mishsheshshikkeo vakkivshan. ufosek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana. rabbi yose omer, en poskin al hazzevel ella im ken hayta lo zevel baashpa. vachachamim mattirin. ufosek immo cheshaar haggavoah. rabbi yehuda omer, af al pi shello fasak immo cheshaar haggavoah, yachol lomar ten li chaze, o ten li meotay: 
Malve adam et arisav chittim bechittin lezera, aval lo leechol. shehaya rabban gamliel malve et arisav chittin bechittin lezera, beyoker vehuzelu, o vezol vehukeru, notel mehen keshaar hazzol, velo mippene shehalacha chen, ella sheratza lehachemir al atzmo:
Mishnah Bikkurim 1:10-2:2:
Veellu meviin vekorin, min haatzeret vead hechag, mishshivat hamminim, mipperot shebbeharim, mittemarot shebbaamakim, umizzete shemen, meever hayyarden. rabbi yose haggelili omer, en meviin bikkurim meever hayyarden, sheenah eretz zavat chalav udevash: 
Hakkone shelosha ilanot betoch shel chavero, mevi vekore. rabbi meir omer, afillu shenayim. kana ilan vekarkao, mevi vekore. rabbi yehuda omer, af baale arisut vechachorot, meviin vekorin: 
Hatteruma vehabbikkurim, chayyavim alehen mita vechomesh, vaasurim lezarim, vehem nichse chohen, veolin beechad umea, uteunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh. hare ellu vitruma uvikkurim, ma sheen ken bammaaser: 
Yesh bemaaser uvikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma, shehammaaser vehabbikkurim teunim havaat makom, uteunim vidduy, vaasurin laonen. rabbi shimon mattir. vechayyavin babbiur. verabbi shimon poter. vaasurin kol shehen milleechol birushalayim. vegiddulehen asurim milleechol birushalayim af lezarim velabbehema. rabbi shimon mattir. hare ellu bammaaser uvabbikkurim, ma sheen ken batteruma:
Mishnah Bikkurim 1:6-9:
Hakkone shete ilanot betoch shel chavero, mevi veeno kore. rabbi meir omer, mevi vekore. yavash hammayan, niktzatz hailan, mevi veeno kore. rabbi yehuda omer, mevi vekore. meatzeret vead hechag, mevi vekore. min hechag vead chanukka, mevi veeno kore. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, mevi vekore: 
Hifrish bikkurav umachar sadehu, mevi veeno kore. vehashsheni, meoto hammin eno mevi, mimmin acher, mevi vekore. rabbi yehuda omer, af meoto hammin mevi vekore: 
Hifrish bikkurav, nivzezu, namakku, nignevu, avdu, o shennitmeu, mevi acherim tachtehem veeno kore. vehashsheniyyim enam chayyavim alehem chomesh. nitmeu vaazara, nofetz veeno kore: 
Uminnayin shehu chayyav beacharayutan ad sheyyavi lehar habbayit, shenneemar (Shemot 23) reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha, melammed shechayyav beacharayutam ad sheyyavi lehar habbayit. hare shehevi mimmin echad vekara, vechazar vehevi mimmin acher, eno kore:
Mishnah Bikkurim 2:3-6:
Yesh batteruma vevammaaser ma sheen ken babbikkurim, shehatteruma vehammaaser osrin et haggoren, veyesh lahem shiur, venohagim bechol happerot, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, uvaarisin uvechachorot uvassikkarikon uvaggazlan. hare ellu vatteruma uvammaaser, ma sheen ken babbikkurim: 
Veyesh babbikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma uvammaaser, shehabbikkurim niknin bimchubbar lakkarka, veose adam kol sadehu bikkurim, vechayyav beacharayutam, uteunim karban veshir utenufa velina: 
Terumat maaser shava labbikkurim bishte derachim, velatteruma bishte derachim. nittelet min hattahor al hattame, veshello min hammukkaf, kabbikkurim. veoseret et haggoren, veyesh lah shiur, katteruma: 
Etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim, velayyarak bederech echad. shave lailan, baarla uvarvai uvashsheviit. velayyarak bederech echad, shebbishat lekitato issuro, divre rabban gamliel. rabbi eliezer omer, shave lailan bechol davar:
Mishnah Bikkurim 2:7-11:
Dam mehalleche shetayim, shave ledam behema, lehacheshir et hazzeraim. vedam hashsheretz, en chayyavin alav: 
Koy, yesh bo derachim shave lachayya, veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema, veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema velachayya, veyesh bo derachim sheeno shave lo labbehema velo lachayya: 
Ketzad shave lachayya, damo taun kissuy kedam chayya, veen shochatin oto beyom tov, veim shechato, en mechassin et damo, vechelbo metamme vetumat nevela kachayya, vetumato vesafek, veen podin bo peter chamor: 
Ketzad shave labbehema, chelbo asur kechelev behema, veen chayyavin alav karet, veeno nilkach bechesef maaser leechol birushalayim, vechayyav bizroa ulechayayim vekeva. rabbi eliezer poter, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Ketzad eno shave lo lachayya velo labbehema, asur mishshum kilayim im hachayya veim habbehema, hakkotev chayyato uvehemto livno, lo chatav lo et hakkoy, im amar hareni nazir shezze chayya o vehema, hare hu nazir. ushear kol derachav, shavim lachayya velabbehema, vetaun shechita kaze vechaze, umetamme mishshum nevela umishshum ever min hachay kaze vechaze:
Mishnah Bikkurim 3:1-4:
Ketzad mafrishin habbikkurim. yored adam betoch sadehu veroe teena shebbikkera, eshkol shebbikker, rimmon shebbikker, koshro vegemi, veomer, hare ellu bikkurim. rabbi shimon omer, af al pi chen chozer vekore otam bikkurim meachar sheyyittalshu min hakkarka: 
Ketzad maalin et habbikkurim. kol haayarot shebbammaamad mitkannesot lair shel maamad, velanin birchovah shel ir, velo hayu nichnasin labbattim. velammashkim, haya hamemunne omer (yirmeya lo), kumu venaale tziyyon el bet Adonai elohenu: 
Hakkerovim meviim hatteenim vehaanavim, veharchokim meviim gerogarot vetzimmukim. vehashshor holech lifnehem, vekarnav metzuppot zahav, vaateret shel zayit berosho. hechalil makke lifnehem, ad shemmaggiim karov lirushalayim. higgiu karov lirushalayim, shalchu lifnehem, veitteru et bikkurehem. happachot, hasseganim vehaggizbarim yotzim likratam. lefi chevod hannichnasim hayu yotzim. vechol baale ummaniyyot shebbirushalayim omdim lifnehem veshoalin bishlomam, achenu anshe hammakom peloni, batem leshalom: 
Hechalil makke lifnehem ad shemmaggiin lehar habbayit. higgiu lehar habbayit, afillu agrippas hammelech notel hassal al ketefo venichnas, ad shemmaggia laazara. higgia laazara vedibberu haleviyyim bashshir, aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani velo simmachta oyvay li (tehillim 30):
Mishnah Bikkurim 3:5-8:
Haggozalot sheal gabbe hassallim, hayu olot. uma shebbeyadam, notnim lakkohanim: 
Odehu hassal al ketefo, kore mehiggadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha (Devarim 26), ad sheggomer kol happarasha. rabbi yehuda omer ad arammi oved avi. higgia laarammi oved avi, morid hassal meal ketefo veochazo vesiftotav, vechohen manniach yado tachtav umenifo, vekore mearammi oved avi ad shehu gomer kol happarasha, umannicho betzad hammizbeach, vehishtachava veyatza: 
Barishona, kol mi sheyyodea likrot, kore. vechol mi sheeno yodea likrot, makrin oto. nimneu millehavi, hitkinu sheyyehu makrin et mi sheyyodea veet mi sheeno yodea: 
Haashirim meviim bikkurehem biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav, vehaaniyyim meviin otam besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa, vehassallim vehabbikkurim nittanin lakkohanim:
Mishnah Kelim 27:12-28:3:
Shelosha al shelosha shennikra, im netano al hakkisse uvesaro nogea bakkisse, tahor, veim lav, tame. shalosh al shalosh shennimha mimmenna chut echad, o shennimtza vo kesher, o shene chutin matimin, tehora. shalosh al shalosh shehishlichah baashpot, tehora. hechezirah, temea. leolam hashelachatah metaharatta, vachazaratah metammetah, chutz mishshel argaman veshel zehorit tova. rabbi eliezer omer, af matlit chadasha kayyotze vahen. rabbi shimon omer, kullan tehorin, lo huzkeru ella mippene hashavat aveda: 
Shalosh al shalosh shennetanah bechaddur, o sheasaah kaddur bifne atzmah, tehora. aval shelosha al shelosha shennetano vechaddur, tame. asao chaddur bifne atzmo, tahor, mippene shehattefer memaato: 
Pachot mishshelosha al shelosha shehitkino lafok bo et hammerchatz, lenaer bo et hakkedera, lekanneach bo et harechayim, ben muchan ben sheeno muchan, tame, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, ben min hammuchan, ben sheeno min hammuchan, tahor. rabbi akiva omer, min hammuchan, tame. sheeno min hammuchan, tahor: 
Haose ispelanit, ben beveged ben beor, tehora. rabbi yose omer, al haor, tahor. melugema, beveged, tehora, uveor, temea. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af beveged, temea, mippene shehi ninaret:
Mishnah Kelim 27:7-11:
Habbeged shearag bo shelosha al shelosha, venitma midras, vehishlim alav et kol habbeged, veachar kach natal chut echad mittechillato, tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. natal chut echad mittechillato, veachar kach hishlim alav et kol habbeged, tame magga midras: 
Vechen beged shearag bo shalosh al shalosh, venitma teme met, vehishlim alav et kol habbeged, veachar kach natal chut echad mittechillato, tahor mitteme met, aval tame magga teme met. natal chut echad mittechillato, veachar kach hishlim alav et kol habbeged, tahor, mippene sheamru, shalosh al shalosh shennitmaet, tahor. aval shelosha al shelosha shennitmaet, af al pi shettahor mimmidras, tame vechol hattumot: 
Sadin shehu tame midras, vaasao vilon, tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. amar rabbi yose, vechi veeze midras naga ze. ella im ken naga bo hazzav, tame vemagga hazzav: 
Shelosha al shelosha shennechelak, tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. amar rabbi yose, vechi veeze midras naga ze. ella im ken naga bo hazzav, tame magga hazzav: 
Shelosha al shelosha, baashpot, bari vetzorer melach. babbayit, o vari o tzorer melach. kamma melach yehe tzorer, rova. rabbi yehuda omer, bedakka. vachachamim omrim, begassa. ellu vaellu mitkavvenim lehakel. rabbi shimon omer, shavim shelosha al shelosha vaashpot leshalosh al shalosh babbayit:
Mishnah Kelim 28:4-7:
Mitpechot sefarim, ben metzuyyarot ben sheenan metzuyyarot, temeot, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, metzuyyarot, tehorot, vesheenam metzuyyarot, temeot. rabban gamliel omer, ellu vaellu tehorot: 
Kippa shehu tame midras, unetano al hassefer, tahor min hammidras, aval tame teme met. chemet sheasaah shatiach, veshatiach sheasao chemet, tahor. chemet sheasaah turemel veturemel sheasao chemet, kar sheasao sadin vesadin sheasao kar, keset sheasaah mitpachat umitpachat sheasaah keset, tame. ze hakkelal, kol sheshshinnahu lishmo, tame. leshem acher, tahor: 
Matlit shettelayah al hakkuppa, metammea echad ufoselet echad. hifrishah min hakkuppa, hakkuppa metamma echad ufoselet echad, vehammatlit tehora. telayah al habbeged, metamma shenayim ufoselet echad. hifrishah min habbeged, habbeged metamme echad ufosel echad, vehammatlit metammea shenayim ufoselet echad. vechen hattole al hassak o al haor, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. rabbi yose omer, al haor, tahor. al hassak, tame, mippene shehu arig: 
Shalosh al shalosh sheamru, chutz min hammelal, divre rabbi shimon. vachachamim omrim, shalosh al shalosh mechuvvanet. telayah al habbeged, meruach achat, eno chibbur. mishshete ruchot zo cheneged zo, chibbur. asao chemin gam, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi yehuda, bamme devarim amurim, betallit. aval bechaluk, milmalan, chibbur. umillemattan, eno chibbur:
Mishnah Kelim 28:8-29:1:
Bigde aniyyim, af al pi sheen bahem shalosh al shalosh, hare ellu temein midras. tallit shehitchil bah lekarah, kevan shennikra rubbah, eno chibbur. heavim veharakkim, en bahem mishshum shalosh al shalosh: 
Keset hassabbalin, temea midras. meshammeret shel yayin, en bah mishshum moshav. sevacha shel zekena, temea mishshum moshav. chaluk shel yotzet hachutz heasuy kisvacha, tahor. haose veged min hacherem, tahor. umizzuto, tame. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, af haose veged min hacherem uchefalo, tame: 
Sevacha shehitchil bah mippiha, tehora, ad sheyyigmor et kurekuretah. hitchil bah mikkurekuretah, tehora, ad sheyyigmor et piha. shavis shellah, tame vifne atzmo. hachutin shellah, temein mishshum chibbur. sevacha shennikrea, im enah mekabbelet et rov hassear, tehora: 
Nome hassadin vehassudarin vehattartin vehappilyon shel rosh, shesh etzbaot. shel afkarsin, eser. nime sagos, vehardid, vehechaluk, vehattallit, shalosh etzbaot. nime chippa shel zekena, vehaggumedin shel arviyyin, vehakkulkin, vehappunda, vehammaaforet, vehappargod, nimehen kol shehen:
Mishnah Kelim 29:2-6:
Shalosh kesatot shel tzemer, shesh shel pishtan, shelosha sedinin, shetem esre mitpachot, shene suverikin, chaluk echad, tallit echad, keluvkarin echad, chibbur lattuma velahazzaya. yater mikkan, chibbur lattuma, veen chibbur lahazzaya. rabbi yose omer, af lo lattuma: 
Chut hammishkolet, shenem asar. shel charashin, shemona asar. shel bannayin, chamishshim amma. yater mikkan, im ratza lekayyem, tahor. shel sayyadin veshel tzayyarin, kol shehen: 
Chut moznayim shel zehavim veshel shokle argaman tov, shalosh etzbaot. yad hakkurdom meacharav, shalosh etzbaot. rabbi yose omer, tefach, tahor: 
Chut moznayim shel chenvanim, shel baale vattim tefach. yad hakkurdom millefanav, tefach. sheyare yad happargol, tefach. yad makkevet shel yad shel mefatteche avanim, tafach: 
Chut moznayim shel tzammarim, veshel shokle zechuchit, tefachayim. yad hammakkor, tefachayim. yad hammaatzad shel ligyonot, tefachayim. yad hakkurnas shel zehavim, tefachayim. veshel charashin, shelosha tefachim:
Mishnah Kelim 29:7-30:2:
Sheyare haddarvan milmalan, arbaa. yad habbadid, arbaa. yad hakkurdom shel nikkush, chamishsha. yad ben happattish, chamishsha. veshel happattish, shishsha. yad hakkurdom shel bikkua veshel adir, shishsha. veyad makkevet shel sattatin, shishsha: 
Sheyare charchur millemattan, shiva. yad magrefa shel baale vattim, bet shammay omrim, shiva. bet hillel omrim, shemona. shel sayyadin, bet shammay omrim, tisha. bet hillel omrim, asara. yater mikkan, im ratza lekayyem, tame. veyad meshammeshe haur, kol shehu: 
Kele zechuchit, peshutehen tehorin, umekabbelehen temeim. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehen kelim, mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. hattavla vehaiskutela shel zechuchit, tehorin. im yesh lahen lizbez, temeim. shule keara veshule iskutela shel zechuchit shehitkinan letashmish, tehorin. kirtesan o shafan beshufin, temein: 
Aspaklarya, tehora. vetamchuy sheasao aspaklarya, tame. veim mittechilla asao leshem aspaklarya, tahor. tarvad shehu notno al hashshulchan, im mekabbel kol shehu, tame. veim lav, rabbi akiva metamme, rabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:23-25: Yisrael sheasa melacha beshabbat im avar veasa bezadon asur lo lehanot beotah melacha leolam. ushear yisrael muttar lahem lehanot bah lemotzae shabbat miyyad shenneemar <small>(Shemot lo 14)</small> "ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi", hi kodesh veen maaseha kodesh. ketzad. yisrael shebbishshel beshabbat bemezid. lemotzae shabbat yeachel laacherim aval lo lo yeachel olamit. veim bishshel bishgaga lemotzae shabbat yochal ben hu ben acherim miyyad. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum vechazru. beshogeg yeachlu beshabbat shehare lo naasa begufan maase velo nishtannu. bemezid lo yeachlu ad motzae shabbat:

Hassocher et happoel lishmor lo et happara veet hattinok lo yitten lo secharo shel shabbat. lefichach en acharayut shabbat alav. veim haya hassachir sechir shabbat o sechir shana noten lo secharo mashlam. lefichach acharayut shabbat alav. velo yomar lo ten li sechari shel shabbat ella omer lo ten li sechari shel shana o shel asara yamim:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 1:1: Kol karbenot hatztzibbur zecharim. vechen chattaot shel tzibbur min haez o min habbakar. veen bahen min hakkevasim. vechol olot hatztzibbur min hakkevasim umin habbakar. veen lahen ola min haez. kol chattat yachid nekeva veteachel lakkohanim veenah baa min habbakar. chutz mishshalosh chattaot. chattat nasi shehi ez veneechelet. vechattat kohen mashiach shehu par venisrefet vehu par habba al kol hammitzvot. vehashshelishi par shemmevi kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim vehu chattat venisraf:

Kol chattaot shel tzibbur neechalot chutz missair shel yom hakkippurim shechavero mishtalleach. vechen seire avoda zara ufar helem nisrafin. ufar habba al kol hammitzvot ufar helem nikraim parim hannisrafin. useire avoda zara nikraim seirim hannisrafin. ha lamadta shechamesh chattaot hem hannisrafot. shetayim layyachid veshalosh latztzibbur:

Kol hakkarbanot haellu nikraim zevachim. vechol haolot vehachattaot vehaashamot ushene kavse shelamim shel atzeret nikraim kadshe kadashim. aval shelamim shel yachid vehabbechor vehammaaser vehappesach nikraim kadashim kallim:

Haevarim shessorfin otan al gabbe hammizbeach min hachattaot hanneechalot umin haashamot umin hashshelamim hen hannikrain emurin. veellu hen haemurin shel shor o shel ez. hachelev asher al hakkerev uvichlalo chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva ushete hakkelayot vechelev shealehen im hachelev asher al hakkesalim veyoteret hakkaved venotel min hakkaved meat im hayyoteret. veim haya hakkarban mimmin hakkevasim mosif al ellu haalya temima im hachulyot min hashshidra ad mekom hakkelayot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 9)</small> "leemmat heatze yesirenna". vechol haemurin nisrafin al mizbeach hachitzon:
Hayta habbehema meubberet af al pi shekkalu chodashav shel ubbar vaafillu nimtza chay eno maale chelbo im chelev immo ella chelev immo bilvad. vahare haubbar keechad meevareha:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 2:1:
Hayyayin vehassolet shemmeviin im hakkarban hem hannikrain nesachim. vehassolet levaddah nikret minchat nesachim. uminchat nesachim enah teuna lo tenufa velo haggasha velo levona. aval teuna melach. vechullah nisrefet al mizbeach hachitzon. veyitnassech hayyayin al hammizbeach. veen notnin oto al haesh ella magbiah yado veyotzek al hayesod vehu yored lashshitin:
En taun nesachin ella olat behema ushelamim bilvad ben hayu karban tzibbur o karban yachid o keves yoledet veelo shel kohen gadol hoil vehen olot teunim nesachim. aval haof vehaashamot vehachattaot en meviin immahem nesachim. chutz mechattat metzora vaashamo shennitparshu niskehem battora:
Uminnayin sheen meviin nesachim im hachattat vehaasham shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 3)</small> "lefalle neder o nedava" davar habba beneder unedava yatzu chattat veasham uvechor umaaser ufesach hoil veenan bain beneder unedava en teunin nesachim. uminnayin lehavi shalme chagiga veolat reiyya linsachim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 3)</small> "o bemoadechem":
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 2:4:
Kamma hu shiur nesachim. niske keves o kavsa issaron solet balul birviit hahin shemen veyayin lannesech reviit hahin. vechen niske haez ben katan ben gadol ben zachar ben nekeva o niske rachel af al pi shehi gedola. aval niske ayil hen shene esronim solet balul bishlishit hahin shemen veyayin lannesech shelishit hahin. veniske happar o haegel ben zecharim ben nekevot shelosha esronim solet balul bachatzi hahin shemen veyayin lannesech chatzi hahin:
Ellu hen hannesachim ben laola ben lashshelamim kashshiur hazze lechol echad veechad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 12)</small> "kammispar asher taasu kacha taasu laechad kemisparam". en mosifin al hashshiurin haellu veen gorin mehen. veim gara o hosif kol shehu pasul. chutz mikkeves haola shemmakrivin beyom hanafat haomer shehannesachim shello shene esronim balul bishlishit hahin shemen. af al pi shennichpela salto lo nichpelu yeno [veshamno] ella yayin lannesech reviit hahin:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 2:6:
Hametzora mevi im shelosha kevasim shello shehen chattat veasham veola shelosha esronim. umippi hashshemua lamdu shehen bain bichlal hazzevachim shello issaron im kol keves balul birviit hahin shemen. ureviit yayin im kol issaron mishshelashtan kishar niske hakkevasim. vehammakriv et happilgas mevi immo niske ayil velo ole lo zivcho:
Hahin hu shenem asar log. uchevar hodanu shiur hallog im middot acherot behilchot eruvin. vehaissaron hu haomer shehu shiur challa uchevar bearnu shiuro beinyan challa:
Keshemmoddin hannesachim o hammenachot ben minchat yachid ben minchat tzibbur en moddin oto bemidda shel shelosha esronim lappar o shel shenayim laayil ella moded hakkol beissaron echad shehaya bammikdash. vechen hashshemen shel nesachim moddin oto bemiddato shebbammikdash. veshemen shel minchot hayyachid belog shebbammikdash. keminyan haesronot kach minyan hallogin:
Niddah 20a:10-13: Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vechullam, en bodkin ella al gabbe matlet levana. amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi: veshachor al gabbe adom.

Zohar, Shmini 1: (Vayikra 9:1) vayhi bayom hashshemini vegomer. ribbi yitzchak patach, (iyyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kol bene elohim. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahiv lon orayyta kaddisha, chedvavta decholla, chedvavta dekudesha berich hu, veatyayluta dileh, dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye shaashuim yom yom. veorayyta kolla, chad shema kaddisha ihi dekudesha berich hu. uveorayyta itbere alma dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon al tikre amon ella uman.

Uveorayyta itbere bar nash, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:26) vayyomer elohim naase adam. amar kudesha berich hu leorayyta, baena lemivre adam. amra kammeh, hay bar nash zammin lemechete uleargeza kammach, i la taarich rugezach aleh, hech yekum bealma. amar lah, ana veat nokim leh bealma, deha lav lemaggana itkarena erech appayim. (sefer acher deha kol zimna dayshatedalevan beorayyta mitkayyeymme bealma)

Ribbi chiyyay amar, tora shebbichtav vetora shebbeal pe ukemuha leh lebar nash bealma, hada hu dichtiv naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu. ribbi yose amar mehacha, (Kohelet 2:12) et asher kevar asuhu, asuhu vadday. veda hu tzelem udemut, tzelem: bidchura. demut: benukeba veal da sheruta deorayyta 2, veokmuha.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, mippene ma 2 peticha usetima. ella, beshaata debar nash ate leitchabbera beorayyta, hare hi peticha lekabbela leh, uleishtattefa bahadeh. uveshaata debar nash, satim enoy minnah, veyehach learcha ochora, hare hi setima, missitra ochora. kema deat amer, im yom taazveni yomayim eezvekka. vela yishkach pitcha, ad deyetuv leitchabbar bah beorayyta anpin beanpin, vela yitneshe minnah. veal da orayyta patchat kame bene nasha veachreza vekare lehon (Mishlei 8:4) alechem ishim ekra vegomer uchetiv (Mishlei 1:21) berosh homiyyot tikra befitche shearim bair amareha tomer.
Ribbi yehuda amar, 2 teren gagin, vechad deachid lon. may ka mayyre. ella chad lishshemayya vechad leara, vekudesha berich hu achid vekabbil lon.

Ribbi elazar amar, 3 nehorin (tzedadim illen) innun illain kaddishin, daachidan kachada, veinnun kelala deorayyta, veillen patchin pitcha lecholla. patchin pitcha limhemnuta, veillen beta decholla. veal da bayit ikru, deillen innun beta. uvegin kach sheruta deorayyta 2. deha hi orayyta (sefer acher aviha have asvavta) havi veasvavta dealma.

Uvegin kach, man deishtaddal beorayyta, keillu ishtaddal beh bishma kaddisha. veha ittemar, deorayyta kolla, chad shema kaddisha illaa ihi. uvegin deihi shema kaddisha, patcha bevet, deihi kelala dishma kaddisha, bitlat kishre mehemnuta.

Ta chaze, kol innun demishtaddele beorayyta, mitdabbekin beh bekudesha berich hu, umitattere beitre deorayyta, veitrechimu leella vetatta, vekudesha berich hu oshit lon yemineh (sefer acher vekudesha berich hu areshaym lon) kol shekken innun demishtaddele beorayyta name belelya. veha ukemuha, deinnun mishtattefe bishchinta (nusach acher bichneset yisrael) veitchabbaru kachada. vechad ate tzafra, kudesha berich hu meatter lehu, bechad chuta dechesed, leishtemoda ben illain vetattain.

Vechol innun kochve tzafra, beshaata dichneset yisrael, vechol innun delaan beorayyta, atan leitchazaa kame malka, kullehu mezammere kachada, hada hu dichtiv beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kol bene elohim. may vayyariu. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 24:19) roa hitroaa haaretz. deinnun dinin mittabberin, veattebaru kullehu mikkamme boker, kad ittear boker bealma, kema deat amer, (Bereshit kad) vayyashkem avraham babboker. veal da vayyariu kol bene elohim.
Zohar, Tzav 12: Hasheta it lememar, ha tanenan, veittearu chavrayyay, el bechol atar chesed hu, kema deat amer (Devarim 10) hael haggadol, veda nehiru dechachma illaa, veat (119 amud bet) amrat veel zoem bechol yom, shavik kera kol illen shemahan, veachid behay, i hachi la kayymin mille. veod, dichtiv, (yeshaya 9) el gibbor, o nokim leh dina, o nokim leh rachame.

Ella hachi shemana, chayyayvayya mehappeche rachame ledina. delet lach bechol innun kitrin illain demalka kaddisha, dela kelilan rachame bedina, vedina berachame. vechayyayvayya, mehappeche rachame ledina.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, shappir behahu dichtiv el gibbor, ella el zoem bechol yom mahu, deha bechol yoma veyoma kayyeyma bedina, ben divne alma zakkain, ben dela zakkain. la hava bideh, atu shailu leh lerabbi shimon. amar lon, vadday el zoem bechol yom, veha ukemuha chavrayyay, lezimnin hu dina, lezimnin hu rachame. i zakkain bene alma, ha el kayyeyma, vehu chesed. vei la zakkan, ha el kayyeyma, veikre gibbor, veal da kayyeyma bechol yoma.

Aval milla shappir hu, el bechol atar, nehiru (202) dechachmeta illaa hu, vekayyeyma bekiyyumeh bechol yoma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 52:3) chesed el kol hayyom. veilmale dehay el ittear bealma, la yachil alma lemekam afillu shaata chada, mikkamme dinin takkifin demitarin bealma bechol yoma, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, al tikre behibbaram, ella beavraham, beitaruta deavraham kayyme, vechad ittear avraham bealma, kol innun dinin demishtakkeche bechol yoma veyoma dache lehu levar, vela kayymin kammeh.

Hada hu dichtiv, veel zoem bechol yom, nizam, o zeum bechol yom, la ketiv, ella zoem. bechol yoma veyoma dedina ishtechach, dache lon levar, vekayyeyma hu umevassem alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. veilmale hay, la yachil alma lemekam afilu riga chada. veal da kolla kayymu begineh deavraham.

Vehay dichtiv el gibbor, lav deihu gibbor, ella hay kera remez hu deka ramiz laavahan, uremiza hu deka ramiz limhemnuta illaa kaddisha, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 9:Adonai) pele yoetz el gibbor avi ad sar shalom. pele, da chachmeta illaa, dehi pelia veitkasya mikkolla, kema deat amer (Devarim 17:8) ki yippale mimmecha davar. yoetz, da hu nahar illaa denagid venafik, vela paska, veda yoetz lecholla, veashke lecholla. el da avraham, kema deokimna hael haggadol. gibbor, da yitzchak, dichtiv haggibbor. avi ad, da yaakov, deachid lehay sitra ulehay sitra, vekayyeyma bekiyyuma shelim. sar shalom, da tzaddik, deihu shelama dealma, shelama deveta, shelama dematronita.
Atu ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yehuda, venashsheku yedoy. bachu, veamru zakkaa chulakana, deshailna hay. zakkaa hu dara, deat share begavavyyhu.
Zohar, Tzav 16: 4 Minin balulav, veinnun shiva. vei tema dez minin innun. lav hache, ella arbea ninhu veinnun mitparshin litlata ocharanin. uveovada dilhon ittearu shiva ochoranin leella, leotava alma bechamma sitrin.

Keneset yisrael, af al gav deihi bichlala, mitbarcha mekullehu shit, (sefer acher uleitbarcha meinnun shit) uminnachala daamika demabbua, denagid vela pasik lealmin memoy denagda (sefer acher malenagedaa) alayyhu, veyanka levat. deha begin deihi bat lah lealma illaa vetattaa, itbarcha minnayyhu beitaruta da. deha beshaata dichneset yisrael itbarcha minnayyhu, kullehu almin itbarchan. al da sovvim et hammizbeach kema (24 amud bet) deittemar.

Veod beittearuta da, shita kullehu mitbarcha bemayya, leistappeka beh, veishtaavin kullehu mimmabbua deyena (sefer acher deyamma) (damya) (sefer acher denachala) amika decholla, lenachta lealma. uvegin kach, bayayn kullehu lachin vela yeveshin, leamshacha birchan lealma, begin deilane illen, kullehu lachin tedira, vetarpin dilhon mishtakkechin tedira, uzeman chedvavta dilhon behay zimna.

Vetanenan besifra derav hamenuna sava, deha hahu chela deitpakkeda al ilanin illen, kol chad vechad meillen, la natil birchan dechedvevta leella, ella bezimna da. vechedvavta dilhon kullehu leella, vechedvavta deilanin illen letatta, kullehu bezimna da hu. veittearuta dilhon beinnun kaddishe malka talyayn. vechad yisrael natle lon, kolla ittear bezimna da, vealma mitbarcha, (sefer acher lichneset yisrael mitbarcha) learka birchan lealma.

Ketiv (Tehillim 29:3) kol Adonai al hammayim el hakkavod, amar ribbi yose, da avraham. kol Adonai bakkoach: da yitzchak. kol Adonai behadar: da yaakov. kol Adonai shover arazim: da netzach. kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh: da hod. kol Adonai yachil midbar: da tzaddik. kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot: da tzedek. vechullehu mitgaddele al yamma (mayya) veitshshakyayn bemayya, legaddela. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. vechullehu hane mitare birchan lealma, mehahu shakyu, deitteshakyayn kullehu.
Ta chaze, hane sheva kalin, talyayn bemilla defuma bishar yome shatta, vehasheta, la talyayn ella beovada, vaanan ovada ka baenan, vela milla. begin divzimna da, mevarech lechol shatta.

Beyoma sheviaa dechag, hu siyyuma dedina dealma, ufitkin nafkin mibbe malka, ugevuran mitare umistayyeyman behay yoma, vearve nachal (talyayn) behu. uvaenan leitteara gevuran lemayya. ulesachara 7 zimnin, leravava lehay mizbeach, mimmayya deyitzchak, begin deitmalya mayya hay bera deyitzchak, vechad hu itmalleya, kol alma itbarcha bemayya.

Uvehay yoma gevurot baenan lemayya, ulesayyma lon levatar, deha behay yoma mistayyeyme dina. uvegin kach baenan levattesha lon beara, ulesayyma lon dela mishtachchu, dehay yoma ittearuta vesiyyuma hu. veal da ittearuta vesiyyuma hu deavdinan bearve nachal.

Amar ribbi chiyay vadday hachi hu, veshappir. vearve nachal, missitra denachal, nafke gevuran. uvehay yoma mitare umesayyeyme. behay yoma ketiv, (Bereshit 26:18) vayyashav yitzchak vayachpor et beerot hammayim. beerot ketiv chaser. vayyashav, mahu vayyashav. ella yoma kadmaa deyarcha, sheruta dedina hava bechol alma, veyitzchak kayyeyma lechuresyay lemedan alma. behay yoma, vayyashav yitzchak leitteara dinin ulesayyma dinin. vayachpor et beerot hamayim, learka gevuran likkeneset yisrael, leitteara lemayya, deha mayya bigvuran nachtan lealma.

Uvegin deillen gevuran, la nachtin ella beiva, veyoma deiva la nayycha ruchehon dekayyme alma, ella begin dealma itzterich lehu. may taama. begin dealma bedina itbere, vecholla baya hachi. begin kach kolla beovada talya milleta. veal da, kahana beovada vetikkuna deihu avid letatta, ittearu illain vetattain letakkena lon, umittakne al yedoy.

Amar ribbi yose ha tanenan, haarava dedamya lesifvavn behay yoma, umay hi. amar ribbi chiyyay, af al gav delidrasha hu deate, hachi hu vadday. deha behay yoma besifvavn talya, behay yoma pakid malka lemehav pitkin lesantira, umistayyeyme dinin, veastim lishana bisha mealma. beyoma kadmaa deyarcha sheruta dedina hu, vesiyyuma hu behay yoma. veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, beyoma da shelemin umesayyeyme ammin ovde avoda zara birchan dilhon, vesharan bedina. veyisrael beyoma da mesayyeyme dinin dilhon vesharan bevirchata. deha leyoma ochora zeminin leishtashea bemalka, lenatla mineh birchan lechol shatta, uvehahu chedvavta la mishtakkeche bemalka ella yisrael bilchodayyhu. uman deyativ im malka, venatal leh bilchodeh, kol ma devae shail, veyahiv leh. veal da yisrael sharan, veammin ovde avoda zara mesayyeyme. veal da ketiv, (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai vegomer.

Amar leh, ha chamena leh leesav beshalva, bemalchu, bichrichan illain, veshalit al alma, veat amar vaasim et harav shemama. amar leh, bechol atar hachi hu. kevan demalka kaddisha gazar gezera, veshavvi hahi gezera befitkeh, kera ashid kema deitavid. veal da vaasim et harav shemama, ha shiviti befitka dili. vechen kol innun tavan degazar alayyhu deyisrael, dichtiv, (yechezkel 17:24) ani Adonai dibbarti veasiti.

(Vayikra 7:11) vezot torat haasham vezot torat hammincha vezot torat zevach hashshelamim zot torat hachattat. ribbi yitzchak amar, ha ukemuha i letatta da becholla. i leella da becholla. uman deishtedal beorayyta, natla lechulakeh becholla, veitachid bechol sitrin, vela bae lekarva karbena al nafsheh, veha ittemar.
Zohar, Tzav 17: Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Yirmeyahu 2:8) hakkohanim lo amru aye Adonai vetofse hattora lo yedauni veharoim pashu vi. hakkohanim, illen kohanim dimshammeshin bichhuna gedola, umekarvin millin kaddishin leatrayyhu, umeyaychadin yichuda kol chad vechad kadka chaze. vetofse hattora man innun tofse hattora, vechi kahane lav tofse hattora ninhu. ella, illen innun levae, detafse bechinnorot, deatyayn missitra deorayyta. veityeyhivat missitra dilhon orayyta. veinnun memanan al shevacha detushebachta demalka kaddisha, leyachada leh yichuda shelim kedka yeot. veharoim pashu vi. illen innun ravreve amma, deinnun rayayn leamma, keraya demadbar aneh.

Veillen innun 3 dargin, devaya leishtakkecha tadir al karbena, leashkecha raava leella vetatta, uleishtakkecha birchan bechullehu almin. kahana mekarev karbena, veitkevvavn leyachada shema kaddisha kadka chaze, uleatara sitra dileh. velevae itkavvevnan beshir, leitteara sitra dilhon, uleitkallela besitra dechahana. veyisrael itkevvavn libba ureuta letiuveta shelemata, veitkenna kame malka kaddisha, vehay natil kolla, veitkepar choveh, veishtechach chedvavta beillae vetattae.
Zohar, Tzav 29: Ad dahavo azle, ashkachu chad gavra dehava ate, veg anpe hadas bideh, kerivu gabbeh, amru leh lamma lach hay. amar leravvcha ovda. amar ribbi elazar shappir kaamrat. aval 3 illen lamma. amar leh, chad leavraham. chad leyitzchak, vechad leyaakov. vekashirna lehu kachada, vearachna behu. begin dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 1:3) lereach shemanecha tovim shemen turak shemecha. begin divhay recha, itkeyyaym chulesha denafsha, uvehemnuta da itkayyeyma, veitnegidu birchan meella vetatta. amar ribbi elazar zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, let alma (nusach acher nafsha) mitkayyeyma, ella al recha, umerecha da ishtemoda recha ochora. deha beshaata denafik shabbeta, (nitparda hachavila) vesalleka nafsha yetera, veishtaarun nafsha verucha mitparshan atzivin, ata recha da, umitkarvan da beda vechaddan.

Veal da, bae rucha batar rucha, lekabbela recha, kevan deitkabbal recha mitkarvan kachada vechaddan. ke hay gavvna recha dekurebna, berecha (da) mitkarvin kolla kachada, umitlahatan butzine vechaddan.

Ta chaze, tere butzine, chad leella vechad letatta, i lahit bar nash hay butzina diltatta, vechave lah (sefer acher lehahu dilella), hahu tenana desalik (nusach acher mibbutzina tattaa), lahit hahu butzina illaa. kach tenana dekarbenin, hay tenana desalik, lahit butzine illae, umitlahatan bechad, umitkarvin kullehu kachada, berecha da. uvegin kach, reach nichoach laAdonai, (ishsha) veha ukemuha.

Veal da, recha dekarbena, kiyyuma decholla, vekiyyuma dealma. vekarbena al yeda dechahana, demikrav kolla. uvegin kach, shiva yome ashlemuta, ishtelimu beh, begin deyitbarchun kullehu befulechaneh, veyishtechachu chedvavn uvirkan leella vetatta.
Zohar, Yitro 31-32: (Shemot 20) la tissa, raza da ha ukemuha chavrayyay. begin dekudesha berich hu kad shatil alma, atba go tehome, tzerora chada, chakika bishma kaddisha, veatba lah lego tehoma. vechad mayya baan lesalleka, chaman raza dishma kaddisha, chakik al hahu tzerora, vetayyvin umishtakkein, vehaderin laachora, ushema da kayyeyma ad yoma da, go tehoma.
Uveshaata deomin bene nasha al keshot, bekiyyuma dikshot, hahu tzerora salleka, umekabbela hahu omaa, veahdar veitkayyaym al tehoma, vealma itkayyaym, vehahu omaa dikshot kayyaym alma.

Uveshaata deomu bene nasha omaa leshakkera, hahu tzerora salleka lekabbela lah lehahi omaa, kevan dechaze deihu deshikra. keden hahu tzerora dehava salik, tav laachora, umayin azlin veshatin, veatvavn dehahu tzerora, parchan go tehome, veitbadderan, uvaan mayya lesalleka lechafyay alma, uleahdara leh kemillekaddemin.

Ad dezammin (nusach acher daremayz) kudesha berich hu, lechad memana, yeazriel, di memana al shivin maftechan, beraza dishma kaddisha, veal legabbeh dehahu tzerora, vechakik beh atvavn kemilkaddemin, ucheden itkayyaym alma, veahadru mayin leduchetayyhu. (nusach acher dehahu tzerora varegaysh lehu laatavevan dishma kaddisha vechakik lehu kemillekaddemin veahadaru mayin leduchetayyhu ucheden itkeyyaym alma) veal da ketiv la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav.

Raya mehemna pikkuda 12, leomaa bishmeh beorach keshot. uman deome shevua, hu kalil garmeh, beinnun 7 dargin illain, dishma dekudesha berich hu itkelil behu. veha shita innun. hahu bar nash deome omaa dikshot al pi bet din, kalil garmeh behu, vehu sheviaa, lekayyeyma shema kaddisha beducheteh. val da ketiv, (Devarim 6:13) uvishmo tishshavea. uman deome omaa lemaggena uleshakkera, garim lehahu atar dela yitkayyaym beducheteh.

Omaa lekayyeyma pikkuda demareh, da ihu shevua dikshot, kad hahu yitztzer hara mekatreg levar nash, umefatte leh lemebar al pikkuda demareh. da ihu omaa demareh ishtebach beh, veitztzetrich leh levar nash leumaa bemareh al da, vihu shevacha dileh. vekudesha berich hu mishtebach beh. kegon boaz, dichtiv, (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker. ha yitztzer hara hava mekatreg leh, vome al da.

Neder ihu leella, vinnun chayye malka, raza dermch shayyfin, uterisar ketirin, kechusheban vneder. veal da chamir mishshevua. chayye demalka illen, deyahiv chayyin lechol illen shayyfin, vikrun hachi begin innun chayyin, veinnun chayyin nachtin meella letatta. lehahu mekora dechayyyn. umehahu mekora nachtin letatta, lechol innun shayyfin.

Shevua lekayyeyma darga diltatta, raza dishma kaddisha. vda ikre melech atztzemo, derucha illaa vegufa dileh, lemishre begavvih, uledayyeyra beh, berucha deshare go gufa. veal da ikre melech atztzemo derucha ilaa taiva dile lemishre begavi atztzemo dehahu desattir leela. uvegin kach, man deome bikshot, hu mekayyem lehahu atar, vechad kae hay atar mekuyaym, mekayyem kol alma. neder sharya al kolla, al mitztzeva, veal reshuta delav hachi bishvua, vhachi ukemuha chavrayyay. (ad kan raya mehemana) (pikkuda 13 leitasseka bifriyya ureviyya vechulei ad bechol sitrin. umishsham telech Vayikra 43 amud bet uveyom hashshemini)

(Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho da ihu raza divrit kaddisha. uvegin dibbehay berit kayymin kol mekorin deshayyfe gufa, veihu kalal kolla. kegavvna, da shabbat ihu kelala deorayyta, vechol razin deorayyta beh talyayn, vekiyyuma deshabbat, kekiyyuma dechol orayyta, man denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Raya mehemna pikkuda 24, lemehevi dachir yom hashshabbat, kema deat amer zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. raza deshabbat, ha okimna bechol innun duchete, yoma ducherana denayycha dealma veihu kelala deorayyta. uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kolla. veha ittemar, ducherana deshabbat, lekaddesha leh bechol zine kidushin. man deidkar lemalka, itztzetrich levarcha leh, man deidkar shabbat, tzarich lekaddesha leh veha ittemar.
Zachor lidchura ihu. shamor ihu lenukeba. (veda belo piruda) yom shabbat, raza dechol mehemanuta, detalya meresha illaa, ad sofa dechol dargin, shabbat ihu kolla.

Telat dargin innun, vechullehu ikrun shabbat. shabbat illaa. shabbat deyoma. shabbat delelya. vechullehu chad veikre kolla shabbat. vechol chad, kad ihu shalta, natil lechavroy, vezamin lon bahadeh, behahu shuletanu dileh. vechad hay ate lealma, kullehu atyayn uzeminin bahadeh.

Kad ate lelya, zamin bahadeh leshabbat dimama, vezamin leh behechaleh, veittammar bahadeh. kevan dehay atya, shabbat illaa itmeshach aleh, vchullehu genizin behechla delelya uvegin da seudata delelya chamur mibbeymama (sefer acher kadebaymamea.)

Kad ate yemama, zamin bahadeh litren illen acharanin, darga illaa vedarga tattaa, da deanhir leh, veda deitnehir minih. vecholla kachada ikre shabbat, veshaltin beyoma deshabbat. veillen telat dargin, innun kelala vraza dechol orayyta, tora shebbichtav, neviim uchetuvim. man denatir shabbat, natir orayyta kulla.

rashi: Kalil. kullah shava legavoah:
Vehabbasar. shel kodesh shelamim asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel:
Vehabbasar. lerabbot ever sheyyatza miktzato — shehappenimi muttar (sifra):

Kol tahor yeachel basar. ma tal? lefi shenneemar vedam zevachecha yishshafech vegomer vehabbashar tochel (Devarim 12), yachol lo yochlu shelamim ella habbealim, lechach neemar kol tahor yochal bashar (sifra):

(Vehabbasar kol tahor yeachel basar. kelomar, kol ma sheasarti lecha bechattat veasham, sheim yatzu chutz lakkelaim asurin — kemo shekkatuv bachatzar ohel moed yochluha 0 — bevasar ze ani omer lecha kol tahor yochal basar afillu bechol hair):

Ufashat et begadav. en zo chova ella derech eretz, shello yelachlech behotzaat haddeshen begadim shehu meshammesh bahen tamid — begadim shebbishshel bahen kedera lerabbo, al yimzog bahen kos lerabbo, lechach velavash begadim acherim pechutin mehem (sifra):
Vehotzi et haddeshen. hatztzavur battappuach, keshehu harebe veen makom lammaaracha, motzio mishsham; veen ze chova lechol yom, aval hatteruma chova bechol yom (tamid 28):
Vaychatte et hammizbeach. chitteo vetiharo mizzarut likkanes likdushsha:
Vaykaddeshehu. baavoda zo:
Lechapper alav. meatta kol hakkapparot:
Vayyaas aharon uvanav. lehaggid shivchan, shelo hittu yamin ushomol:
Lehodiacha kosht. shalishim katavti lecha kede shettavin mittocham kosht imre emet. lehashiv amarim emet:
Lesholchecha. leshoalcha horaa:
targum: Leodainach kusheta umile ditritzuta detahafich milata dekusheta limshadrayich:

rashi: Al tiga lehaashir. laasot girsatcha chavilot chavilot, ki sof shettishkachenna:
targum: La tikrav leattira ela vivyunetach perak mineh:

rashi: Ki teshev lilchom. leechol:
Bin tavin. ten libbecha ladaat mi hu, im eno tzara o yafa:
targum: In yetivta lemechal im shalite etbayen kemo reshim kodamayich:

ohc: Vattikkahel haeda vegomer. ulay ki birotam maase moshe shellakach aharon uvanav vehabbegadim vegomer, nikhalu meatzman. o yirtze lehodia shehechzikam hammakom lechol yisrael befetach ohel moed, kemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 10:9) befarashat "hakehel" vegomer, vechan yodia hakkatuv shekken haya.

rashi: Hakkaved. levad hakkaved, shehaya notel meat min hakkaved immah:
Velo tamutu. ha im lo taasu chen hare attem chayyavim mita:
Hataif enecha bo. kerega, shettichpol enecha leatzmo, veen otah girsa metzuya becha:
Hataif. kemo "vechafalta" (Shemot 26:9): "vetaef" (targum uneklos):
targum: In titzar enach beh la mitchaze lach metul demebad aved leh gappata hech nishra detayes bishmaya:

rashi: Bishrirut libbam. bemare libbam; lashon "ashurennu" (Bamidbar 24:17):
targum: Vela kabbilu vela archinu yat udenehon vaazalu baatzathon behirhur libbechon bisha veachzaru befulechani kedal vela shaviu dechalti lokovel appehon:

rashi: Al tigzal dal. al tigzelennu ki tirennu dal, baavur shehu dal, veen lo koach laamod negdecha:
targum: La tigzol lemiskena metul demiskena hu vela temakkech anya vetara:

rashi: Yease lechol melacha. ba velimmed al hachelev sheeno metamme tumat nevelot:
Veachol lo tochluhu. amra tora, yavo issur nevela uterefa veyachul al issur chelev, sheim achalo yitchayyev af al lav shel nevela, velo tomar en issur chal al issur (zevachim 70):
Vayyasem al hammitznefet. petile techelet hakkevuim batztzitz natan al hammitznefet, nimtza hatztzitz taluy bammitznefet:

Echad mikkol korban. lechem echad mikkol min vamin yittol teruma lakkohen haoved avodato, vehashshear neechol labbealim (menachot 77); uvasar labbealim chutz mechaze veshok shebbah, kemo shemmeforash lematta tenufat chaze veshok bishlamim, vehattoda keruya shelamim:
Et haurim. ketav shel shem hameforash:
Veim neder o nedava. shello heviah al hodaa shel nes, enah teuna lechem, veneechelet lishne yamim kemo shemmeforash bainyan:
Umimmochorat vehannotar mimmennu barishon yeachel. 22 zo yetera hi, veyesh kamoha harebe bammikra, kegon veele vene tzivon veayya vaana (Bereshit 36), tet vekodesh vetzava mirmas (Daniel 8):
Vechol chattat vegomer. sheim hichnis middam chattat hachitzona lifnim pesula:
Vechol. lerabbot shear kadashim (sifra):
Meshuva nitztzachat. meshuvat olam; kemo "netzach" (yirmeya 15:18):
Hecheziku. achazu:
Battarmit. bemirma:
targum: Ma den mitchasnin lemetav lefulechani ama haden yatve yerushelem tavu limrad min orayta vela tzavan lemetav atkifu benichlin mesarvin lemetav:

rashi: Kodesh kodashim hu. hu karev veen temurato kereva (sifra):
Veet kol chelbo vegomer. ad kan lo nitparshu emurin baasham, lechach hutzrach lefarsham kan, aval chattat kevar nitparesh bah befarashat vayyikra:
Et haalya. lefi sheasham eno ba ella ayil o keves, veayil vecheves nitrabbu bealya:
Velula vashshemen. zo minchat nedava:
Vachareva. zo minchat chote uminchat kenaot sheen bahen shemen:
Tenufa, teruma. molich umevi maale umorid (menachot 62):
Lihyot baAdonai mivtachecha hodaticha. ani modiacha shettivtach baAdonai vetaasok battora, velo tomar: ech avattel mimmelachti veech etparnes?
targum: Deneheve velaha sivrach veodatach yomana hada af ant:

ohc: Min habbehema. darshu zichronam livracha betorat kohanim lerabbot kilayim mittayish verachel o lehefech, umeamro "kol chelev" ribba koy shehu habba mittayish utzeviyya. veayyen ma shekkatavti bechibburi peri toar al tur yore dea siman 16.

Kol ochel chelev. betorat kohanim darshu lerabbot chelev behemat chulin, shello tite lomar "asher yakriv mimmenna ishshe laAdonai" amar hakkatuv davka chelev kadashim, talmud lomar "kol chelev", veribbuy ze im eno inyan laochlin tenehu inyan lanneechalin.

Vekashe li, ech nite lomar davka chelev kadashim, vahalo amar "vechelev nevela yease lechol melacha", emure kadashim mi muttarim lehedyot? vahalo amru bechetzad tzolin (fesachim 82.) nishchata venimtzet terefa hare ze tetze levet hasserefa, middichtiv (Vayikra 6:23) "bakkodesh baesh tissaref", limmed al kol pesulim shebbakkodesh bisrefa. veim ken, meamro "vechelev nevela vechelev terefa yease lechol melacha" atta yodea ki lo shel kadashim levad asar hakkatuv, velo haya tzarich lomar "kol ochel". veyesh lomar deikar limmud hattanna mikkol ochel chelev" hu al chiyyuv karet, vezulat "kol", hagam shehayiti lamed mippasuk "yease lechol melacha veachol lo tochluhu", hayiti omer lav davka, velo karet, velo ba hakkaret ella al chelev kadashim.

Kol chelev shor vechesev vaez lo tochelu. veamro shor kesev vaez, darshu betorat kohanim shebba lemaet behema temea vechayya veof. uvechullin (daf 116.) amar leh rav mari lerav zevid: i alya ikre chelev, tittesar baachila? amar leh: alecha amar kera "chelev shor vechesev vaez" – davar hashshave beshor vechesev vaez, ad kan. vekashe, vahalo itzterichu shor vechesev vaez lemaet behema temea veof vechayya, shehayu baim bekal vachomer leissur kaamur sham betorat kohanim, talmud lomar "shor vechesev vaez". veulay ki shelosha elle memuatim hem meamro "asher yakriv mimmenna ishshe laAdonai" – yatzta chayya, yatzta behema temea, yatza of sheen kullo nikrav. o sheachar shemmiet hakkatuv behema temea vechayya, hare gilla hakkatuv sheen ladun kal vachomer middam, shehare behema temea vechayya yochichu. vechen timtza shekkatav Rashi bechullin (daf 117.) beferush hammishna sheamra eno noheg ella battehorim – dichtiv "asher yakriv mimmenna ishshe laAdonai". veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Min habbehema. darshu betorat kohanim lehavi chullin baale mumin, shello tomar chullin dumeya dekadashim – talmud lomar "min habbehema" lerabbot afillu baale mumin. vahagam sheasar hakkatuv beferush chelev nevela uterefa hagam sheasurim lammizbeach, bishlama terefa nuchal lomar kedaat rambam (aysaveray mizbeach 82) sheen bah issur lammizbeach min hattora ella mishshum (Malachi 1:8) "hakerivehu na lefechatecha", vahagam shebbetorat kohanim (siman 1 82) darshu leesor min hakkatuv – eno ella asmachta uchemo shekkatav sham hakkesef mishne, ella nevela pesul hammizbeach hu, ki "veshachat" ketiv bechol hakkarbanot. veyesh lomar shelinyan karet mechazzer hattanna, uchemo shekkatavti lemala.

Asher yakriv. amru betorat kohanim: ma talmud lomar "asher yakriv"? chelev shekkemoto kasher likkarev al gabbe hammizbeach, yatza chelev defanot sheen kasher likkarev, ad kan. hinne lisvara zo shehotzi miut behema temea vechayya veof meamro "shor vechesev vaez", lo haya tzarich lomar "asher yakriv", vehutzrach lemaet chelev defanot.

Vekashe lerav zevid sheddarash "shor vechesev vaez" laalya shemmutteret, vaasher yakriv" lemaet behema temea vechayya vaof, minnayin lehattir chelev defanot? gam lattanna sheddarash "shor vechesev vaez" lemaet temea vechayya vaof, hetter haalya mena leh? veyesh lomar lerav zevid amro "asher yakriv" yemaet behema chayya vaof vechulei gam chelev defanot, ki chol sheeno karev laAdonai hare hu bichlal hammiut. vetanna detorat kohanim gam ken yemaet gam ken meamro "shor vechesev vaez" et haalya, sheim lo ba hakkatuv ella livhema temea vechayya vaof lo haya lo lomar ella shor vase, ucheshennitmaet davar sheyyeshno beissur dam tu lo avdinan kal vachomer, uchelum lema itzterich lemaet mishshum shehayiti dan kal vachomer middam, bemiut echad sheyyitmaet behema temea o chayya o of nistar kal vachomer, velo itzterich ella lelammed al haalya sheenah shava bechullan shemmutteret.

Ella sheadayin en haddaat mityashshevet baze, lamma yachlok rav zevid al tanna detorat kohanim dimmaet temea vechayya veof mishshor vechesev vaez" vehu yemaatem measher yakriv mimmenna laAdonai"? veod hare hattanna gilla dato ki amro "asher yakriv" vegomer lo yaspik lidrosh mimmennu lemaet behema temea vechayya veof vechelev haddefanot mimma shechillekam lishne miutim. asher al ken hannachon beenay hu ki gam lechulle alma miut behema temea chayya veof eno ella meamro "shor vechesev vaez", uderasha zo hayta tzodeket hagam shehaya omer shor vase, umimma shepperat kesev vaez lemaet haalya, veamro "asher yakriv" ba lemaet chelev haddefanot, velo kemo shepperesh Rashi (chullin 117.) shekkatavti lemala.

rashi: Kodesh kodashim hu. betorat kohanim hu nidrash:

Im al toda yakrivennu. im al devar hodaa al nes shennaasa lo, kegon yorde hayyam veholche midbarot vachavushe bet haasurim vechole shennitrappe — shehen tzerichin lehodot, shekkatuv bahen yodu laAdonai chasdo venifleotav livne adam veyizbechu zivche toda (Tehillim 107) — im al achat meelle nadar shelamim hallalu, shalme toda hen, uteunot lechem haamur bainyan, veen neechalin ella leyom velayla, kemo shemmeforash kan:

Vehikriv al zevach hattoda. arbaa mine lechem — challot urekikin urevucha, shelosha mine matztza, uchetiv al challot lechem chametz vegomer; vechol min vamin eser challot, kach meforash bimnachot, veshiuran chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot, shehen 6 midbariyyot, 20 issaron (menachot 76):
Murbechet. lechem chalut berotchin kol tzarko:
Ushetachum lashshemesh. vehakkasdim yishkenu latzur al hair bekivre hassarim, shehayu naim kefallatin (sanhedrin tzav:):
Ledomen. lezevel:
targum: Veyishtichunun likavel shimsha vesihara ulechol chele shemaya derachamunun vediflachunun vedito vatrehon veditvaunun vedisgidu lehon la yitkanshun vela yitkabberun lezeval mevader al appe ara yehon:

rashi: Lo teafe chametz chelkam. af hashsheyarim asurim bechametz (menachot 55):
Kachattat vechaasham. minchat chote hare hi kechattat, lefichach kematzah shelo lishmah pesula, minchat nedava hare hi keasham, lefichach kematzah shello lishmah keshera (sifra):
Kol zachar. afillu baal mum; lamma neemar? im laachila hare kevar amur, lechem elohav mikkadshe hakkodashim vegomer (Vayikra 21), ella lerabbot baale mumin lemachaloket (sifra):
Kol asher yigga vegomer. kadashim kallim o chullin sheyyiggeu bah veyivleu mimmenna:
Yikdash. lihyot kamoha, sheim pesula yippaslu, veim keshera yeachlu kechomer hammincha (sham):
Tzav et aharon. en tzav ella leshon zeruz miyyad uledorot; amar rabbi shimon, beyoter tzarich hakkatuv lezarez bemakom sheyyesh bo chesron kis (sifra):

Zot torat haola vegomer. hare hainyan hazze ba lelammed al hekter chalavim veevarim sheyyehe kasher kol hallayla, ulelammed al happesulin e ze im ala yered, vee ze im ala lo yered, shekkol tora lerabbot hiv ba, lomar — tora achat lechol haolim, vaafilu pesulin, sheim alu lo yerdu (sham):
Hiv haola. lemaet et harovea veet hannirba vechayyotze bahen, shello haya pesulan bakkodesh, shennifselu kodem shebbau laazara (sham 8):
ohc: Tzav et aharon. amru zichronam livracha betorat kohanim (ayyen kiddushin 29.) en tzav ella zeruz miyyad uledorot, amar rabbi shimon: beyoter tzarich hakkatuv lezarez kol makom sheyyesh bo chesron kis, ad kan. hinne letanna kamma yesh kan zeruz, letzad ma sheggadlu perate dine haola ballayla, ma sheen mishpat dome lah bechol hakkarbanot, laze zerzo miyyad, perush leoto zeman yitnaheg, kemo shellamdu betorat kohanim mipparashat nerot dichtiv (Vayikra 24:2) "tzav et bene yisrael veyikchu elecha" vegomer, uchetiv (Bamidbar 8:3) "vayyaas ken aharon". ledorot, perush sheyyitnahagu mishpete haola kichtavan ledorot, sheamru zichronam livracha (Pesikta pasuk et karbani lachmi Bamidbar 28:2) veze leshonam: lefi shehayu yisrael omrim, lesheavar hayu hammassaot nohagim vehattemidin nohagim, pasku hammassaot pasku hattemidin, ad kan, hare sheyyesh makom litot shello tinhag ledorot.

Vechesron kis sheomer rabbi shimon, rabbu bo happerushim: yesh omrim lav davka chesron kis, ella hiv haddin ribbuy hatztzaar, veyesh omrim ki haya batel mimmelachto kol hallayla, vehu chesron kis, veyesh omrim chesron kis hiv leyisrael, sheevre ola nisrafin al hammizbeach veenam nehenin mehem, veyesh omrim chesron kis lakkohen, shehu yirtze lehakeriv karbanot acherim sheyyesh lo zechut bahem, ma sheen ken haola shekkullah kalil veen lo bah ella haor, vechol haddevarim rechokim beenay.

Veulay nire shehu al hatemadat etzim sheamru zichronam livracha (yoma ma.) shalosh maarachot shel esh hayu sham vechulei, shelishit en aleha kelum, ella lekayyem "esh tamid tukad" vegomer ad kan, al perat ze amar chesron kis, perush lelo davar, sheen bo echad mehakkarbanot, ella shettihye haesh ochelet etzim kol hallayla, vegam hem shavim mamon.

Od nire ki chesron kis hiv, letzad shemmitzvat olat tamid asa bah hakkatuv davar gadol, dichtiv (Vayikra 6:5) "uvier aleha hakkohen vegomer vearach aleha haola", vetanu rabbanan betorat kohanim: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar? talmud lomar "aleha haola", ad kan, vetanya betosefta difsachim: kol hakkodashim shehikrivan kodem letamid shel shachar vechulei pesulim vechulei, ad kan.

Ha lamadta, im en ola kol hannaase kodem lah pasul. umizze yishtalshelu devarim rabbim sheyyesh bahem chesron kis. hare shehevi keves ben shenato, veim haya makrivo samuch lahavaato haya kasher, uletzad sheomrim lo amod ad sheyyakriv tamid shel shachar, hare ze hifsido bishhiyyat shaa achat, ki monin shaot lekadashim, kidita beferek 2 dizvachim (zevachim ko:) uveferek al ellu mumin (bechorot lat:).

Vechen mashkachat lah im kamatz vehiktir kodem hare ze pasul, gam mashkachat lah sheyyihye zeman shello haya lahem kevasim lehakeriv, bizman shehayta yerushalayim bematzor veen metziut laavodat bet elohenu lehakeriv karban mehakkarbanot habbaim mishshear baale chayyim vehammenachot vehakketoret, utzerichin yisrael latet mamon rav becheves letzad sheen metziut lehakeriv ad sheyyakdim, vechen timtza (bava kamma 82:) shehayu meshalshelin lahem kuppa melea dinare zahav bead keves echad, veen lecha chesron kis gadol mizze, veulay sheim lo haya haikkuv hannizkar lo hayu notnim kol hafelaga becheves echad bechol yom uvifrat minnichse gavoah.

Lemor. en yadua lemi yomru, veim ledorot, hare davar ze nishma meamro "tzav", kemo shekkatavnu besamuch, veim lomar leyisrael kede sheyyachinu haola umachshireha vaatze hammaaracha, hare amar "vaydabber Adonai vegomer lemor".

Veulay ki tzivva alav sheyyomar leaharon derashot harmuzot bemichtav elohim, vehaddikdukim asher yechavven lahem hakkatuv, ki happasuk hiv kechazon hassatum, uma shettimtza sheddarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha eno ella lefi ma shekkadam alehem mehahalachot shenneemru lemoshe besinay, veotam tzivva Adonai lemor leaharon.

O yirtze, letzad shehichshir olim al hammizbeach, hagam shennifselu kaamur bedivrehem (torat kohanim) beferush hakkatuv, laze tzivva sheyyomar lahem sheyyishtaddelu leval yaalu min happesulin, birotam ki enam yordin yachshevu ki en kefeda kol kach baaliyyatam velo yittenu alehem lev leshamram leval yaalu, laze tzivva lemor lahem, sheyyishmeru shello taale ella torat haola, perush ola ketoratah uchemishpatah belo lina belo yetzia vechulei:

Zot torat haola vegomer. rabbi yehuda darash (torat kohanim kan) shelosha miutim: "zot", "hi", veh shel "haola" sheniyya, lemaet nishchata ballayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim – ellu im alu yerdu. aval hallan, vezevach hayyotze, vehattame vechulei, im alu lo yerdu, vechol shear happesulin im alu lo yerdu, ki tevat "torat" ribbuy hiv.

Veze shiur hakkatuv "zot torat haola hi haola", perush, kol shealta al mokda vechulei, torat ola yesh lah, veen lecha bah pesul ella kodem shealta, aval im alta al mokda al hammizbeach, torat ola yesh lah bechol gavvna, vechol happesulin tiharam hammizbeach zulat shelosha devarim shemmiet kannizkar, shello haya lo lomar ella "torat haola ola al mokda" veamar "zot", veamar "ha", veamar "hi", lemaet kannizkar:

Hi haola. katav Rashi zichrono livracha miet harovea vechulei, lo yadati lamma bachar yoter lefaresh hakkatuv alibba derabbi shimon velo alibba derabbi yehuda, shekkatav lemaet hannishchat ballayla, veshennishpach damah. veod lo dikdek yafe harav bilshono, shello katav hammiutim bezot" ella behi haola", verabbi shimon mizzot" darish.

Ufashut etzli ki mimmiut "zot" levad darish rabbi shimon, velo mehi haola", ki en tzarich lerabbi shimon miutim rabbim lapperatim sheamar bahem im yaalu yerdu, kemo shemmiet rabbi yehuda shelosha [peratim] mishshelosha miutim, sheim banu lomar ken tzerichim anu lemiutim rabbim millispor, ki rabbim hem happeratim shehizkiram rabbi shimon shealehem ba hammiut, ella vadday ki mimmiut echad miet hakkol, kol sheen pesulo bakkodesh en hakkodesh mekabbelo, vechevan sheen tzarich ella miut echad vekatane leh babberayta (zevachim 84.) talmud lomar "zot", minnayin lerashi lomar sheddoresh "hi haola"?

Vetimtza sheamru behorayot (2.) al matnita dekatane "nefesh achat" vechulei, hare ellu miutin, haose mippi atzmo vechulei, umoke hashshas habbarayta kerabbi yehuda, ufarich dilma rabbi shimon hi, umeshanne man shemat leh dedarish miut kehay rabbi yehuda, detanya "zot torat haola hiv haola" hare ellu miutin, hare ki rabbi shimon lo darish miut.

Al mokda al hammizbeach. yitbaer al derech amram beferek hammizbeach mekaddesh (zevachim pe:) kol ellu sheim alu lo yerdu, im yardu lo yaalu. amar ulla: lo shanu ella shello mashla bahem haur, aval mashla bahem haur – yaalu. vahagam deikka hatam man dematne asefa daatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vechulei, hare massik baggemara delo nafka pelugeta ella besefa, aval beresha deresha haevarim vehaemurim happesulim shennitrabbu mehaola sheim alu lo yerdu veim yardu lo yaalu, lechulle alma im shalat bahem haur yaalu hagam sheyyardu.

Velaze amar hakkatuv, keneged otam shemmashla bahem haur "al mokda", ucheneged otan sheadayin lo mashla bahen haur ella alu lammizbeach amar "al hammizbeach", vechillekam hakkatuv letzad sheyyishtannu bedinam, "al mokda" taale hagam sheyyarda, aval ma shehosif hakkatuv lomar "al hammizbeach", davka im alta velo yarda:

Velaze hikdim hakkatuv lomar "al mokda", kodem amro "al hammizbeach", umin harauy yakdim aliyyat hammizbeach ki enah mokda ella achar shekkadam hammizbeach, ella nitkavven lirshom haderaga rishona shebbah yachzor happasul kasher mammash leinyan im yardu yaalu, veachar kach amar haderaga sheniyya sheen bahem hasarat pesul, ella kol od shehem al hammizbeach kannizkar.

Uvetorat kohanim nechleku rabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua, rabban gamliel sover "al hammizbeach", kol davar sherauy lammizbeach im alu lo yerdu, vaafillu nesachim, verabbi yehoshua sover "al mokda" davka velo nesachim vechulei, veshivim panim lattora (Zohar kadosh chelek 1 47:).

Uvederech remez tirmoz kol happarasha al galut haacharon sheanu bo lenachamenu meitztzevon nafshenu, ki chol ish yisrael meana hinnachem nafsho birot orech haggalut. nire lemi dome: lemitzrayim arba meot, levavel shivim, lishnehem yachad arba meot veshivim, vehen hayyom elef 678 ma ayachel od? velo galut levad ella innuy mehaummot, ki chol goy umamlacha bivne yisrael yaavodu, vaasher ze yesovev chashov lo tov, ki sefat emet lo hukkera bechonnut veheericha leshon sheker. uva hatztzofe umabbit ad sof kol haddorot, kore haddorot merosh vehodia lemoshe lezarez leyisrael, uverosham bene tora sifte chohen asher tora yevakshu mippihu, aharon uvanav, lehodia laddorot et haddavar hazze.

Zot torat haola, amar "zot" lemaet kol haaliyyot sheen kamoha ola, vechazar uferesh mi hi zot, veamar hiv haola kevar, dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 3:6) "mi zot ola min hammidbar". "al mokda al hammizbeach" hem shene peratim sheanu bahem, haechad sheanu bene tora, ma sheen bechol haummot, vehashsheni sheanu meyussarim begalut veyissurin vedallut. keneged hattora amar al mokda shennimshela hattora laesh, vechen timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (taanit 4.) hay tzureba merabbanan deratach orayta vechulei, ucheneged haggalut vaanafav amar al hammizbeach ki hayyissurin mityaches lahem shem mizbeach lihyotam kappara, vechen hiv bilshon chachamim (berachot 5.). vehodia hakkatuv ki beemtzaut shene devarim tihye aliyyatenu meyoedet bahafelagot hammeullot meshunnot leshevach shevachim asher lo haya velo yihye.

Uveer ad matay yihyu yisrael begeder shene devarim ellu, kol hallayla, shehu zeman haggalut hannimshal lelayla "shomer ma millayla" (Yeshayahu 21:11), vechen bappasuk "lini hallayla" darshu zichronam livracha al haggalut, ad habboker shehu zeman sheyyarik alenu kevodo veata boker, vehazzeman hiv achar avor 500 laelef hashshishshi, lefi ma shekkadam lanu middivrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 19:8) ki yomo shel hakkadosh baruch hiv elef shana, umehashshechel yihyu 500 rishona middat layla vetk sheniyya middat yom, vehodia Adonai ki ad habboker shekkesheyyiggamer 500 shana baggalut ad habboker sheyyihye haaliyya, uvoker ze en ani yodea im boker shel elef hachamishi o bakro shel elef hashshishshi ki baelef harvii gala kevod yisrael baakevo, laze gilla Adonai sodo beyad avadav hanneviim ki hiv levoker sheni, vehu amro (Yeshayahu 33:2) "heye zeroam labbekarim" – lishne bekarim, levoker sheni im lo levoker rishon. velaze amar "ad habboker" hayyadua shehu sheni velo boker habba rishon baggalut. veulay ki laze ramaz hannavi beamro (Yeshayahu 21:12) "amar shomer ata voker vegam layla", perush hagam sheata boker rishon lo hoil uva gam ken hallayla acharav ki lo noshanu bo. veulay ki illu yisrael hayu shelemim hayu nigalim bevoker rishon.

Vehu ma sheramuz bedivrehem shello nigzar al yisrael galut ella yom echad, dichtiv (tehillim 20:2) "yaancha Adonai beyom tzara", perush yomo shel hakkadosh baruch hiv, velo nisharim ella 672 shehem 172 shennisharu meelef harvii vetk shel elef hachamishi, hare 672, uvabboker hayu nigalim, uletzad maasehem haraim ikkev veyied boker sheni, velaze nitkavven beamro (yeshaya 33:2) "Adonai channenu lecha kivvinu" vegomer, perush kivvinu lihyot haggeulla bevoker rishon shello leakkev ad boker sheni, aval al kol panim heye zeroam labbekarim kesheyyaavru shanim.

Veamro veesh hammizbeach tukad bo, yodia hakkatuv ki beor boker teshan af Adonai veesh mippiv tochel al asher innunu bene avla veyisserunu beyissure nekama, uvifrat bene hammaarav happenimi en lecha kos mar shello hitimu tamid. vehu amro "veesh hammizbeach" sheramaznu bo bechinat hayyissurin mehaummot velo richem libbam laasher hikka Adonai ze yamim vehishpil geon yaakov, velo nahag bam bechinat deraon, lomar day reot elyone elyonim lematta matta. esh mizbeach ze tukad bo benelam hannelamim ki hiv hammekanne velovesh kina, veramaz gam ken beamro "veesh hammizbeach" livchinat akedat yitzchak, gam hammizbeach yaggid el bechinat haddin ki yitorru haddinim veyitgabberu, vehu sod amro tukad bo, vehaven.
