Velavash hakkohen middo vad. yirtze lemiddat hachesed veharachamim ki yitkanne beshem kohen, hakkavvana sheggam hachasadim yaskimu linkom nakam, veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat vaera vegomer befasuk (Shemot 6:2) "vayyomer elav ani Adonai". veamro "middo vad" yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha ki chol nefesh shehorgim haummot miyyisrael al kiddush shemo yitbarach, hakkadosh baruch hiv roshem middamo tzurat hanneherag hahu bammalbush veoto yilbosh yom nakam belibbo, vehu amro middo asher bo, otam shehem bad, shehem yisrael asher hem (Bamidbar 23:9) "am levadad yishkon" vesharshah bad. gam yirmoz el haachdut shehem neheragim al asher lo yachpetzu leshattef shem shamayim vedavar acher umeyachadim shemo yitbarach.

Veamro umichnese vad yirmoz lema shehargu haummot mehaanashim hanniggashim el Adonai, hammachnisim emunat Adonai veachduto belev yisrael, vehem hem yakkire el elyon asher en davar mafsik beno levenam, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar "umichnese vad" leshon hachenasa. bad hiv bechinat haachdut, leelle amar "al besaro", perush, en davar mafsik benam leven Adonai, veamar besaro leshakkech et haozen, al derech amro (Yirmeyahu 13:11) "kaasher yidbak haezor el matne ish" vegomer, (Bamidbar 11:1), "beazne Adonai", (tehillim 34:16) "ene Adonai", uletzad ma sheasu lehatztzaddikim hallalu yechatem gezar din leumma reshaa.

Veamro veherim et haddeshen keneged ma shehereu bivchinat hayyissurin vehainnuyim asher tzarru otanu, veim bata lirot hiv yoter miggalut mitzrayim, ki galut mitzrayim hayu meshabedim otam umaachilim otam umalbishim otam, vetze ulemad mimma sheamru zichronam livracha (mechilta, yalkut Bamidbar 11:5) befasuk "zacharnu et vegomer et hakkishshuim" vegomer, chinnam hayu ochlim hakkol, vehen galut yishmeelim, ashre mi shello raam meshabedim umemarrim chayye yisrael, velo day shello yittenu sachar ella od shoalim mimmennu medod vehava, veod adam nigzal bema sheyyesh lo vehem tovim mimmennu ma sheen lo, vechos ze yashkuhu ad sheyyamut. ucheneged ze amar veherim el merim roshi et haddeshen asher tochal haesh esh haammim, ki matzinu shetztzarat haummot tikkare esh, vetze ulemad meesh ben hakkeruvim (Yechezkel 10:2), et haola shehi haumma hannikret ola.

Veamro "al hammizbeach" yitbaer al derech ma shennechleku rambam (hilchot teshuva 86) veraavad beinyan mishpat haovde kochavim hameannim ummatenu, ki haraavad sover sheyyishshaftu al asher hereu yoter mehakkatzuv leheyotam baale bechira veratzon. verambam sover ki yishshaftu gam al haikkar, uchevar katavti befarashat ben habbetarim (Bereshit 15:14) ki haemet hiv sheyyishshaftu al hakkol betuv taam. umechadash ani dover ki mehattosefet yukkach reaya el haikkar, sheim kavvanat hammeannim lekayyem mitzvat Adonai haya lahem shello lehosif, umimma shehosifu gillu datam ki lo lemitzva yechavvenu. vehu amro "al hammizbeach", perush, beyater al hashshiur shehu lechappara shekkatzav Adonai lahem oto, sheyyaasu beyoter mehakkatzuv, vesamo etzel hammizbeach shehu hakkatzuv lechappara, veyadin mimmennu ki lo lemitzvat Adonai hem mitkavvenim, shehayyater yegalle al bechinat hannigzara lechappara im lah mitkavvenim o besina lehara levad venimtzaim mitchayyevim al hakkol. o yirtze ki hagam sheadayin lo shalmu yeme galut yavo Adonai leminyan hannotar mehatztzaar hakkatzuv asher hosifu bene avla leannot, vesamo etzel hammizbeach lehashelim bo kappara hatztzericha asher katzav Adonai bigzerat haggalut. od yirtze ki yakriv maase hatztzarot lifne middat haddin shemmityacheset lammizbeach kede linkom nakam meoyvenu.

Veamro ufashat vegomer, leheyot shebbegadim harishonim hem laasot mishpat beose raatenu, veachshav ba lehetiv lehotzienu mehaggalut ulehetiv otanu, laze yilbash bigde bechinat hahatava, ki lo yeakkev kibbutz galuyyot ad kelot ose risha, ella techef umiyyad yekabbetz nefutzotenu veyotzi otanu mimmachane haanashim harshaim el makom tahor, hi eretz yisrael hattehora, ki eretz haammim hi temea hi vaafarah vaafillu avirah (shabbat 15.), veen lecha makom sheyyikkare tahor zulat eretz hakkedosha. gam yirmoz beamro makom tahor mekomo shel hakkadosh baruch hiv hannikra tahor kivyachol.

Veamro vehaesh al hammizbeach, perush, lo tedamme ki en tzara leose risha ella haraa hahi asher yaase Adonai bahem shefatim behotzi otanu mibbenehem, lo chen, ella "vehaesh", hi bechinat esh hammishpat "lo tichbe", uvier aleha hakkohen etzim – hem haummot shehem etzim yeveshim, al derech amro (Devarim 20:19) "ki haadam etz", vechen amru berabbot (Eicha Rabba, Petichta) veze leshonam: haetzim ellu haggaluyyot, ad kan.

Veamro babboker babboker yirtze, lefi ma shehikdamnu ki zeman haggeulla haya rauy lihyot babboker rishon shel shenat 505 laelef hachamishi, ulesibbat heavon nitakkev ad boker sheni, veamar hakkatuv ki lo mippene ze yizku haummot velo yavo alehem ma shehaya tzarich lavo alehem bevoker rishon. lu yehi sheyyisrael lo zachu liggael, af al pi chen lo yimmaltu haummot mehatztzara shehayta atida lavo alehem az, veyavi Adonai alehem ma shennitchayyevu bevoker rishon uvoker sheni.

Veamro vearach aleha vegomer, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava kamma fag.) hakkol lefi hammevayyesh vehammitbayyesh, ki eno dome nichbad hammevayyesh nichbad levazuy hammevayyesh nichbad, veen tzarich lomar eved hammevayyesh et rabbo, vehu omer "vearach aleha haola" shehu haumma hayyisreelit bichlalutah. vehiktir aleha perush yaarich gam ken bechinat hatztzaddikim hashshelemim muvchare yisrael shelemim shebbahem hammaalim reach besamim, al derech amro (Bereshit 27:27) "ree reach beni kereach sade". veteda ki kol haover averot recho nodef leraa, vehammaase shehuva bedivrehem (102 hayyashar perek 7) shehaya over eliyyahu veraa adam rasha umana atzmo mehariach recho hara yoter mimma shehirgish beavro al sirchon nevela, uvehefech yihye leish tzaddik shalem sheyyaale mimmennu bosem kereach haggan, laze zachar zichron arevatam bilshon haketara, vehammechuvvan ki yishpot bifratut et asher hereu leanshe bosem. od yirtze ki kaasher yaarich Adonai et haola linkom nikmatah mehammereim, lo yaarichenna bifne atzmah ella yaktir aleha hammuvcharim vehashshelemim shebbaumma sheyyikkaru beshem "chelev hashshelamim", shebbaze tigdal maalatah shel haumma linkom nekama gedola missoneha.

Veamro esh tamid vegomer, perush, hagam sheyyakke Adonai bahem makka rabba, lo tichbe esh vetamid tukad al hammizbeach, al derech amro (Yoel 4:21) "venikketi damam lo nikketi", ad avod ruach hattuma min haaretz, vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz (Zecharya 14:9).

rashi: Vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo. ribba kan yekidot harebe — al mokda, veesh hammizbeach tukad bo, vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo, esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach, kullan nidreshu bemassechet yoma (daf 45), shennechleku rabbotenu beminyan hammaarachot shehayu sham:
Vearach aleha haola. olat tamid hi tikdom (menachot 49):
Chelve hashshelamim. im yaviu sham shelamim, verabbotenu lamdu mikkan "aleha" — al olat habboker hashelem kol hakkarbanot kullam, mikkan shello yehe davar meuchar letamid shel ben haarbayim (sifra):
Veherim mimmennu. min hamechubbar — sheyyehe issaron shalem bevat achat bishat kemitza (sifra):
Bekumtzo. shello yaashe midda lakkometz (sham):
Missolet hammincha umishshamnah. mikkan shekkometz mimmakom shennitrabba shamnah (sota 14):
Hammincha. shello tehe meorevet beacheret (sifra):

Veet kol hallevona asher al hammincha vehiktir. melakket et levonatah leachar kemitza umaktiro; ulefi shello peresh ken ella beachat min hammenachot bevayyikra, hutzrach lishnot parasha zo, lichlol kol hammenachot kemishpatan:
Venivchar mavet mechayyim. af al pi shehem roim et hammetim netunin bevizzayon, tzarat hachayyim gedola hemenna, veyivcharu et hammavet:
targum: Veyitreun bemota midivchaya lechol sheara deyishtaarun min zarita vishta hada bechol atraya deyishtaarun deagletinun letaman amar Adonai tzevaot:

rashi: Vezot torat hammincha. tora achat lechullan — lehateinan shemen ulevona haamurin bainyan, sheyyachol en li teunot shemen ulevona ella minchat yishorael shehi nikmetzet, minchat kohanim shehi kalil minnayin? tal torat (sifra):
Hakerev otah. hi haggasha bekeren deromit maaravit (sham):
Lifne Adonai. hu maarav shehu letzad ohel moed:
El pene hammizbeach. hu haddarom, shehu panav shel mizbeach, shehakkevesh natun leoto haruach (sota 14):

ohc: Vayyimshach et hammishkan vegomer. hattaam shehifsik ben levishat aharon limshichato bimshichat hammishkan vechelav, letzad shemmatzinu shetztzivva Adonai bimshichat hammishkan vechelav kodem limshichat aharon karashum befarashat pekude (Shemot 40:9), umin harauy haya lehakedim meshichat hammishkan gam lilvishat bigde aharon karashum sham, vetaam shello asa chen letzad sheddikdek maamar Adonai kan befarasha zo (pasuk 2) sheamar lo "kach et aharon vegomer veet shemen hammishcha" vegomer, veim meshichat hammishkan kodemet gam lilvishat bigde aharon haya lo lomar "kach et shemen hammishcha" shehu davar sheyyaase mimmennu hammitzva harishona shehi meshichat hammishkan, veen makom litot meamro "kach et shemen hammishcha" rishona sheyyimshach aharon kodem levishat begadav, shehare kevar amar "vehilbashta et aharon vegomer umashachta oto" (Shemot 28:41), ella vadday shekkavvanato hu lehakedim levishat habbegadim kodem limshichat hammishkan, uma shehikdim meshichat mishkan befarashat pekude lilvishat bigde aharon velimshichato eno ella limshichato davka, ella letzad shello ratza hakkatuv lehafesik ben mitzvat habbegadim lemitzvat hammeshicha shel aharon laze amar kol dine aharon yachad, uleolam lo takdim meshichat hammishkan vechelav ella limshichat aharon velo labbegadim, kemo sheggilla kan kannizkar.

rashi: Or haola asher hikriv lakkohen lo yihye. perat litvul yom umechussar kippurim veonen sheen cholkim baorot (sham):

ohc: Kaasher tzivveti. perush, al haachila tzivva kevar sheyyochluha, veatta hu metzavve al hammakom. ha lamadta: mitzva al haachila, umitzva al hammakom, veim yirtze shello leechol hare ze bittel hammitzva, veim yirtze leechol chutz mehammakom hare ze bittel hammitzva. veamro lemor, perush, lo shetztzivva meatzmo ella mimma shenneemar lo mippi hashshechina.
Chassalat parashat tzav

rashi: Yadav teviena vegomer. shettehe yad habbealim millemala, vehachelev vehechazot netunin bah, veyad kohen millematta umenifan (menachot sefer acher):
Et ishshe Adonai. uma hen haishshim?

Et hachelev al hechaze yeviennu. keshemmevio mibbet hammitbachayim noten chelev al hechaze, ucheshennotno leyad hakkohen hammenif nimtza hechaze lemala vehachelev lematta, vezehu haamur bemakom acher shok hatteruma vachaze hattenufa al ishshe hachalavim yaviu lehanif vegomer (Vayikra 10), uleachar hattenufa notno lakkohen hammaktir, venimtza hechaze lematta, vezehu shenneemar vayyashimu et hachalavim al hechazot vayyakter hachalavim hammizbecha (sham 9), limmedanu sheshshelosha kohanim zekukin lah, kach meforash bimnachot:

Et hachelev al hechaze yeviennu. veet hechaze lamma mevi? lehanif oto hu mevio velo sheyyehe hu mehaishshim: lefi shenneemar et ishshe Adonai et hachelev al hechaze yachol sheyyehe af hechaze laishshim, lechach neemar et hechaze lehanif vegomer:
Ze haddavar. devarim shettiru sheani ose lifnechem, tzivvani hakkabba laasot, veal tomru lichvodi velichvod achi ani oshe; kol hainyan hazze perashti bevatta tetzavve":
ohc: Vayyomer vegomer ze haddavar vegomer. amar ken lehodiam leval yeararu al haddavar kekorach vechaadato, bechashvam ki millibbo umertzono haya ose. umeatta en taana lekorach ki shogeg haya, shehare hodio bishat maase ki ze haddavar hu mitzvat Adonai velo millibbo umertzono shel moshe.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 2:6; zevachim kav.) ki moshe melech haya, dichtiv (Devarim 33:5) "vayhi vishurun melech", utenan (ketuvot 17.): melech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul. vehinne moshe haya ose maasim sheasur laasotam afillu eved ivri laadono, lirchotz otam bammayim vechulei kol gufam vechol seder hammaase, veen lecha zilzul gadol mizze. asher al ken hikdim lomar ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai mippi Adonai neemar li laasoto, vedavka ze velo acher, ki hammelech asur laasot ken hagam sheyyachpotz limchol, ki davka ze haddavar, letzad shehappe sheasar melech shello yimchol al kevodo hu shehittir vetzivva li laasot.

Od yirtze al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha betorat kohanim bappasuk "vayyirchatz otam bammayim", beotah shaa zachu bekiddush yadayim veraglayim uvitvilat yom hakkippurim, ad kan. vehu amro "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai laasot" ledorot, ki baze yizku bekiddush yadayim veraglayim utevila beyom hakkippurim ledorot:

rashi: Yishchatu. ribba lanu shechitot harebe; lefi shemmatzinu asham betzibbur, neemar "yishchatu" — rabbim, utelao beola, lehavi olat tzibbur latztzafon:
Vayrappu. kemo "vayrappeu" (yirmeya 6:14):
targum: Veasiu yat tevar kenishta deami vemile shikrehon lememar shelama shelama velet shelam:

rashi: Yom hashekem veshaloach. midde yom beyom hashekem veshaloach:
targum: Lemin yoma dinfaku avahatchon meara demitzrayim ad yoma haden ushelachet levatchon yat kol avaday neviyaya yom makdim umeshalach:

rashi: Beyom hotzii otam. techillat tenay lo hayta ella "im shamoa tishmeu bekoli ushemartem et beriti vihyitem li segulla" (Shemot 19:5).
targum: Are la mallit im avahatchon vela pakedtinun beyoma deafket yathon meara demitzrayim al iske alvan venichsat kudeshin:

rashi: Hovishu. boshet uchelimma tavo lahem:
Gam bosh lo yevoshu. enam mitbayyeshim bemaasehem haraim, latet lev lashuv:
targum: Alehon lemivhat are toeva avadu af mivhat let inun bahatin veitkenau let inun yadin bechen yitremon ketilin beidan deasar alehon chovehon yitkelun amar Adonai:

rashi: Al titav lematammotav. ella perosh mimmennu velech lifne rav hagun, velo tevayyeshehu bishelot, achar shello yeda lehashiv:
targum: La titrageg levishuloy vehinun mechuleta dechadavuta:

rashi: Kol asher yigga bivsarah. kol devar ochel asher yigga veyivla mimmenna:
Yikdash. lihyot kamoha — im pesula tippasel, veim hi keshera, teachel kachomer shebbah:
Vaasher yizze middamah al habbeged. veim huzza middamah al habbeged, oto mekom haddam shebbabbeged asher yizze ale, techabbes betoch haazara:
Asher yizze. yehe nizze, kemo velo yitte laaretz minlam (Iyov 15) — yehe natuy:
Hammakriv et dam hashshelamim vegomer. mi shehu rauy lizrikato ulehaktir chalavav, yatza tame bishat zerikat damim o bishat hekter chalavim sheeno cholek babbasar (sifra):
Ki naim. yehi lecha leachar zeman im tishmerem vetitzpenem bevitnecha, shello tishkachem. veematay yihyu shemurim belibbecha? bizman sheyyikkonu al sefatecha. kaasher totziem beficha (eruvin ned.):
targum: Metul devasimin netar inun bichresach venittaknun ech chada al sifvatach:

rashi: Velammilluim. leyom chinnuch hakkehunna:
ohc: Zot hattora laola. lo noda kavvanat pasuk ze. uvetorat kohanim darshu lomar lecha, ma milluim neemru kelalotehen vedikdukehen missinay, af kol neemru vechulei. uchevar katavti bimkomot acherim (resh parashat mishpatim) ma sheyyesh lehair bedavar ze. od darshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim; zevachim 97:) lelammed al hazzevachim kullan shetteunin sakkin keola, ulelammed al shalme tzibbur shenneechalin lezichre kehunna kemincha vechulei. uvederech remez nire al derech amram bimnachot (menachot 110.): amar resh lakish, may dichtiv "zot hattora" vegomer, kol haosek betorat ola keillu hikriv vechulei ad kan, gam anu nomar bederech ze.

Vekodem akdim divre razal, anshe emet shonim besh nehorim, asher amru ki tachlit esek hattora hu levarer nitzotze hakkedushsha asher naflu vaasher neensu mehakkedushsha ulehachaziram beyichud shalem lichmot shehayu, vehem shene bechinot: haechad nitzotze hakkedushsha sheyyardu beolam hattohu lesibba yedua lo, vehammussag leyode daat yaspik letaam nachon, vehashsheni hem nefashot haashukot asher ashak adam beliyyaal meadam harishon becheto asher shalal shalal rav, kayyadua hafelagat hanneshamot asher hirba laashok, veen lecha davar sheppoked alav lehotzi balo mippiv zulat emtzaut esek hattora yaase kol davar ikkar, yaale nitzotze hakkedushsha shennaflu kodem olam hattikkun, veyotzi misml balo mippiv, umefotztzo umamche kocho ad asher yaki chayil bala, vehu maamaram zichrono livracha (kiddushin 30:): im paga vechulei im even hu nimmoach veim barzel mitpotzetz.

Uvefasuk ze gilla hakkatuv pile hattora vetaatzumeha, veamar zot hattora toaloteha asher tesovev keriatah, laola perush shebbeemtzautah titalle hashshechina shehi bechinat keneset yisrael, 2 lammincha teva zo sovelet kamma perushim vechullan tzodkin: leshon menucha uleshon nachat, uleshon hanacha, veze happerush hu sod (chullin tze:) alay yanniach tzaddik ze et rosho, vehu sod (Bereshit Rabba 90) baa shabbat baa menucha ki yanniach aleha tzaddik yesod olam, vehu sod (Shir HaShirim 2:6) "semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni", vehaven:

Lachattat velaasham. hem shene bechinot habberurin: haechad, chelke hakkedushsha sheyyardu lematta mimmadregatam bitchilla beolam hattohu, kenegdam amar "lachattat". vehashsheniyya, chelke hanneshamot shenneeshku meadam becheto, kenegdam amar laasham, ki hattora toil lishne bechinot ellu levarram mimmekom yeridatam. velo berur levad ella gam yechonnem bammakom shennechseru mimmennu, vehu amro velammilluim – lemalleotam bimkomam. ze keneged nitzotzot sheyyardu. ucheneged chelke neshamot sheanas 131 meadam harishon amar ulezevach hashshelamim, al derech amro (tehillim 50:23) "zoveach toda yechabbedanni", vedarshu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin mag:) ze hazzoveach yitzro. vehazzevicha hu sheyyenatztzechehu, uvivchinat hannitztzachon hu borer mimmennu bechinat hattov asher anas meadam harishon. vehinne bechina zo hi maala gedola asher yitatztzem lizboach yitzro, kemaase david sheamar (tehillim 109:22) "velibbi chalal bekirbi", vedavar ze ose peulla gedola babbechina sheanu mishtaddelim aleha, veen metziut lehassaga zo zulat beemtzaut hattora, keamram (kiddushin 30:): im paga becha menuvval ze mashchehu levet hammidrash, vechen amru (sham): amar hakkadosh baruch hu: barati lachem yetzer hara, barati lo tavlin, shehi hattora.

Od yirmoz beamro ulezevach hashshelamim ki tachlit habberur yihye beemtzaut hazzevach, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 34:6): "ki zevach laAdonai bevatzra", veamru zichronam livracha atid hakkadosh baruch hu lishchot et hassatan, uferush shechita zo hi sheyyasir mimmennu bechina hamechayyehu shehu nitzotz hakkedushsha, uvaze hashshelamim nishlemu kol habberurim. vehodia hakkatuv ki gam haddavar hazze yussag beemtzaut esek hattora, ki bizchut esek hattora sheoskim hatztzaddikim baolam hazze yihye haddavar. velaze ramzu zichronam livracha (socha nov) bedivrehem ki hashshechita hallaz tihye al ze hadderech: hakkadosh baruch hu mitztzad echad vechol hatztzaddikim tofsin hassakkin mitztzad acher lizboach zevach hahu, ki bechocham haya hammussag. ha lamadta "zot hattora" lechol haddevarim hanniflaim. laola lammincha keneged haalaat hashshechina veyichudah im hakkadosh baruch hu, lachattat velaasham levarer shete bechinot habberurim shehem ikkar haolam, velammilluim ulezevach hashshelamim leyached nitzotzot hayyordot lemalleotam bimkomam, velizboach yitzro zevicha sheen achareha kiyyum, gam yoomad chay lifne Adonai lishloach yad bimvakshe raato lizboach zevach, "vehaya Adonai lemelech vegomer yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad", vehu amro "hashshelamim", perush, shennishlemu kol bechinot hakkedushsha venityachadu yachad.

Veamro asher tzivva Adonai vegomer, chozer lassibba shehi hattora shehizkir berosh happasuk, keillu amar "zot hattora asher tzivva Adonai" vegomer, shetztzerichin lilmod hattora al menat ken, lo letachlit acher zulato. veamro beyom tzavvoto, ki davar ze neemar lahem bemaamad har sinay dichtiv "bemidbar sinay". veamar lehakeriv et karbenehem, kan ramaz betosefet beur ma shepperashti, shemmakrivin kol chelke hakkedushsha shehem meyuchasim leyisrael, shehem hem hadderagat hakkedushsha, vechol chelke hakkedushsha lahem yityachasu, uveemtzaut hattora yakrivu et karbenehem veyityachadu kol bechinot hakkedushsha kannizkar lemala.

rashi: Hat aznecha ushema divre chachamim. lilmod tora mechacham kol shehu:
Velibbecha tashit ledati. veim rabbecha rasha, lo tilmod mimmaasav (chagiga 15:):
targum: Beri tzeli adnach ushema mile dechakkime velibbach sim lidiati:

rashi: Achen hinne lashsheker. hinne chachmatchem lashsheker bachem, lerappeotchem al nekalla:
Asa et sheker sofrim. neviachem:
targum: Echden temrun chakkimin anachna veal orayta dayya anachna rechitzin bechen ha leshikra aved safer kulemas dishkar lezayafa:

rashi: Yakriv korbano al zevach. maggid sheen hallechem kadosh kedushshat hagguf — lippasel beyotze utevul yom umillatzet lechullin befidyon — ad sheyyishshachet hazzevach (sifra):

Bamot hattofet. hu hammolech (Melachim 2 23:10), shehaya shel nechoshet, umassikin oto mittachtav veyadav peshutot venissakot, venotnin et hayyeled al yadav vehu nichve venohem, vehakkomrim hayu makkishin betuppim shello yishma haav kol habben veyikkamru rachamav (Bereshit 43:30). tofet al shem hattof:
Hinnom. al shem nahamat habben (tanchuma Buber, vaetchannan havesapeh 2):

Lo tzivviti. bemitzvot sheyyakrivu benehem lekarban, velo dibbarti leechad min hanneviim. uchesheddibbarti leavraham lishchot et beno (Bereshit 22:2), lo alta al libbi sheyyishchot, ella lehodia tzidko:
targum: Uveno bamat tofet di vechelat bar hinom leokada yat benehon veyat benatehon benura dela fakdet beorayti vela raava kadmay:

rashi: Hovishu chachamim. kemotchem. umahu habboshet? – hinne vidvar Adonai maasu vechachmat me lahem:
targum: Behitu chakkimaya ittevaru veitachidu ha befitgama dayya katzu vechulak bechuchemta let lehon:

rashi: Vayyaz mimmennu al hammizbeach. lo yadati hechan nitztavva bahazzaot hallalu:
Chasida. tzigonia belaaz:
Moadeha. et avram el iyye hayyam mippene hatztzinna, veet shuvam:
Shamru. himtinu:
Vetor vesis veagur. "veshafnina vechurechya usenunita" (targum yonatan). kurechya – gerua belaaz, senunit – arunedila belaaz:
targum: Af chivarita bishmaya yada zimnaha veshafnina vechurechaya usenunita natrin yat idan meyaolhon veami la havo yadin lemebad yat keyama dayay:

rashi: Kach et aharon. parasha zo neemra shivat yamim kodem hakamat hammishkan, sheen mukdam umeuchar battora:
Kach et aharon. kachennu vidvarim umashchehu:
Veet par hachattat vegomer. ellu haamurim beinyan tzavvaat hammilluim bivatta tetzavve, veachshav beyom rishon lammilluim chazar vezerzo vishat maashe:
ohc: Kach et aharon vegomer. parasha zo neemra kodem hakamat hammishkan, vetaam shenneemra kan, lomar lecha shekkadmu kol mishpete hakkarbanot uferatehen vedikdukehen kodem milluav, ki laasot kullan nitkahanu hu uvanav, velo nitkahen ad shellimmedo moshe kol perate dine kol hakkarbanot vekiyyem vekibbel alav laasot kechol hakkatuv, veaz amar lo "kach et aharon" sheal menat ken nitkahen, veod shezzulat ze mashkachat sheyyavi adam miyyisrael karban miyyad bekarvato lifne Adonai velo yeda ma laasot.

rashi: Tzivva Adonai laasot. kol shivat hayyamim; verabbotenu darshu, laasot — ze maase fara, lechapper — ze maase yom hakkippurim, ulelammed shekkohen gadol taun perisha kodem yom hakkippurim shivat yamim, vechen hakkohen hassoref et happara (sifra):

Ze korban aharon uvanav. af hahedyotot makrivin asirit haefa bayyom shehen mitchannechin laavoda, aval kohen gadol bechol yom, shenneemar mincha tamid vegomer vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav vegomer chak olam:
El hammilluim. el hashshelamim, shemmilluim leshon shelamim, shemmemallein umashlimin et hakkohanim bichhunnatam:

Veim heachol yeachel vegomer. bimchashshev bashshechita leachlo bashshelishi hakkatuv medabber; yachol im achal mimmennu bashshelishi yippasel lemafrea, talmud lomar hammakriv oto lo yechashev — bishat hakerava hu nifsal veeno nifsal bashshelishi; vechen perusho: bishat hakeravato lo taale zot bemachashava, veim chishshev piggul yihye (zevachim 29):
Vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu. afillu betoch hazzeman avonah tissa:

Asham hu. ad sheyyinnatek shemo mimmennu, limmed al asham shemmetu bealav o shennitkapperu bealav, aappi sheomed lihyot damav ole lekayitz hammizbeach, im shechato setam, eno kasher leola kodem shennittak liriyya; veeno ba lelammed al haasham sheyyehe pasul shello lishmo — kemo sheddarshu hu hakkatuv bachattat — lefi sheasham lo neemar bo asham hu ella leachar haketarat emurin, vehu atzmo shello hukteru emurav kasher (zevachim Adonai):
ohc: Asham hu. nechleku rabbanan verabbi eliezer (torat kohanim kan), rabbanan amru "hu" lemaet im lo shechato batztzafon leikkuva, rabbi eliezer omer lemaet im shechato shello lishmo. vehinne lisvarat rabbi eliezer yeduyyak "asham hu" shechozer "hu" laasham shetztzarich sheyyihye leshem asham. vahagam shebbizvachim (zevachim 10.) matzinu shehiksha rabbi yehoshua lerabbi eliezer vechazar rabbi eliezer velamad din ze deshello lishmo mippasuk (Vayikra 7:7) "kachattat kaasham" shehishva otam hakkatuv, im ken tevat "hu" lema tzericha? veulay ki zulat "hu" hayiti omer shehahekkesh ba leinyan shetztzarich semicha, kemo sheddarshu chachamim (zevachim 11.), laze amar "hu" samuch leasham lomar shetztzarich leshem asham. uletzad shennakshe ma shehiksha sham, amar "kachattat kaasham". ulerabbanan "hu" lemaet shechita shello batztzafon shehuzekra bapparasha (pasuk 2) uva leakkev. vahagam sheyyesh lehakeshot meen kushyot shehiksha rabbi yehoshua lerabbi eliezer gam ledivre chachamim, kevan shello chiddeshu din zar mehassechel bidrashatam ella davar sheyyeshno bechol hakkarbanot, vegam huzekar beferush, ella shemippasuk echad hayiti omer sheeno meakkev, yecholin lidrosh "hu" shebba leikkuva, ma sheen ken rabbi eliezer sheholid din chadash sheen lo dimyon, laze hukesha kol hakkushyot harshumot sham.

rashi: Hakehel el petach ohel moed. ze echad min hammekomot shehechezik muat et hamerubbe (Vayikra Rabba 10):
Amar atzel ari vachutz. ech etze lilmod tora?
targum: Amar atla bachachinnuteh arya it levara uvenat shevake mitketelna:

rashi: Hamechatte otah. haoved avodoteha — shehi naaset chattat al yado:

Hamechatte otah yochlenna. harauy laavoda; yatza tame bishat zerikat damim, sheeno cholek babbasar; vei efshar lomar sheoser shear kohanim baachilatah chutz min hazzorek damah, shehare neemar lematta kol zachar bakkohanim yochal otah (zevachim 99):
Lakkohen hammakriv otah vegomer. yachol lo levaddo, tal lechol bene aharon tihye, yachol lechullan, tal lakkohen hammakriv, ha ketzad? levet av shel yom shemmakrivin otah (sham):
ohc: Vechol mincha vegomer. amar hakkatuv zichron chamesh menachot lemaet chamishsha devarim: 1, shello yachleku bene aharon, perush bet av, zevachim keneged menachot, ella kol echad yittol chelko bammincha. 2, shello yachleku ofot keneged menachot, hagam sheyyeshnam behashevaa beinyan echad, shemmatzinu shehaof ba bedallut vehammincha kama tachtehem bedalle dallut. 3, shello yachleku ofot keneged zevachim, hagam sheshshenehem mine damim. 4, shello yachleku menachot keneged menachot, hagam shehem mine kemachim. Adonai, shello yachleku afillu machavat keneged machavat umarcheshet keneged marcheshet, hagam shemmaasehem shavim.

Vahagam shehammiutim hem menachot, derashum beim eno inyan". ella sheraiti larambam (hilchot maase karbenot perek 10 halacha 15) shekkatav beofen acher, ki mimma shechillek hakkatuv ben menachot haafuyot uminchat hassolet, shehare baafuyot hu omer "kol hammincha lakkohen hammakriv" vegomer, uveminchat solet hu omer "vechol mincha lechol bene aharon" vegomer, lomar lecha sheafillu minchat solet shehaya ole al haddaat sheyyechallekuha mincha keneged mincha, letzad sheim yechallekuha benehem maggia laze melo kappo vechulei sheeno rauy lo lalush velo leefot, af al pi chen lechol bene aharon yechallekuha bifne atzmah. mikkan amru chachamim en cholkin mincha keneged mincha, ad kan. nimtzeta omer lidvarav shehallimmud hu meamro "lechol bene aharon" beminchat solet, mizze anu lomdim lechol hammenachot, umin habbarayta eno nishma ken.

Veod dikdek harambam bilshono shehallimmud hu mimma shechillekam hakkatuv, mashma sheim lo chillekam lo hayinu shomim ze, vedla kehabbarayta. veulay ki sover rambam ki mimma shechillek hakkatuv ben menachot haafuyot vechulei, baze gilla lanu hakkatuv kavvanato shebba lomar shello yachleku benehem achat keneged achat afillu beminchat solet, umizze lamdu lechol hammenachot, ki bemarcheshet umachavat lo huzkar bah chilluk lakkol ella shello yitteluha zulat bet av shel oto yom, uminnayin atta omer shello yittelu machavat keneged marcheshet im lo huzkar bah seder chalukkatah im lechullam yachad im leechad mehem. uma shellamdu kol hachamishsha peratim mechamishsha miutim asmachta hi, uleolam ikkar limmudam hu mimma shechillek hakkatuv.

Umeatta tzarich ladaat lamma perat hakkatuv kol hammenachot, kevan shellimmudenu hu mimma shechillek, lo haya lo lomar ella "kol mincha lakkohen hammakriv" vegomer vechol mincha chareva lechol bene" vegomer? veulay sheachar sheyyarad hakkatuv lefaret maafe vachareva, chash sheyyite adam lechallek benehem leven shear menachot. gam matzinu sheddarshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim; menachot 63.) "vechol naasa vammarcheshet veal machavat" – sheal shem kelehen nikreu, venafka minnah haomer "hare alay marcheshet" – keli sharet nadar. vehu davar shennechleku bo (menachot 63.) bet shammay uvet hillel. laze amar hakkatuv vechol naasa vammarcheshet veal machavat legallot lecha sheal shem kelehen nikreu. veamro asher teafe battannur darash gam ken rabbi yose berabbi yehuda shebbaa lilmod al atzmo mehassemichut shel "kol naasa vammarcheshet veal machavat" – ma marcheshet umachavat hem shenayim, gam maafe tannur hem shenayim, velo yavi mechtza challot umechtza rekikin. vegam lelammed al marcheshet umachavat ba lomar: ma tannur keli, gam machavat umarcheshet keli, kaamur sham betorat kohanim. venishar omer "kol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva" – lamma hutzrach lomar shenayim?

Venire ki kavvanat rabbi yose berabbi yehuda shellamad kol minchat maafe shehu shene mine menachot, lo lemadah ella mimma sheamar hakkatuv shete peamim "kol" achare chen, vehem shenayim shenayim, velaze diyyek bilshono: talmud lomar "vechol mincha" "vechol naasa" vegomer "vechol mincha belula" vegomer, ma kol vechol haamurim lematta shene minim vechulei. velaze im haya omer hakkatuv "vechol mincha velula" levad o "kol mincha chareva" levad, en makom lilmod, veyesh levaal haddin lachlok velomar: "kol mincha chareva" tochiach, sheamar "kol" veen bah ella min echad, af kol maafe tannur min echad. laze hutzrach lomar "kol" haamur bakkatuv.

rashi: Ki Adonai yariv rivam vekava. veyigzol et hannefesh:
Kovehem. gozlehem. uvilshon arammi kevia – gezela bemassechet rosh hashshana (rosh hashshana 26,1-2): ata hahu gavra lekammeh amar leh: kabbean pelanya vechulei:
targum: Metul delaha daen dinhon umitpera pureanutehon denafshehon:

rashi: Ohev tehor lev chen sefatav. mi shessefatav chen:
Reehu melech. hakkadosh baruch hu ohavo umechabbevo (Bereshit Rabba 41, 5):
targum: Rachem elaha deche libba uvechisda desifvateh yitchabber lemalka:

rashi: Hammashiach tachtav mibbanav. hammashiach mibbanav tachtav:
Kalil toktar. en nikmetzet lihyot sheyareha neechalin ella kullah kalil, vechen kol minchat kohen shel nedava kalil tihye:
ohc: Vehakkohen vegomer. tachtav mibbanav – beferek hattechelet (menachot na.) darshu shebba lechohen gadol shemmet vaadayin lo minnu acher tachtav shebbeno shel met yevienna bimkomo, vehu amro tachtav mibbanav. vedarshu mem shel mibbanav lidrasha acheret, detanya sham: "banav" – ellu kohanim hedyotim, o eno ella kohanim gedolim? keshehu omer "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav" – hare kohen gadol amur, ma ani mekayyem "banav"? behedyotim. umassik sham baggemara demeamro "mibbanav" doresh ken.

Uvehorayot perek 3 (horayot 11.) amru od: kohen gadol ben kohen gadol taun meshicha menalan? dichtiv "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav", nema kera "vehakkohen mittachtav mibbanav", may "hammashiach" vechulei, ad kan. vekashe, vahalo tzarich lomar "hammashiach" lelammed al banav haamurim battechilla shehem hedyotot kemaamar hattanna beferek hattechelet. veyesh lomar shellelammed al banav haamurim battechilla shehem hedyotot shappir nishma, hagam shello haya omer "hammashiach", ki shene ketuvim bechohen echad lamma li? ella vadday shebbanav" deresha behedyotim, "banav" desefa bigdolim, velo haya tzarich lomar "hammashiach" ella lidrasha limshoach kohen gadol ben kohen gadol.

Vaadayin kashe bakkatuv lamma amar tachtav mibbanav shehaya tzarich lomar "mibbanav tachtav". veulay sheyyechavven lehasemich banav leyaase otah" lechavven derashat perek hattechelet (menachot 27:) sheim met kohen gadol vaadayin lo minnu acher bimkomo – beno yavi bimkomo. veze shiur hakkatuv: "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav yaase", veim adayin lo nitmanna – mibbanav shel met yaase otah. veim haya omer hakkatuv "hakkohen hammashiach mibbanav tachtav", az tihye hakkavvana sheen chiyyuv al beno lehavi ella im yihye tachtav, shekken mashma davka tachtav, perush shennitmanna o shehu rauy laamod tachtav. umeamro "mibbanav yaase" mashma kol yoresh yavi. ulerabbi shimon shecholek vesover sheim lo minnu acher tachtav baa mishshel tzibbur, amar "tachtav mibbanav" lismoch "mibbanav" leyaase", lomar ki en rauy leshum adam acher likkanes tachat hakkohen zulat beno. achar shepperashti ze matzati shekken derashuha betorat kohanim lemevin mashmaut habbaraytot al nachon.

rashi: Olotechem. sheattem makrivim kalil (Vayikra 1:8-9), tov lachem shettosifu otam al shalmechem vetakrivu otam shelamim vetochlu habbasar, shehare enam mekubbalot lefanay, velamma tafsidum?
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai tzevaot elaha deyisrael alavatchon osifu al nichsat kudeshechon vaachulu visra:

rashi: Vayyachavosh. leshon keshira:
Halo chatavti lecha shalishim. tora uneviim uchetuvim:
targum: Veha kitvet inun lach al telata zimnin beetzta vidiata:

rashi: Gazzi nizrech. talshi searech; kemo "vayyagaz salvim" (Bamidbar 11:31); "vayyagaz et rosho" (Iyov 1:20). lashon acher: nizrech kitrech, leshon gedulla; vechen tirgem yonatan: "ravrevich", vechen chibbero menachem:
Vayyittosh. vayyaazov:
targum: Telishi al ravrevayich deyiglun vetuli al nagrin ilya are rachek Adonai veratesh yat dara daavaru al memreh:

rashi: Yishshaver. lefi shehabbelia shennivlaat bo naase notar, vehu haddin lechol hakkodashim:
Umorak. leshon tamruke hannashim (Ester 2), ashekaveramenat belaaz:
Umorak veshuttaf. liflot et beliato, aval keli cheres limmedcha hakkatuv kan sheeno yotze mide dafyo leolam (avoda zara 34):
Oshek dal leharebot lo. osher:
Noten leashir. sof shennoten mamono leovde gillulim haashirim, vach lemachsor hu ba:
targum: Deashek lemiskena masge leh bishta udeyahev leattira chuserana hu leh:

rashi: Al titra. al titchabber, leshon reut:
targum: La titchabber im mare meriruta veim gavra chemtana la teol:

rashi: Middo vad. hi hakkuttonet, uma tal middo? shettehe kemiddato (sham):
Al besaro. shello yehe davar chotzetz bentayim (zevachim 19):
Veherim et haddeshen. haya chote melo machta min hameukkalot happenimiyyot venotnan bemizracho shel kevesh (tamid 28):
Haddeshen asher tochal haesh et haola. vaasaatta deshen, meoto deshen yarim teruma vesamo etzel hammizbeach:
[Al hammizbeach. matza evarim sheadayin lo nitakkelu, machaziran al mizbeach leachar shechata gechalim elach vaelach venatal min happenimiyyot, shenneemar et haola al hammizbeach]:
Garesh letz. yetzer hara:
targum: Tarech limmikna veappek letigrana veyivtal deyana vetziara:

rashi: Bechol moshvotechem. lefi shehi chovat hagguf veenah chovat karka noheget bechol moshavot, uvemassechet kiddushin beferek 1 meforash lamma hutzrach lomar:
Laof velabbehema. perat ledam dagim vachagavim (keritut 20):
Vayyakter hammizbecha. moshe shimmesh kol shivat yeme hammilluim bechaluk lavan (avoda zara 34):
Al haola. achar haola, velo matzinu shok shel shelamim karev bechol makom chutz mizze:
ohc: Al haola. shello haya davar mafsik. veulay shello shaha ad sheachla haesh et haola, ella vaadayin haola kayyemet.

rashi: Vesamta sakkin beloecha. bilchayecha; im raita eno tzara, al tochal mishshello:

Im baal nefesh atta. im raavtan atta vetaev leechol, tov litchov sakkin ben shinnecha. verabbotenu darshu (chullin 6.) betalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo; im yodea berabbo sheyyachazir lo teshuva al kol davar sheyyishalehu, yedakdek veyishal shemuato, veim lav – yishtok:
targum: Utesim sakkina veloach in mara denafshach at:

rashi: Uvesar zevach todat shelamav. yesh kan ribbuyin harebe, lerabbot chattat veasham veel nazir vachagigat arbaa asar sheyyihyu neechalin leyom velayla (sifra):
Beyom korbano yeachel. vechizman besarah zeman lachmah:
Lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker. aval ochel hu kol hallayla, im ken lamma amru ad chatzot? kede leharechik adam min haavera (sham):
Esh tamid. esh shenneemar bo tamid, hi shemmadlikin bah et hannerot shenneemar ba lehaalot ner tamid (Shemot 27), af hi meal mizbeach hachitzon tukad (yoma 45):
Lo tichbe. hamechabbe esh al hammizbeach over bishne lavin:
Vayyitzok, vayyimshach. battechilla yotzek al rosho veachar kach noten ben rise enav umoshech beetzbao mizze laze (horayot 12):

Vetumato alav. betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber, aval tahor sheachal et hattame eno anush karet ella azharat vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame vegomer; veazharat tame sheachal et hattahor enah meforeshet battora, ella chachamim lemaduha bigzera shava; shalosh karetot amurot beochle kadashim betumat hagguf, uderashum rabbotenu bishvuot achat lichlal, veachat lifrat, veachat lelammed al karban ole veyored shello neemar ella al tumat mikdash vekadashav:
ohc: Vehannefesh asher vegomer vetumato vegomer. pasuk ze veshelleacharav betumat hagguf pershuhu betorat kohanim uvizvachim (zevachim mag.) amru: kol kera shello persho rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi vechulei la mefarsha. hachi amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: hoil ufatach hakkatuv bilshon nekeva vesiyyem bilshon nekeva uleshon zachar baemtza, betumat hagguf hakkatuv medabber, ad kan. uferesh Rashi: hoil vechulei – perush pasuk "nefesh ki tigga" shehu pasuk sheni, vesham behechreach lomar sheal tumat hagguf hu omer, hagam sheshshinna baemtza. gam befasuk rishon "vehannefesh" al titma alav sheddibber techilla leshon nekeva "vehannefesh" ulevassof "venichreta", uvaemtza "vetumato" – sheen hakkavvana al habbasar ella al hagguf, ad kan. devarav zichrono livracha hoilu shello lehacheriach mimma sheshshinna baemtza lomar shennitkavven lomar shebbetumat basar hu omer, aval lehacheriach sheal tumat hagguf hu omer hu mimmashmaut hakkatuv, shennire shekkevar nigmeru hilchot tumat basar, kemo shepperesh Rashi sham bizvachim.

Veod betorat kohanim lamdu gezera shava "tumato" "tumato" haamura beviat mikdash (Bamidbar 19:13). ella natatti libbi lamma shinna hakkatuv bishne pesukim ellu, befasuk echad shinna lichtov "vetumato" vesamach lilmod bigzera shava, vehaya lo lichtov "vetumatah" velo hayinu tzerichin ligzera shava, gam befasuk sheni lamma lo amar lashon yashar kol hakkatuv beseder echad.

Venire ki taam amro vetumato alav ba lehair inyan acher, shehagam sheavru shivat yeme tuma letumat met o heerev shemesh letumat sheretz, kol od shello taval hare hu betumato. veyesh lecha ladaat ki tuma zo enah bifnimiyyut hannefesh ella masve hattuma hammesakkech al hagguf mibbachutz velo bifnim, uletzad ze hu shemmoil lo tevila lehasir mesukkat hattuma, ma shello yoil lo bemeshech yeme hattuma shehattuma gam bifnim. veze shiur hakkatuv nefesh asher tochal vegomer vetumato alav, perush, lo mibbaya vetumatah aleha shehu bemeshech shiva letumat met uvemeshech yom maggao letumat sheretz, ella afillu tumato shel guf levad, hayenu sheavar alav shiva yeme tuma veeno chaser ella tevila lehaavir meal gufo, afillu hache venichreta.

Vetaam amro befasuk sheni leshon zachar baemtza, hagam sheen taut baddavar lo haya lo lomar ella seder echad bechol hakkatuv. venire ki taam amro venefesh ki tigga leshon nekeva velo amar "ish ki yigga" leshon zachar, shennitkavven lomar shetztzarich sheyyigga ledato velo behelem, sheeno chayyav karet ella bidiat tuma. vegam amro befasuk echad "vehannefesh asher tochal" shehayta achilat basar bidia, ki hannefesh yore el hahergesh velimniat hahelemot. uletaam ze timtza sheamar befarashat hashshegagot (Vayikra 4-5) "venefesh", lomar, taam hamechayyev chattat veasham al hashshogeg hu letzad heyotah nefesh, shehi bechinat haheara vehayyedia ushegaga, laze titchayyev karban. uleolam shem nefesh yore al bechinat shelilat hahitallemut, velaze amar bishne ketuvim "nefesh ki tigga" – hare yediat hannegia, "vehannefesh asher tochal" – hare yediat hammaachol. umeatta en makom lekushya lamma amar leshon zachar baemtza, sheen tzorech leshannot seder haragil lomar al haose leshon zachar. vetaam amro "venichreta hannefesh hahi", ba gam ken lehashemienu chiddush, sheggam nefesh hachotet tamut velo guf levad.

Vechutz middarkam zichrono livracha nire leyashshev kefel hakketuvim al derech ma sheamru bizvachim daf 106 bammishna: hattame sheachal ben kodesh tame ben kodesh tahor chayyav, verabbi yose haggelili omer tame sheachal tame patur, veamru baggemara (zevachim kach.) kol hechi denitma hagguf veachar kach nitma habbasar, dechule alma la peligi dechayyav. velaze amar shene ketuvim: haechad "asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim" – ze tame haochel besar shelamim tahor, vehashsheni amar "veachal mibbesar zevach" vegomer – ze keneged tame haochel mibbesar shelamim shennitma. veulay ki laze dikdek hakkatuv lomar befasuk echad tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim, pasuk habbasar hu mizzevach hashshelamim shehu adayin bemadregato shello nitma, vehashsheni amar mibbesar zevach hashshelamim perush, mimmin besar shelamim hagam sheachshav eno besar shelamim shebba bo yiud haachila, vehu amro mibbasar sheshshem zevach shelamim alav, ki lo kashar habbasar im zichron zevach hashshelamim lirmoz ki eno begeder setam zevach shelamim hattahor, vedok velo yifne levavcha litot achar hammem beofen acher.

rashi: Shok. min happerek shel arkubba hannimkeret im harosh ad happerek haemtzai shehu sovech shel regel (chullin 134):
Bemakom kadosh. veezehu? bachatzar ohel moed:
Vehiktir hakkohen et hachelev. veachakka vehaya hechaze leaharon, limmedanu sheen habbasar neechol beod shehaemurim lematta min hammizbeach (sifra):
Veen macharid. et haofot meal happegarim:
targum: Utehe nevelta deama haden meshagra lemechal leofa dishmaya velivira deara velet demanid:

rashi: Vechallat lechem shemen. hi revucha shehaya marbe bah shemen keneged hachallot veharkikin, kach meforash bimnachot (daf 89):
Tora achat lahem. bedavar ze:
Hakkohen asher yechapper bo. harauy lechappara cholek bo, perat litvul yom umechussar kippurim veonen (sifra):
Hayippelu velo yakumu. hatov lahem sheyyappilu et atzmam linfila sheen lahem tekuma:

Im yashuv velo yashuv. lichsheyyirtzu lashuv meraatam, lo yashuv hakkadosh baruch hu miggezerato (sefer Bamidbar 42). davar acher: af im yashuvu bitshuva, lo titkayyem beyadam, ki yemaharu lashuv lerishatam (sefer Bamidbar 42); vechen tirgem yonatan: "im lemetav, gele kodamay dela yetuvun":
targum: Vetemar lehon kidnan amar Adonai hayippelun vela yekumon im lemetav gele kadamay dela yetuvun:

rashi: Kol zachar bakkohanim yochal otah. ha lamadta shehamechatte otah haamur lemala lo lehotzi shear hakkohanim, ella lehotzi et sheeno rauy lechittuy:
Shucha amukka pi zarot. pi ovde gillulim:
Zeum Adonai. mi shehakkadosh baruch hu sono, nofel venichshal bah:
Zeum. nazuf millefanav:
targum: Gumetza amikta puma denuchereta uman demargez kodam elaha nafel taman:

rashi: Murbechet. chaluta berotchin kol tzarkah (sham):
Tufine. afuya afiyyot harebe — achar chalitatah ofah battannur vechozer umetaggenah bammachavat (menachot 50):
Minchat pittim. melammed shetteuna petita:
Lo chen. lo baddin, kemo "ken benot tzelafchad" (Bamidbar 27:7):
Kullo shav bimrutzatam. badderech harishon chotim, vechozrim vechotim. merutzatam – korshi belaaz:
Shotef. eshperidin belaaz:
targum: Etzetit ugele kadamay la chidchashar memallin let gevar dimtiv min bishteh lememar ma avadet kulehon misgan birut nafshehon kesuseya digzar bikrava:
Vaevatel mikirvaya debet yehuda umishoke yerushelem kal bia vekal chedva kal chatnun vekal kalan are lechureba tehe ara:
La techul im gavra devisha ayneh vela titrageg levishuloy:
Utemalel imhon yat kol pitgamaya hailen vela yekabbelun minach vetitnabbe lehon vela yetivunach:
Are avadu vene yehuda devish kodamay amar Adonai shaviu shikutzehon beveta deitkere shemi alohi lesaavuteh:
Aynoy delaha natran yediata umetaltel milehon devazoze:
Vela kabbilu lememri vela archinu yat udenehon vekashiu yat kedalhon avishu meavahathon:
Shatyuta ketira belibbeh detalya shivta demarduta nirchakeh mineh:
Bechen ha yomaya atan amar Adonai vela yitamar od tofet vechelat bar hinom elahen chelat ketilaya vikabberun betofet mibbeli atar:
Vetemar lehon den ama di la shemau lememra dayya elahahon vela kabbilu ulefan piskat hemanuta veitmanaat mippumehon:
Elahen yat pitgama haden pakdet yathon lememar kabbilu lememri veeheve lechon leelaha veattun tehon kodamay leam utehachun bechol orcha daafaked yatchon bedil deyitav lechon:
Beidana hahi amar Adonai yifkun yat garme malchaya devet yehuda veyat garme ravrevehon veyat garme chahanaya veyat garme neviye shikra veyat garme yatve yerushelem mikivrehon:
Bechen etten yat neshehon leocharanin chaklathon lirutin are min zeera vead rabba kulehon anse mamon misafer vead kahen kulehon avde shekar:

bart: Haggozalot sheal gabbe hassallim. shehayu tolim meachore hassallim shel bikkurim torim uvene yonim, velo al gabbe hassallim mammash, shello yetannefum. vehen kerevin olot:
Uma shebbeyadam. rambam peresh haggozalot sheheviu veyadam, shello telaum achore hassallim. veli nire uma shebbeyadam, habbikkurim sheheviu veyadam:
Shelosha al shelosha shennikra. velo nechleku hakkeraim zo mizzo:
Uvesaro nogea bakkisse. im hakkera kol kach gadol ad shekkeshemmesimim habbeged al hakkisse veyeshev alav besaro nogea bakkisse:
Tahor. devatal leh mittorat beged:
Veim lav. sheen hakkera kol kach sheyyigga besaro vakkisse, lo vatal mittorat beged, vetame:

Shennimha mimmennu. shebbala mimmennu. vedugmato mehuha shettelayah al gabbe veria ditnan leel besof perek shelosha terisin. ucheshebbala chut echad mibbeged shalosh al shalosh metzumtzamot, nitmaet shiuro vetahor:

O shene chutin matimin. pershu rabbotay, dematimin kae nammi akkesher. vehachi katane, nimtzeu vah shene kesharim matimin o shene chutim matimin. mishshum deim shene chutim keshurim ze etzel ze beveged en derech lehannicham, vehachi amrinan baggemara perek kelal gadol [shabbat daf ad] i mitreme tere kitre vahade hadade share chad vekatar chad. ushene chutim hammatimin, shedderech haariga shehaerev nichnas letoch hashsheti en shene chutim nichnasim beseder echad ella vemakom shezze nichnas ze yotze, uchesheshshenehem shavin nechshav haechad kemi sheeno:
Hechezirah. labbayit:
Temea. deha hadar achsheva:
Leolam hashelachatah metaharattah. kelomar ki hay gavna mittama umittaheret afillu eser peamim bayyom:
Argaman uzehorit tova. chashive velo mevattela lehu [mittorat beged]. uzehorit tova hu hammeshi hatztzavua 287 belaaz:
Af matlit chadasha kayyotze vahen. dinah chedin argaman uzehorit tova, velo mevattela la ashpa mittorat beged:
Kullan tehorin. im hushlechu laashpa, afillu argaman uzehorit tova:
Lo huzkeru. argaman uzehorit tova lechalek mishshear begadim:

Ella mippene hashavat aveda. deim metzaam baashpa lo amrinan middaat hishlicham, uvau hacheraza, demippene chashivutayhu lo miyyaashe habbealim. ushear begadim dela chashive, im metzaam baashpa lo vau hacheraza. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Yilke vechaser uveyater. bema shechasar happikkadon, uvema shehotir. kegon shehifkid etzlo rachel teuna tzemer, o meubberet, venigzeza o yalda leachar sheshshalach bah yad, meshallem otah veet gizzoteha veet valdoteha, venimtza shehu loke bema shechasra etzlo. uveyater, sheim nitabbera o taana tzemer keshehi etzlo, meshallem otah teuna umeubberet kemot shehi achshav, vahare loke veyater:
Uvet hillel omrim kishat hotzaa. mibbet habbealim, im teuna teuna, veim rekanit rekanit:

Rabbi akiva omer kishat hattevia. kemo shehu happikkadon bishat haamada vaddin. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) laasher hu lo yittenennu beyom ashmato, yitten kemo shehu beyom ashmato, bayyom shemmitchayyev bo baddin. vahalacha kevet hillel:
Hachoshev lishloach yad befikkadon. amar bifne edim ettol pikdono shel peloni leatzmi:
Bet shammay mechayyevim. dichtiv (Shemot 22) al kol devar pesha, mishshaa sheddibber lishloach yad have foshea:

Ad sheyyishlach bo yad. dichtiv im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu. vehay al kol devar pesha, darshe beh bet hillel, amar leavdo velishlucho lishloach yad bappikkadon minnayin shehu chayyav, talmud lomar al kol devar pesha:
Ketzad, hitta et hechavit. hasheta mefaresh lemilletayhu devet hillel. veit sefarim delo garse chetzad. umilleta beanpeh nafsha hi:
Venishbera. leachar zeman:
Eno meshallem ella reviit. dishlichut yad eno mitchayyev boonasim ad sheyyimshoch o yagbiah dahave keniyya:

Higbihah venatal. lav davka natal, dimchi agbehah al menat littol chayyav beanseha afillu lo natal mimmenna chelum. veim natal reviit min hechavit vehechmitz hayyayin hannishar bechavit achar ken, af al pi shello higbiah hechavit, meshallem kol hayyayin, shehu garam layyayin shehechmitz, vegire dideh hu deahane leh:
Kamma tehe sela chasera. matbea hayyotze vetamid hu shochek vechaser, kamma techsar veim hotziah lo tehe onaa:
Arba issarin. lesela:
Issar ledinar. vehu echad min esrim vearbaa bo. deshesh maa chesef hu dinar, maa shene fundeyonim, pundeyon shene issarin:
Arbaa fundeyonim. echad mishnem asar:
Shemona fundeyonot. shetut. kishar onaa. vechen halacha:
Osrin et haggoren. asur leechol mittevua shebbaggoren ad sheyyafrish terumot umaasrot, aval bikkurim enan osrin:
Veyesh lahen shiur. teruma yesh lah shiur midderabbanan echad mechamishshim, aval bikkurim en lahem shiur afillu midderabbanan:
Venohagim bechol happerot. midderabbanan, uvikkurim enan bain ella mishshivat hamminin:
Bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit. uvikkurim enan ella bifne habbayit bilvad, dichtiv behu (Devarim 26) vehinnicho lifne mizbach Adonai‏ elohecha, im en mizbeach en bikkurim:
Uvaarisut uvachachirut vechulei. meforash leel beresh perek kamma, uvikkurim enan bain ella mimmi shehakkarka shello min haddin dichtiv (Shemot 23) bikkure admatch:
Dam mehalleche shetayim. hayenu dam haadam, kemo dam chalalin:
Lehechsher. lehacheshir et hazzeraim lekabbel tuma kemo dam behema dichtiv beh (Devarim 12) al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim:

Vedam hashsheretz. kelomar veshave dam mehalleche shetayim ledam hashsheretz, sheen chayyavin alav mishshum dam. vedavka keshehitru vo mishshum dam en chayyavin al dam hashsheretz, aval im hitru vo mishshum sheretz loke, sheddam hashsheretz kivsaro hu:
Nimneu millehavi. mippene habbusha sheeno yodea likrot:
Hitkinu sheyyehu makrin. veasmechuha akkera dichtiv (Devarim 26) veanita veamarta, veen aniyya ella mippi acher:

Hatteruma vehabbikkurim chayyavin alehen mita. zar haochlan bemezid chayyav mita bide shamayim, dichtiv batteruma (Vayikra 22) umetu vo ki yechalleluhu, uvikkurim ikkeru teruma, deamar mar uterumat yadecha, ellu bikkurim, shenneemar bahen (Devarim 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha:
Vechomesh. haochlan shogeg meshallem keren labbealim vechomesh lechol kohen sheyyirtze:

Vaasurim lezarim. bechinnam hi shenuya, dechevan shechayyavin alehem mita vechomesh peshita sheasurim lezarim. ulerabbi yochanan deamar chatzi shiur asur min hattora, matzinan lememar ditnan asurim lezarim lachatzi shiur, shehu asur min hattora, veen bo lo mita velo chomesh:
Vehen nichse chohen. sheyyachol lemachran velikkach bahen avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea:
Veolim beechad umea. im nitarvu bemea shel chullin:
Uteunim rechitzat yadayim. habba ligga bahen tzarich littol yadav techilla, shessetam yadayim poslot et hatteruma, uvikkurim nammi ikkeru teruma:
Vehaarev shemesh. tame shettaval eno ochel bitruma ad sheyyaariv shimsho, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkadashim, vehu haddin levikkurim:

Ma sheen ken bammaaser. deshare lezarim, veasur liknot bidme maaser sheni behema temea vaavadim vekarkaot, uvatel berov hecha deen lo mattirin, vehannogea bo en taun rechitzat yadayim, veen tzarich haarev shemesh, deamrinan taval veala ochel bammaaser:

En moshivin chenvani lemachatzit sachar. lo yomar baal habbayit lachenvani hare perot nimkarim bashshuk arba sein besela veatta mochran bachanut peruta peruta umistakker sea, helach perot veshev umechor bachanut veharevach nachlok. vetama demilleta, mishshum dekayma lan hach iska palga milva ufalga fikkadon, setam hammekabbel perakmatya lemachatzit sachar mekabbel alav acharayut chatzi hakkeren boonasim vezola, hilkach hahi falga kevan demichayyav boonasim milva hi etzlo shehare hi shuma etzlo bemaot beshaar hashshuk vedino littol chatzi sachar, nimtza mitassek bechetzyo shel baal habbayit shehu fikkadon etzlo bischar hametanat maot hammalve, lefichach asur. ella im ken noten lo sechar amalo shehu amel beoto hachetzi kefoel batel shel otah melacha devatel minna, im haya naggar o nappach, kamma adam rotze littol libbatel mimmelacha cheveda kazo velaasot melacha kalla:

En moshivin tarnegolim lemechetza. lashum betzim bedamim levaal hattarnegolet lehoshivah alehem legaddel efrochim lemachatzit sachar ma sheyyihyu haefrochim shavim yoter al deme habbetzim, dehoil veze mekabbel alav acharayut chatzi deme habbetzim im yitkalkelu o im yamutu, hava leh palga milva, nimtza ze megaddel et chetzyan hashsheni bischar hametanat meotav:
Umezono. mazon shehu motzi baefrochim:
Veen shamin agalim useyachin lemechetza. achshav hem shavim kach vechach, kabbelem alecha legaddelam shenatayim lemachatzit sachar, ulemachatzit hefsed im yamutu:
Aval mekabbelim agalim useyachim. ketannim, belo shuma, sheim yamutu lo yeshallem kelum, veim yichyu yechalleku benehem:
Sheyyihyu meshullashim. perush kesheyyaamdu al shelish giddulan veaz yachloku:
Vachamor ad shettehe toanet. masseoy. kach haya minhagam legaddelam kodem chaluka:
En mearvin perot beferot. baal habbayit haomer lachavero perot sede feloni ani mocher lecha, lo yearvem beferot sade acher:
Veen tzarich lomar chadashim bishanim. pasak limkor lo yeshanim, lo yearev immahem chadashim. shehayeshanim yeveshim veosim kemach yoter min hachadashim:
Mippene shemmashbicho. kashe mashbiach et harach, lefichach pasak immo rach mearev bo kashe, aval pasak immo kashe lo yearev bo et harach:
En mearvin shimre yayin. shel chavit zo beyayin shel chavit acheret:
Aval noten lo et shemarav. shel yayin atzmo:
Lo yimkerennu vachanut. peruta peruta:
Ella im ken hodio. lechol echad veechad mehen, mayim meoravin bo:
Velo letaggar. lo yimkerennu beyachad veaf al pi shehodio, lefi sheeno lokcho ella lerammot ulemachro bachanut:
Mekom shennahagu lehattil mayim bayyayin. davka ben haggittot yattil. dechevan shennahagu en kan taut, shekkol hayyenot bechezkat ken:

Ketzad mafrishin. shebbikkera. vaafillu lo nigmar happeri, dichtiv (Devarim 26) hinne heveti et reshit peri, bishat havaa hu peri, aval bishat haferasha en tzarich sheyyihye peri, ella afillu boser, vaafillu paggin:
Hare ellu bikkurim. veen tzarich likrot od shem achar lekitatan:

Rabbi shimon omer af al pi chen chozer vekore shem. dedaresh velakachta mereshit kol peri haadama, ma bishat havaa peri, af bishat haferasha peri, devishat keriat shem tzarich sheyyihyu happerot betalush kemo vishat havaa. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Matlit. shehi temea midras, utelaah vakkuppa. vekuppa lav bat midras hi, umihu cheshettelaah vakkuppa nitmet hakkuppa, lefi shennaga vammatlit hattemea midras, vahare hi magga midras. vehammatlit keshennigmera teliyyatah parach minna tumat midras, mishshum devatla legabbe kuppa vekuppa lo chazya lemidras:

Metammea echad ufoselet echad. kedin kelim shennagu vammidras ufarshu, ditnan besof zavim hannogea bemishkav metamme shenayim ufosel echad, perash metamme echad ufosel echad, dechol zeman shehakkeli nogea bammidras chashvinan leh keav hattuma leinyan ochalim laasot rishon vesheni vachullin ushelishi vatteruma, aval keshepperash have leh kivlad hattuma veose sheni vachullin ushelishi vatteruma vilvad, dehaynu metamme echad ufosel echad:

Hifrishah. lammatlit min hakkuppa, have la hakkuppa velad hattuma chemo shehayta kodem shehifrishah, aval hammatlit tehora, demikkevan shettelaah bakkuppa naaset kakkuppa vehaveya la kachatichat dofen shennittela min hakkuppa dithora hachaticha. umihu im achar perishatah min hakkuppa chishshev aleha lishiva, mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba im yesh bah keshiur:
Telaah al habbeged. lo nitbattela mittumat midras, umetamme habbeged shenayim ufosel echad kedin kelim hannogim bammidras kol zeman shello farshu:
Hifrishah min habbeged. din habbeged kechelim shennagu ufarshu, metamme echad ufosel echad, vehammatlit hare hi chemo shehayta, dilolam lo nitbattela, umetammea shenayim ufoselet echad:
Vechen hattole. matlit:
Al hassak o al haor. ketole al habbeged veenah mitbattelet:
Verabbi shimon metaher. kasavar bassak uvaor mitbattelet, hoil velav minah. verabbi yose savar, divsak dearig kemotah, enah mitbattelet. aval beor, delav arig hu, mitbattelet. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Bari vetzorer melach. garsinan. beged hammuttal baashpot batal leh mittorat beged, ella im ken it beh tarte, sheyyehe bari vechazak, verauy litzror bo rova kav melach. aval hannimtza vabbayit, hoil veenah mushlechet baashpa adayin chashuv hu uvechad gereda saggi, o bari af al pi sheeno tzorer melach, o tzorer melach af al pi sheeno bari:
Rabbi yehuda omer bedakka. leolam eno mittamme ad sheyyehe tzorer rova melach dakka:
Vachachamim omrim. eno mittamme ad sheyyehe tzorer begassa:

Ellu vaellu mitkavvenim lehakel. rabbi yehuda savar dakka tzericha litzror beveged bari vechazak tefe, mippene chavdah, shehi cheveda yoter min haggassa, hilkach meshaer ad shettehe machazeket baddakka, lehakel aleha shello tittamme. verabbanan savre gassa tzericha beged yoter bari, mippene chiddudah vekarnoteha boltim, hilkach meshaarim begassa littamme, kede lehakel al habbeged hammachazik melach dakka shello yittamme:

Shavin shelosha al shelosha vaashpa leshalosh al shalosh babbayit. keshem sheshshalosh al shalosh babbayit mittammeot teme met veen mittammeot midras, kach shelosha al shelosha vaashpa mittammeot teme met veen mittammeot midras, devatla chashivutan meachar shehishlichah laashpa. vahalacha kachachamim bilvad:

Nome hassadin. nimin hayyotzim min hassadin, vehen chutim shergilim latzet min haarig ben min hatztzedadim ben millemala ben millematta. im naga sheretz bannimin, nitma hassadin. vehu sheyyigga betoch hashshiur hameforash bematnitin. vechen im naga sheretz bassadin, nitmeu hannimin ad mekom hashshiur hameforash. umishsham velachutz tehorim, sheen hannimin chibbur lechol beged ella ad mekom hashshiur hameforash bahen:
Tartin. kemin kovaim:
Pilyon. sadin shemmitattef bo chullo:
Afkarsin. kemo afkarsuto enah meakkevet deferek veellu megallechim [moed katan 22:], vehu levush hattachton ufatuach mikketefav ucheshellovsho koshro:
Sagos. beged shel tzemer av vechullo tzitziyyot, vekorim lo vaaravi 355:
Redid. tzaif dak shehaishsha mechassa vo roshah. vattechas batztzaif, targum yerushalmi redida:
Gumedin. beged shehu amma al amma, umechassin haarvim chatman ufihem bizman hakkor. uferush gomed amma, kedichtiv (Shoftim 3) velah shene feot gomed arkah:
Kulkin. arig shel sear veyesh lo nimin:
Punda. yesh mefarshim ezor chalul verachav. veyesh mefarshim habbeged hattachton shennotnim al habbasar lishmor shear habbegadim shello yittannefu vazzea:
Maaforet. targum vayyitchappes baafer (Melachim 1 20) veeshtane bemaafara. sudar shemmeattefim bo harosh:
Pargod. masach shettolin al pitche hammelachim:
Kol shehen. ben rav ben meat have chibbur. vechullehu acharine sheshshiuran meforash, keshiur have chibbur, ma sheyyater mikkeshiur lo have chibbur, lo lattuma velo lahazzaa:

Nittelet min hattahor al hattame. deha deen teruma nittelet min hattahor al hattame hayenu taama mishshum devainan mukkaf vechayshinan dilma lo makkif demistefe dilma naga hattahor battame. vehay taama lekka lememar hacha, deha nitremet shello min hammukkaf:
Veyesh lah shiur katteruma. shehatteruma natnu vah chachamim shiur, tere mimmea:
Vechen beged shearag bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot. metzumtzamot, shezze shiuro littamme vechol hattumot kullan chutz mimmidras, uvivtzir mehachi lo mittamme veshum tuma shebbaolam:
Shalosh al shalosh shennitmaet tahor. legamre. delo chazi lemidi lo laaniyyim velo laashirim, hilkach tahor mikkol hattumot:

Hachi garsinan mipperot shebbeharim umittemarot shebbaamakim umizzete shemen meever hayyarden, rabbi yose haggelili omer en meviin bikkurim meever hayyarden sheenah eretz zavat chalav udevash. vehachi perusho, perot shebbeharim hem mutamim yoter mipperot shebbaamakim, hilkach meviim bikkurim mipperot shebbeharim. aval hattemarim hem hefech ze, shehattemarim shebbaamakim hem yoter meleim middevash, vehannirtze mehattemarim hu haddevash shebbahem, shehare hattora kara lattemarim devash, hilkach meviin bikkurim mittemarot shebbaamakim velo mishshel harim.
Umizzete shemen. mizzetim haosim shemen.

Meever hayyarden. mipperot shel ever hayyarden nammi meviim bikkurim, af al pi sheenah eretz zavat chalav udevash, shekkevan shennetanah hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael karena vah peri haadama asher natatta li. ufaleg rabbi yose haggelili veamar en meviin bikkurim meever hayyarden, veen halacha kerabbi yose haggelili:
Aspaklarya. mara shel zechuchit shehaishsha roa vah et paneha. uvelaaz 277. vaafillu yesh lah bet kibbul tehora, lefi sheenah asuya lekabbel ella lirot tzurat happanim:
Tamchuy. kemin keara gedola shel zechuchit:
Tarvad. kaf shel zechuchit:
Veim lav. im keshennotno al hashshulchan o al davar pashut hu mitgalgel lechan ulechan venishpach ma shebbetocho, lefi shettachtav chad veeno omed:
Rabbi akiva metamme. hoil veyesh lo vet kibbul. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Shel tzammarim. mochre tzemer. vetaama dehanach shiuran bitfachayim, mippene shettofes bahen bishte yadav. vehayenu nammi taama dechol hanach yadot dilkamman sheshshiuran betifchayim. vechol otan sheshshiuran tefach, lefi sheddarko leechoz bahen beyado achat:
Makkor. kurnas chad shemmenakkerim bo harechayim. veal shem shemmenakkerim bo karuy makkor:
Yad hammaatzad shel ligyonot. garsinan. vehu cheli mikkele harotzchim, rosho agol, venosim oto anshe hachayil bammilchama. uvearvi korim lo 288:
Shel zehavim. hammakkim al zahav laasot tassin dakkin:
Veshel charashim. shel barzel:
Biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav. kuppot metzuppot kesef vezahav:
Hassallim vehabbikkurim nittanim lakkohanim. salle aniyyim nittanim lakkohanim, ukelatot shel ashirim machazirim lahen, mikkan amru batar anya azla aniyyuta:

Sheyare haddarvan milmalan. hammardea rosho echad yesh bo varzel keen martzea shebbo melammed happara litlameha vehu karuy darvan, uverosho hashsheni barzel rachav mechuddad lachtoch bo sharashim ushemo charchur. veshiur yad hammardea, lemala letzad haddarvan arbaa tefachim chashuvim chibbur, ulematta letzad hacharchur shiva tefachim hassemuchim lo havu chibbur, kedilkamman. uma shehu yoter mearbaa letzad haddarvan veshiva letzad hacharchur eno chibbur, veim naga sham tuma lo nitma lo hacharchur velo haddarvan:
Badid. keli varzel shebbo chofrim gummot seviv hailan kede sheyyachaziku memehen. veal shem haggummot shekkeruyin bedidin nikra hakkeli hachofer bahen badid:
Shel nikkush. pattish shemmakkishim bo al haavanim umeshabberim otan:
Ben pattish. happattish hakkatan karuy ben pattish, vehaggadol shemo pattish:
Shel bikkua. kurdom shemmevakkeim bo etzim:
Shel adir. shechofrim bo hakkarka lizria. kemo asher bammader yeaderun (yeshaya 7):
Shel sattatim. chotzve avanim vehamekatztzeim umashvin otan:
Lafok. listom nekavin shebbammerchatz shello yetze hachom:
Ulenaer bo et hakkedera. leechoz bo et hakkedera kede learot mimmenna letoch hakkeara o letoch hattamchuy:

Ben min hammuchan ben sheeno min hammuchan. beferek bamme madlikin mochiach, divhinnicho vekufsa chulle alma lo felige detame, deha achsheveh. uvizrako laashpa chulle alma lo felige detahor, deha vatteleh. ki felige hecha detala oto vemaggod, 167 belaaz, o hinnicho achore haddelet. rabbi eliezer savar ben hinnicho vemaggod shennire chemuchan legabbe zerako vaashpa, ben hinnicho achore haddelet shennire cheeno muchan legabbe hinnicho vekufsa, leolam tame kol zeman shello zerako vaashpa. verabbi yehoshua savar, leolam tahor kol zeman shello hinnicho vekufsa. verabbi akiva savar, ditlao vemaggod muchan hu vehave cheillu hinnicho vekufsa vetame, vehinnicho achore haddelet dahave shello min hammuchan, hare hu cheillu zerako vaashpa vetahor. vehatam massik dehadar beh rabbi akiva legabbe rabbi yehoshua. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Kippa. mitpachat shebberosh haishsha. veyesh lah tumat midras, sheppeamim shehi yoshevet aleha:
Unetano al hassefer. im yiched oto lesefer vecharach oto alav:
Tahor min hammidras. aval tame shear tumot:
Chemet. nod shel or:

Sheasao shatiach. or shatuach al haaretz leshev alav. vechemet veshatiach tarvayhu temein midras, vaafillu hachi chevan deshinna mizze laze vaafillu velo shinnuy maase have leh kichli shennishbar vetahor, aval mekabbel tuma mikkan ulehabba:
Turemel. keli or sheharoe manniach kelav letocho:

Hachi garsinan, keset sheasao mitpachat umitpachat sheasaah keset tahor. velo garsinan tame. vechach hi girsat rabbotay. vechen matzati vemishna davvekanit. vehachi muchach min hattosefta. vetaama divchullehu tahor, keditnan besamuch ze hakkelal lishmo tame leshem acher tahor, umefaresh battosefta, lishmo mikkeli fashut lichli fashut, kegon mishshatiach lemitpachat o mimmitpachat leshatiach, veshello lishmo mikkeli fashut lichli kibbul umikkeli kibbul lichli fashut, umikkeli kibbul lichli kibbul nammi, hakkol shinnuy shello lishmo vetahor. veim ken chemet sheasaah turemel deshinnahu mikkibbul lekibbul nammi tahor, vechar sheasao sadin vesadin sheasao char dahave shinnuy mikkibbul lefashut umippashut lekibbul nammi tahor. vei kashya, ammay lo arvinhu uteninhu chemet sheasaah shatiach veshatiach sheasao chemet bahade hanach, kevan dechullehu tahor hu. ha lo kashya, mishshum deka vae lemihdar ulemitne [chemet] zimna achariti chidtane chemet sheasaah turemel vahava tzarich lemitne chemet sheasaah shatiach o turemel, veeno rotze leshannot misseder haacherim. verov sefarim gorsim tame, veeni yodea leyashshev girsa zo mechuvvenet:
Tzeraran. besudaro:

Vehifshilan laachorav. af al pi sheshshemira meulla hi, chayyav, shehammolich maot shel pikkadon mimmakom lemakom en lahem shemira ella beyado, dichtiv (Devarim 14) vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha, af al pi shetztzerurim hem, yihyu beyadcha. veim babbayit hu, en lahem shemira ella bakkarka, uvakkotel, betefach hassamuch lattikra o betefach hassamuch laaretz. sheen derech haggannavim lechappes sham. veim shamar beinyan acher, poshea have vechayyav. ella im ken hitna mittechilla im hammafkid sheal menat ken hu mekabbel happikkadon, shello yitchayyev bechol hashshemirot hallalu:

Livno ulevitto hakketannim. aval laggedolim, nishbaim hem sheshshamru kederech hashshomrim, ufatur. velo amrinan beha shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav, shedderech haadam lehafekid ma shehufkad beyado, beyad ishto uvanav. vechol hammafkid, al daat sheyyittenem hannifkad beyad ishto uvanav hu mafkid:
Koy. nechleku vo chachme yisrael, yesh omrim shehu el habbar, veyesh omrim shehu tayish habba al hatztzeviyya, veyesh omrim beriyya bifne atzmah hi. velo hichriu vah chachamim im chayya hi im behema:
Namakku. nirkevu venamassu, kemo ittam yimmakku (Vayikra 26):
Nivzezu. nigzelu mimmennu, kemo bazaznu lanu (Devarim 2):
En chayyavin alehem chomesh. zar sheachalan eno meshallem et hachomesh. vehach matnitin yechidaa hi veenah halacha, ella halacha shechayyavim alehem chomesh:

Nitmeu vaazara nofetz veeno kore. garsinan, kelomar menaer umerik hassal min happerot kevan shennitmeu, vehassal nittan lakkohanim dichtiv (sham 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha, peamim sheen hakkohen lokeach ella hattene. veeno chayyav lehavi bikkurim acherim tachtehen, dechevan shebbau lehar habbayit lo mitchayyev tu beacharayutan:
Bakkerakkim. sheyyesh sham shulchani, ad kede sheyyare lashshulchani:
Bakkefarim. sheen sham shulchani:
Ad arve shabbatot. shebba lehotzi beerev shabbat lisudat shabbat, az yeda im yuchal lehotziah vikabbeluha mimmennu:
Veim haya makkirah. hachi kaamar, veim chasid hu verotze laasot lifnim mishshurat haddin, im makkir shehi hassela shennatan lo, yekabbelenna mimmennu afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh:
Veen lo alav ella taromet. hachi kaamar, veacher sheeno chasid velo ratza lekabbelah mimmennu, en laze alav ella taromet. deihu hu deafsed annafsheh shello hechziro bizmanno:

Venotnah lemaaser sheni. achasera kede onaa kae. venotnah lemaaser sheni beshavyah, veeno choshesh mishshum asimon sheen maaser sheni mitchallel ella bematbea sheyyesh bo tzura, deshem matbea yesh alav, demi sheeno lokchah beshavyah betorat matbea ella kemo niska shel kesef, eno ella nefesh raa:
Haonaa arbaa chesef. lemikkach sela shehu esrim vearba maot kesef. nimtza haonaa shetut kidamran. vechazar ushenaa mishshum devae lemitne hattaana shete chesef:

Vehattaana shete chesef. sheen shevuat haddayyanim al taana shehi pechuta mishshete chesef, shettaano shave shete maot kesef yesh li beyadcha, veze yode lo mehem shave feruta veyichpor hashshear, o yode lo hakkol veyichpor peruta:
Vehahodaa shave feruta. lihyot hodaa bemiktzat veyitchayyev shevua:
Hammotze shave feruta. aval batzir mehachi eno chayyav lehacheriz, dichtiv (Devarim 22) asher tovad mimmennu, perat laaveda sheen bah shave feruta:
Yolichennu acharav. im hoda shennishba lashsheker, deaz en lo kappara ad sheyyachzirennu leyado mammash velo leyad shelucho, dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) venatan laasher asham lo:
Shalosh al shalosh sheamru. demittamme leinyan tumat met vesheretz unevela:

Chutz min hammelal. ma shemmeshayyer haoreg berosh habbeged keshiur shete etzbaot, vehu anaf shel beged, karuy melal. vechevan sheshsheti levaddo hu veen bo erev, en mitztaref laarig. verabbotay mefarshim melal, ma shemmolel vechofel hattofer mekom hachatach, mippene hachutim sheddarkan latzet shello yetzu vetitkalkel hattefira:
Mechuvvanet. vehammelal bichlal:
Telayah al habbeged meruach achat. matlit shehi temea midras vetafar otah al habbeged beemtzao meruach achat, umishshalosh ruchot teluya veenah mechubberet babbeged:
Eno chibbur. veen habbeged tame midras:
Mishshete ruchot zo cheneged zo. kegon shehi tefura mizrach umaarav, vedarom vetzafon enah tefura. o ippecha. hare ze chibbur vehabbeged tame midras:
Kemin gam. shettefura mizrach vedarom, o maarav vetzafon:
Bamme devarim amurim. delo have chibbur ella vishte ruchot zo cheneged zo:
Betallit. sheenah derech malbush ella shekkorchah alav bilvad:
Aval bechaluk. shellovshim oto, leolam have chibbur, ella im ken tefura hassafa haelyona. vahalacha kachachamim:
Magrefa. sheggorfim bah tannur vechirayim o hattit. targum yaim, magrofyata:
Veshel sayyadim. sheggorfim bah et hassid:
Yater mikkan. yoter mimmiddot ellu shemmanu chachamim beyad hammagrefa, im rotze vekiyyum ze haorech hayyater:
Tame. im nitma hakkeli. vechen im naga tuma bechol ze haorech shel yad, nitma hakkeli immo, dahave chibbur lakkeli:
Yad meshammeshe haur. kegon yad shel shappud veaskala umarcheshet ushear kelim shettashmishan al yede haur:
Metzuyyarot tehorot. detzuratan mochachat alehen shehen meyuchadim lisfarim bilvad veenan meshammeshe adam, vechol sheeno meshammeshe adam, tahor:

Vesheenan metzuyyarot. meyuchadim nammi lishar tashmishin, hilkach temeot. uvet shammay dimtammein ben metzuyyarot ben sheenan metzuyyarot, mishshum demichsheve mitpechot sefarim meshammeshe adam, sheasuyin lemashmesh bahem tamid:
Ellu vaellu tehorot. dechevan sheyyichadan lisfarim tu lo havu meshammeshe adam. veen halacha kerabban gamliel:
Keset hassabbalin. hannosim massaot al ketefan o al roshan yesh lahen keset katan beroshan o vichtefan shello yazzik lahen hammasseoy, ufeamim yoshvim alav:
Meshammeret shel yayin en bah mishshum moshav. sheen yoshvim aleha mippene hashshemarim:

Sevacha shel zekena temea moshav. lefi may ditnan leel beferek shelosha terisin disvacha shel zekena temea teme met demashma aval lo mishshum moshav, tzarich lefaresh dishne mine sevachot yesh lizkena, achat sheenah reuya leshev aleha vehi temea teme met, usevacha acheret sheppeamim yoshevet aleha, uvah tenan hacha shehi mittammea mishshum moshav:
Chaluk shel yotzet hachutz. targum zona nafkat bara:
Asuy kisvacha. sheyyesh bah challonot challonot maase reshet uvesarah nire lachutz:
Min hacherem. min hareshet. uvesaro nire, lefichach tahor:
Mizzuto. yesh betachtit hareshet meat arig asuy keveged, vekaruy zuto shel reshet:
Uchefalo. shekkafal et hareshet utefarah veen besaro nire mittochah:
Tame. dachashiv beged. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:
Kurekuretah. shulayim vetachtit, kemo karkerot hakkelim:
Ad sheyyigmor et piha. sefatah haelyona. sheenah yoredet letuma ad sheyyigmor et kol melachtah:

Shavis shellah. milleshon hashshevisim vehassaharonim. tziyyur sheosim al hassevacha lenoy, omed al mitzchah umakkif meozen leozen. uvifne atzmo nammi chashiv, shehu asuy lahasiro mishsham velatet oto bisvacha acheret:
Hachutin shellah. shebbahen koshrim hassevacha al harosh:
Temeim mishshum chibbur. sheim nitmet hassevacha nitmeu hachutim immah deillu hachutim belo sevacha lo hayu mekabbelim tuma: im enah mekabbelet et rov hassear. shel harosh, tehora:
Vehashsheni meoto hammin eno mevi. hakkone et hassade eno mevi bikkurim meotah sade meoto hammin shehevi hammocher, dichtiv (sham) higgadti hayyom, paam achat maggid veeno maggid shete feamim:

Rabbi yehuda omer af meoto hammin mevi vekore. deha deamran paam achat maggid veeno maggid shete feamim, hanne mile beadam echad, aval bishne vene adam maggid vechozer umaggid. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Chittin bechittin lezera. sea bisa muttar lehalevot learis davka kesherotze lezaro. vetaamo, divatra dearis hu shennoten hazzera, im en lo zera lizroa hassade yesallekennu baal habbayit, ucheshellava haaris mibbaal habbayit vezorea uchesheyyokiru chittin yitten chittin, en zo halevaa, ella hare hu keyored letochah meachshav al menat sheyyittol baal habbayit hazzera techilla mechelek sheyyaggia laaris vehaaris yittol hashshear sechar tircho, veal menat ken yarad, sheyyittol pachot mishar arisin keshiur hazzera, veen kan ribbit:

Shehaya rabban gamliel. kelomar, lechach hutzrach lishnot mishna zo, lefi shehaya rabban gamliel machmir sheim huzelu notel keshaar hazzol, veashmeinan matnitin lo shehalacha chen ella sheratza lehachemir al atzmo:
Havaat makom. lehaalotan lirushalayim, dichtiv (Devarim 12) vahavetem shamma olotechem vezivchechem veet maasrotechem veet terumat yedchem, vedarshinan terumat yedchem ellu habbikkurim:

Uteunim vidduy. bammaaser ketiv (sham 26) veamarta lifne Adonai‏ elokecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit, uvabbikkurim ketiv (sham) veanita veamarta lifne Adonai‏ elohecha arammi oved avi. veaf al gav ditruma nammi baya vidduy kidamrinan vegam netattiv lallevi zo teruma uterumat maaser, mihu maaser uvikkurim maaser levaddo o vikkurim levaddan teunim vidduy, uteruma i let leh ella teruma levaddah eno taun vidduy:
Vaasurin laonen. bammaaser ketiv (sham) lo achalti veoni mimmennu. uvabbikkurim neemar (sham) vesamachta vechol hattov, melammed sheasurim laonen:
Verabbi shimon mattir. bikkurim laonen, ditruma kerinhu rachamana, uteruma sharya laonen:

Vechayyavim babbiur. levaaran min haolam lesof shalosh shanim, kedichtiv befarashat maaser (Devarim 26) biarti hakkodesh min habbayit, umashma nammi bikkurim middichtiv hakkodesh, hakkodesh haamur lemala, ellu bikkurim shenneemru bapparasha shellemala:
Verabbi shimon poter. bikkurim min habbiur, ella yinnatnu lakkohen, ditruma kerinhu rachamana, uteruma en tzarich levaarah min haolam:
Vaasurim. maaser sheni uvikkurim shennitarvu bechullin osrim taaruvtan bechol shehu, veen olim beechad umea:

Milleechol birushalayim. kelomar im nitarvu hammaaser sheni o habbikkurim beod shehen betoch yerushalayim, az osrim taaruvtan bechol shehu milleechol betorat chullin, mishshum dahave davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, hoil veyachol leechol hattaarovet kullah bimkomah. aval maaser sheni uvikkurim shennitarvu bechullin chutz lirushalayim enan osrin bechol shehu, hoil veyesh torach lehaalotan, lo mikre davar sheyyesh lo mattirin:

Vegiddulehem asurim. taarovet shel maaser uvikkurim shezzeraam vetzamchu vegadlu, otan haggiddulim nammi asurim leechol betorat chullin im zeraan vegadlu birushalayim. veosrin taaruvtan bechol shehu, kevan sheyyecholim leachel bimkomam:

Af lezarim velabbehema. maaser sheni uvikkurim sheosrin taaruvtan bechol shehu, vegiddulehen nammi daasurin, af lezarim velabbehema asurim. im bikkurim hem osrin hattaarovet lezarim, veim maaser hu oser [et] hattaarovet labbehema, delo tema davka leinyan leachel chutz lirushalayim hu deosrim bechol shehu, dilhay milleta chashive davar sheyyesh lo mattirin kevan sheyyachol leachlan bimkomam birushalayim vaafillu beelef lo vatle, aval leesor hattaarovet lezarim velabbehema deissur zarut uvehema en lo mattirin, salka datach amena delo yaasru taaruvtan bechol shehu, kamashma lan dechevan dechal al hattaarovet shem bikkurim umaaser leaser leachlan chutz lirushalayim, chal nammi leinyan ze leaser leechol lezarim im hen bikkurim, o labbehema im hu maaser:
Verabbi shimon mattir. aggiddulehen bilvad kae, desavar kevar betelim hem, aval battaarovet atzmah mode rabbi shimon. veen halacha kerabbi shimon bechullah matnitin:
Ma sheen ken batteruma. shekkol haddinim hallalu en nohagim batteruma:
Hattaggar notel mechamesh geranot. shehakkol yodim bo shello gadlu bisdotav umibbene adam harebe lokeach, uvechezkat ken lokchim mimmennu:
Megura. otzar sheogrin bo tevua. goren, hu sheddashim bo et hattevua. vederech hattaggar liknot mibbaale vattim bishat haggoren ulehachnis lammegura shello:
Pittam. gigit gedola:
Uvilvad shello yitkavven learvan. lehotzi kol liknot harov mimmakom meshubbach ulearev bo mimmakom acher, ushechenav sevurim shekkol happerot meoto makom:
Velo yifchot et hashshaar. limkor bezol. mippene shehu margil lavo etzlo umekappeach mezonot chaverav:
Zachur latov. shemmittoch kach otzre ferot mochrin bezol. vechen halacha:
Gerisin. polin gerusot barechayim, achat lishtayim:
Lo yavor. et happesolet. lefi shemmittoch shennirot yafot hu maale et demehen harebe middeme happesolet shennatal mehen:

Vachachamim mattirin. sheyyachol hallokeach lirot ulehavchin kamma deme happesolet shennivrar, meellu sheyyeshnan baacherim. vetov lo lehaalot bidmehen shel ellu shehen mevorarim, mippene hattorach. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shello yavor meal pi hammegura. lemala lehareot yafot, veet happesolet shebbetocho lo barar:
Lefi sheeno ella chegonev et haayin. bivrerato:
Mefarkesin. metakkenin umeyappin:
Lo et haadam. eved kenaani haomed limmacher:

Mevi veeno kore. mesappeka leh letanna kamma i kana karka i lo, hilkach mevi missafek veeno kore missafek. vedavka shete ilanot, aval shelosha ilanot kulle alma modu dekana karka umevi vekore, keditnan besof pirkin:
Rabbi meir omer mevi vekore. desavar hakkone shene ilanot nammi kana karka shettachtehem vechutza lahem kimlo ore vesallo. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Yavash hammayan. shehailan chay vegadel mimmennu:
Veniktzatz hailan. vehu sheyyavash veniktzatz kodem shehifrish bikkurim, aval im hifrish kodem, hoil veniru likria venidchu, yerakvu:
Rabbi yehuda omer mevi vekore. kevan shehakkarka kayyam lo chayesh lailan. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Min hechag vead chanukka mevi veeno kore. dichtiv befarashat bikkurim (Devarim 26) vesamachta bechol hattov, en keria ella bizman simcha, meatzeret vead hechag, sheadam melakket tevuato uferotav vesameach bahem. umehechag veelach, af al pi sheharebe perot nilkatim ad chanukka, mikkol makom simchat otah shana kevar nigmera bechag, hilkach mevi veeno kore. umechanukka veelach eno mevi kelal, dichtiv (Devarim 26) asher tavi meartzecha, kol zeman shemmetzuyin beartzecha, vead chanukka hen metzuyin:
Rabbi yehuda omer mevi vekore. delo daresh vesamachta bizman simcha. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
