Ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa vechulei. deamar kera (Vayikra 25) vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha, davar hannikne miyyad leyad, yatzu karkaot sheenan mittaltelin, yatzu avadim shehukshu lakkarkaot. yatzu shetarot, dichtiv vechi timkeru mimkar, davar sheggufo machur vegufo kanuy, yatzu shetarot sheenam omdim ella laraya shebbahen. hekdeshot, amar kera achiv, achiv velo hekdesh:

Lo tashlume chefel. dichtiv betoen taanat gannav (Shemot 22) al kol devar pesha, kelal. al shor al chamor vechulei, perat. al kol aveda, chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon. yatzu karkaot sheenan mittaltelin. yatzu avadim shehukshu lakkarkaot. yatzu shetarot sheaf al pi shehem mittaltelin en gufan mamon. hekdeshot, amar kera reehu, reehu velo hekdesh:

Velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. im ganav vetavach umachar shor o se shel hekdesh. detashlume arbaa vachamishsha amar rachamana velo tashlume shelosha lese vearbaa leshor, dechevan deamit mikkefel, batzir lehu chada, shehakkefel betoveach umocher bichlal tashlume arbaa vachamishsha hen:

Nose sachar eno meshallem. dichtiv (sham) ki yitten ish el reehu, kelal. chamor o shor o se, perat. vechol behema lishmor, chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash davar hammittaltel vechulei. hekdeshot, amar kera reehu, velo hekdesh:
Kadashim shechayyav beacharayutan. amar hare alay ola vehifrishah, vehumemah umecharah:
Yesh lahem onaa. dechevan deim meta o nigneva chayyav beacharayutah, dileh hi, veal tonu ish et achiv karina beh:
Vesheeno chayyav beacharayutan. kegon deamar hare zo:
Af hammocher sefer tora. lefi sheen ketz ledameha:

Margalit uvehema. mippene sheadam rotze lezavvegan. mi sheyyesh lo shor yafe lacharisha mechazzer al acher shekkemoto [letzamdo immo baol], sheim ba lehatzemid tachat haol shor challash im habbari mekalkel et habbari, vechen margalit naa lemalleot im chavertah bezahav min hayechidit. veen halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo cherabbi shimon:

Kach onaa vidvarim. shenneemar (Vayikra 25) velo tonu ish et amito veyareta meelohecha, ze neemar beonaat devarim sheen tovatan veraatan mesura lehakkir ella lelibbo shel medabber sheyyodea im laraa mitkavven im letova:
Hakkone shelosha ilanot. bistam, velo feresh im kana karka im lav:

Mevi vekore. devistam kana karka shettachtehen vechutza lahen. aval pachot mishshelosha ilanot bistam lo kana karka. verabbi meir paleg veamar deaf shene ilanot nammi kana karka, veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Af baale arisut vachachirut meviim vekorim. desavar rabbi yehuda aris vechocher yesh lo kinyan baaretz keillu yesh lo chelek bah. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kele zechuchit. hach matnitin teninan leel beferek 2‏ uveferek 15. veayde devae lemitne din hanach kelim shel zechuchit hadar tana la hacha:
Tavla. shulchan:

Iskutela. bilshon 107 korim likara 456. vehacha mayre vikara feshuta sheen lah bet kibbul, ella shemmittachteha mechubbar lah bet kibbul katan hameshammesh keshekkofin hakkeli al panav, keen sheyyesh lechosot shel kesef veshel zechuchit shellanu:
Yesh lahen levizbez. safa saviv, hallevizbez osehu cheli sheyyesh bo vet kibbul:

Shule keara veshule iskutela. keshennishbar mekom tashmishan nishar habbet kibbul katan vehofcho umishtammesh bo, vaafillu hachi tehorim, dela chashive hashshulayim keli, mippene mekom hashshever shemmazzik layyadayim kesheochazim bo:
Kirtesan o shafan. tikkenam vaasaan chalakim ad sheruyin lehishtammesh beoto vet kibbul, temeim, delo havu tu shever keli:
Beshufin. keli shetztzorfin vecharashe varzel mesirim bo hachaludda umachlikim bo hakkelim. targum hatztzerifim, shufina. 81 belaaz:
Bigde aniyyim. shehem asuyim mechatichot chatichot ketannot veen bechullan chaticha achat sheyyihye vah shalosh al shalosh:
Hare ellu temeim midras. hoil veyesh bechol habbeged bichlalo shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim o yoter, hare habbeged kullo tame midras:
Kevan shennikra rubbah eno chibbur. veim nitma hakkatze haechad lo nitma hakkatze haacher:
Heavim veharakkim. habbegadim heavim vehaggassim beyoter, kegon hallevadin vehammaggosin. veharakkim vedakkin beyoter, kegon hashshirain vehasserikin:
En bahen mishshum shalosh al shalosh. veen temein teme met velo shear tumot ad sheyyihye vahen shelosha tefachim o yoter, mishshum deshalosh al shalosh mehen lo chazi lemidi:

Kol haayarot shebbammaamad. esrim vearbaa maamadot hayu veyisrael, keneged arbaa veesrim mishmerot kehunna, veanshe hammaamad yisreelim hayu, sheluchim mikkol yisrael laamod al hakkarban im hakkohanim vehalleviyyim shebbeoto mishmar, kol echad bashshabbat hakkavua lo, vehen nikraim anshe maamad:
Mitkannesot leiro. shel rosh hammaamad, velo hayu meviin bikkurehem kol echad bifne atzmo, mishshum divrav am haderat melech:
Velo hayu nichnasim labbattim. mippene ohel hattuma:
Velammashkim. babboker keshehem mashkimim:
Hamemunne. rosh hammaamad:

Kumu venaale tziyyon. uvadderech hayu omrim samachti beomrim li bet Adonai‏ nelech. keshehiggiu lirushalayim hayu omrim omdot hayu raglenu bisharayich yerushalayim. behar habbayit hayu omrim haleluyah halelu el bekadsho. baazara hayu omrim kol hanneshama tehallel yah:
Hechalil. min keli zemer vekolo nishma lemerachok:
Haya notel hassal al ketefo. lefi shehaya tzarich litteno miyyado leyad kohen, dichtiv (Devarim 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha:

Ispelanit. tachboshet sheosim mechelev veshaava vechema veshemen vechayyotze vaze, umemarchim otah al habbeged o al haor venotnim al hammakka, vehi nimeset, veen habbeged vehaor reuyin od lishiva velo letashmish acher:
Melugema. tachboshet asuya mikkemach uteenim vechayyotze vahen, sheadam loes venoten al gav hammakka. uferush melugema, melo lugema:
Beveged tehora. lefi shehabbeged nimas umitbattel vetu lo chazi letashmish:
Uveor tamea. sheen hammelugema mitdabbeket al haor kemo al habbeged, veen haor mitbattel bechach:
Mippene shehi ninaret. leachar shennityabbesha meal habbeged hi nineret venishmetet meeleha meal habbeged veholech kol hallichluch. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Niknim bimchubbar lakkarka. dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) bikkure kol asher beartzam, beshaa shehem mechubbarim beartzam bikkurim hem, vehachi tenan lekamman yored adam letoch sadehu vechulei‏ koshro vegemi veomer hare ellu vikkurim:
Veose adam kol sadehu bikkurim. dichtiv bikkure kol, mereshit kol:
Uteunim karban. neemar babbikkurim simcha, vesamachta bechol hattov, veneemar lehallan (Devarim 27) vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham vesamachta, ma lehallan shelamim af kan shelamim:
Veshir. neemar kan bechol hattov, veneemar lehallan (Yechezkel 33) keshir agavim yefe kol umetiv naggen:
Utenufa. ketiv hacha velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha, uchetiv hatam (Vayikra 7) yadav teviena et ishshe Adonai, ma lehallan tenufa af kan tenufa:
Velina. sheyyalin birushalayim kol hallayla shel achar hayyom shehevi habbikkurim, dichtiv (Devarim 16) ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha, ha kol ponot lo yihyu ella babboker:
Ezehu neshech. shehu noshech. deshakal minneh may dela yahev leh:

Hammarbe beferot. hammarbe sachar leatzmo bapperot. uven behalevaat kesef uven behalevaat perot have ribbit. shehare mitrabbe mamono. ella divsefa, ribbit derabbanan kamfaresh, shehu derech mikkach umimkar:
Dinar zahav. esrim vachamishsha dinre chesef:

Vechen hashshaar. kach hayu nimkarin bair. vehuttar lo latet maot achshav al menat litten lo ze chittin kol yemot hashshana baddamim hallalu keshiur meotav veaf al pi sheachshav en lo chittin, ditnan befirkin yatza hashshaar poskin, af al pi sheen laze yesh laze, veyachol hammocher hazze liknotam atta bammaot hallalu:

Amdu chittin bishloshim dinarin amar lo ten li chittay. veze muttar im natan lo chittin. aval im pasak latet lo bahen yayin, asur, shemma yokir hayyayin, hoil veen lo yayin. veaf al pi shepposek immo keshaar hayyayin shel achshav uchevar yatza hashshaar, hoil veeno noten lo damim shennuchal lomar yachol hu liknot yayin baddamim shekkibbel ella ba laasot alav deme hachittin chov velifsok al hachov yayin, asur im yayin en lo. dei hava leh yayin, have kanuy lo meachshav leze shebba lifsok al hachov yayin, vechi aykar birshuteh aykar:

Have maot vetol et shellecha asur. have motar maot shealecha vetol sade shellecha, asur laasot ken. uchegon sheamar lo mocher lallokeach lechi maytet motar hammaot kene meachshav, lefichach asur laasot ken, sheim yochal mocher happerot betoch kach, lichsheyyavi ze hammaot nimtza sade zo kenuya lo miyyom hammecher, veze ochel happerot bischar hametanat meotav. veim yochal lokeach perot meachshav, shemma lo yavi motar hammaot veyachzir lo ze ma shekkibbel venimtza shello hayta sade kenuya lo, deha lechi maytet kene meachshav amar leh, veha lo ayte, umaot harishonot kemilva vealma hayu etzel mocher, veze ochel perot bischaro:

Hare hi shello. uchegon deamar leh kene meachshav im lo avi lecha mikkan ad shalosh shanim, delav asmachta hi ella kinyan gamur, sheal menat mecher gamur hechzik bah meachshav baddamim hallalu veozilu ozil gabbeh, veze kibbel alav sheim yachazir lo meotav ad shalosh shanim yekabbelem. vehapperot yihyu munnachim beyad shalish, im yachazir hallove meotav lammalve ad shalosh shanim yitten happerot lallove, veim lav yitten happerot lammalve, shehayta hassade kenuya lo mishsheat halevaa, veotah halevaa deme hassade hayta:
Yotzi lo shetut leyayin. im hifkid etzlo yayin veervo im yeno, hakkankannim bolim shetut:
Rabbi yehuda omer chomesh. shehakkarka shehayu osim mimmennu hakkankannim beatreh derabbi yehuda bala chomesh. vehakkol lefi hammakom:

Af hammocher vechulei. keshem sheamru shemarim bammafkid, kach amru bammocher. shehammocher shemen lachavero venoten lo mittoch chaviyyotav shemen mezukkak tamid shehu mistappek mimmennu, hare hallokeach mekabbel alav lifchot lo log umechetza mechamat shemarim lechol mea log. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hare shehevi mimmin echad vekara. lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda, deamar leel maggid vechozer umaggid, ka mashma lan demode rabbi yehuda deadam echad eno maggid vechozer umaggid:

Shelosha al shelosha shennechelak. beged sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim shennitma vemidras hazzav, veachar kach nechlak veen beechad mehen kede shiur tumat midras, beha felige tanna kamma verabbi yose, detanna kamma savar tame magga midras, verabbi yose savar tahor legamre. aval beged shel shalosh al shalosh shepperash mibbeged gadol shehaya midras, hakkol modim shebbishat perishatan meavihen mekabbelot tuma meavihen. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Taun kissuy kedam chayya. lechumra, veen mevarchin al kissuyo, kevan desafek hu:
Veen shochatin oto beyom tov. lefi sheasur lechassot et damo, veaf al gav deefer kira muchan hu, muchan levadday veeno muchan lesafek:

Betumat nevela kachayya. dechelev behema tehora tahor hu, kidyalfinan min vechelev nevela vechelev terefa yease lechol melacha (Vayikra 7), umishshum disfek behema hu vechelbo tahor, sefek chayya vechelbo tame, lefichach tumato safek:
Veen podin bo peter chamor. shemma chayya hu, verachamana amar (Shemot 34) ufeter chamor tifde vese, vehay safek se safek tzevi:
En onaa letaggar. mippene shehu baki umissetama achole achil gabbeh, vehay dezabbena hachi, mishshum deitramme leh zevina achariti, vehasheta hu dekavae lemihadar beh. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mi shehuttal alav yado al haelyona. mi shennitanna:
Ten li meotay. im nitanna lokeach. umatnitin rabbi yehuda hannasi hi. velet hilchata kevateh, ella im haonaa shetut, kana umachazir onaa. yoter mishshetut, batel mikkach:
Chelbo asur kechelev behema. kechelev shor vechesev vaez:
Veen chayyavin alav karet. lehavi chattat al shiggato. vehu haddin sheen lokin alav:
Veeno nilkach bechesef maaser leachlo birushalayim. deshemma behema hu, veen lokchin behema livsar taava mikkesef maaser, [ella] shelamim:
Vechayyav bizroa uvilchayayim uvekeva. dimrabbinan lehu mikkera dichtiv (Devarim 18) im se, lerabbot et hakkoy:
Shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. deamar leh baal habbehema lakkohen, ayte reaya demin behema hu, ushekol. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:

Shalosh kesatot shel tzemer. tefurot zo im zo keshalal shel kovsin. i nammi, arugot yachad, keen haorgim mappot sheddarkan lehaniach hefresh ben mappa lemappa umechubbarot bechute hashsheti veen bo erev. vechol hane ditnan hacha, kol echad beminyano o pachot have chibbur, veim naga tuma veechad mehen nitmeu chullan, veim hayu temein vehuza meefer happara veechad mehen nitharu chullan. veyoter al minyan ze lo have chibbur lo lattuma velo lahazzaa:
Suverikin. it detane safrikin. it dimfarshe michnasayim, veit dimfarshe kemin batte yadayim mitztzemer shemmalbishim bahem et hayyadayim umechassim bahem hazzeroot ad haatzilim:
Gelufkarin. kesut ava shel tzemer shellovshim beet hakkerirut:
Chibbur lattuma veeno chibbur lahazzaa. lechumra. im naga tuma beechad mehen have chibbur venitmeu chullan, veim huza echad mehen lo have chibbur, velo tahar ella oto shehuza alav bilvad:
Rabbi yose omer af lo lattuma. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Vaasao vilon. masach lifne happetach. kegon sheasa vo maase sheal yede chen tahor min hammidras, levet shammay mishsheyyitchabber, ulevet hillel mishsheyyikkasher, ulerabbi akiva mishsheyyikkavea, keditnan leel beferek hakkarim vehakkesatot [mishna 6]:
Tahor min hammidras. devatal mittorat mishkav umoshav. aval letumat magga chazi, mippene shehashshammash mitchammem bo umitattef beshulav:
Vechi veeze midras naga ze. kelomar, hoil vetahor mittumat midras kesheasaahu vilon, hare tahor legamre velo nishar bo tuma chelal, midi dahava ashshivre chelim shehem tehorim mittumatan legamre:
Ella im ken naga bo hazzav. im naga hazzav bevilon ze, metammeo tumat magga hazzav. aval mikkoach tumat midras shehayta vo techilla, en kan tuma chelal. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Chut moznayim. chut sheochazim bo hammoznayim beshaa sheshshoklim bahen:

Rabbi yose omer tefach tahor. im yad hakkurdom gadol kol kach sheyyotze tefach leachar yado, la chashiv yad, lefi shemmazzik lo limlachto, vechol hayyad kullo tahor. kach peresh mori. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Teenim vaanavim. keshehem lachim:
Veharchokim. miyyerushalayim, veen bikkurehem yecholim lehitkayyem kol kach:
Meviin gerogarot vetzimmukim. teenim vaanavim yeveshim:
Hashshor holech lifnehem. umakrivin oto shelamim:

Vaatara shel zayit berosho. it deamre lefi shehu karov leeretz yoter mikkol shear ilanot shebbeshivat hamminim, dichtiv (Devarim 8) eretz zet shemen. veit deamre lefi sheen bechol shear ilanot shel shivat hamminim ilan yafe vealehu raanan kemo hazzayit:

Veitteru et bikkurehem. vechetzad meatterim, mi shehayu vikkurav gerogarot meatteran bitenim lachim, mi shehayu vikkurav tzimmukim meatteran baanavim lachim, veim meviim anavim haya mare hattovim vehayyafim shebbechullam millemala:
Happachot. segane chehunna:
Vehaggizbarim. hamemunnim al hahekdesh:
Ulefi chevod hannichnasim. lefi rov hannichnasim hayu yotzim, im merubbim merubbim veim muatim muatim:

Vechol baale ummaniyyot shebbirushalayim omdim mippenehem. af al gav deen baale ummaniyyot chayyavin laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskim bimlachtam, kede shello yitbattelu mimmelachtam, mikkol makom hayu chayyavim laamod mippene mevie vikkurim, dachaviva mitzva bishatah. vmittaam ze omdim mippene nose hammitta shehammet bah, umippene nose hattinok livrit mila:
Rabbi yehuda omer ad arammi oved avi. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Veochazo vesiftotav vechohen manniach yado tachtav. mikkan mashma shehassal haya al yado shel kohen, ella shehabbealim ochazim hassal besiftotav lemala bishat hattenufa, veshello chedivre haomer kohen manniach yado tachat yad habbealim umenif:
Betzad hammizbeach. bekeren deromit maaravit:

Vehishtachava veyatza. mikkan mashma shello haya menif ki im tenufa achat bishat hakkeria bilvad. vetanna desifri matzrich shete tenufot, achat bishat hakkeria, dichtiv (Devarim 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha vehinnicho, vegamrinan yad yad miyyadav teviena et ishshe Adonai‏ (Vayikra 7), ma lehallan tenufa af kan tenufa, vehashshenit leachar shehishlim hakkeria, dilachar hakkeria ketiv vehinnachto, leshon lech neche et haam (Shemot 32), dehaynu tenufa shemmolich umevi, maale umorid:

Habbeged shearag bo shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim. metzumtzamot, shehu shiur littamme midras. veachar shennitmeu vemidras keshehen metzumtzamot hishlim alav arigat kol habbeged, vehasheta chol habbeged tame midras dahave chibbur lishlosha al shelosha shennitmeu kodem arigat kol habbeged:
Natal chut echad mittechillato. mishshelosha al shelosha rishonim shennitmeu midras:
Tahor. kol habbeged min hammidras:
Aval tame magga midras. lefi shennaga bishlosha al shelosha rishonim kodem shennitmaet shiuro:

Natal chut echad mittechillato veachar kach hishlim alav et kol habbeged tame magga midras. veaf al gav denitmaet shiuro kodem shehishlim alav et kol habbeged, af al pi chen tame chol habbeged magga midras. dehay tanna sevira leh beged shelosha al shelosha shennechlak achar shennitma vemidras, tame magga midras, kedilkamman befirkin. hilkach keshennitmaet shiuro dishlosha al shelosha, nishar tame magga midras, ucheshehishlim alav et kol habbeged have habbeged mechubbar letame magga midras, vechol hamechubbar lattame, tame chemoto:
Shamin para. gedola, vachamor gadol, sheruyin limlacha, umelachtan kullah lammekabbel:
Lemechetza. lachlok shevach sheyyashbichu, baddamim uvavveladot:
Lachalok et havveladot miyyad. keshettavo sheat chalukkatan, bivhema dakka sheloshim yom uvegassa chamishshim yom:
Shamin egel im immo. veen tzarich litten amal umazon laegel ella laem. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Umafrin al sadehu. leshon pare verave. veit degarse umafriz, bezayin. leshon perazot teshev yerushalayim (Zecharya 2). kelomar marchiv al sadehu. vehu sheyyomar lo [chocher lammachkir], atta ragil likkach bachachirut sadcha asara korin leshana, haleveni matayim zuz sheuchal lehotzi lezabbel sade zo ulezarah ulecharshah, vaani maale lecha bachachirutah shenem asar korim leshana veachzir lecha meotecha, ze muttar, dahave cheillu maadif lo shene chorim hallalu mippene shechocher mimmennu sade tova umeshubbachat shechachirutah yafa mechachirut sade raa:
Im tzerurin. vachatumin, o keshurim kesher meshunne:
Lo yishtammesh bahen. aval im enam chatumim o keshurim kesher meshunne, af al pi shetztzerurin, hare hen kemuttarin ucheillu enam keshurim kelal, umuttar lehishtammesh bahen:

Chayyav beacharayutan. vaafillu lo nishtammesh bahen have alehem shomer sachar, mippene sheyyachol lehishtammesh bahem, vechayyav bigneva vaaveda. veim nishtammesh, havu milva gabbeh vechayyav af boonasim:
Rabbi yehuda omer kashshulchani. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shalosh al shalosh shennetanah bechaddur. beged shel shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot shennetanah betoch kaddur, 126 belaaz:
O sheasaah kaddur. shellakach habbeged ucheracho agol kemin kaddur, kemo sheosim letinokot, utefaro:
Tehora. shennitbattela cheshennetanah bakkaddur, vechol shekken kesheasaah kaddur bifne atzmah shennitbattela vattefira:

Aval shelosha al shelosha. lo mibbattela vintinatah letoch hakkaddur, lefi shehi shemura sham. aval im asaah kaddur bifne atzmah, tehora, lefi shehattefira memaatah, utehora mimmidras, aval temea vechol shear tumot kedin kol shelosha al shelosha shennitmaet:

Yad hakkurdom millefanav. derech haochez beyad hakkurdom kesherotze lachtoch bo eno ochez mammash berosh hakkatta shemma yachlik veyippol miyyado ella manniach meat leachar yado, vehashshiur sheyyesh ben yad haadam labbarzel kore millefanav, vehayyotze leachar yado kore meacharav beidach bava. veha dela mefaresh bevava zo din shellefanav veshel acharav, mishshum dehacha chashiv hanach deshiuran tefach, uveidach bava chashiv hanehu deshiuran shalosh etzbaot:
Pargol. mechoga. 532 belaaz. vehecharashim tzerichim laasot bo tzurot agullot:
Makkevet. pattish shel barzel sherosho echad chad uvo nokvim ufoslim et haavanim, veal shem kach nikra makkevet. uleshon mikra hu, umakkavot vehaggarzen kol keli varzel (Melachim 1 6):
Mefatteche avanim. leshon pittuche chotam:
Hammafkid perot etzel chavero. veervan hannifkad im perotav vehaya mistappek mehen veeno yodea shiur ma sheachal. keshebba lehacheziran yotzi lo chesronot, yifchot kamma hem regilim lachsor:
Tisha chatzae kabbin lechor. hakkor sheloshim sein, vehassea shishsha kabbin:
Hakkol lefi hammidda. ken lechol kor vachor:
Hakkol lefi hazzeman. shehinnicham beyado. lechol shana veshana yenakke lo kach:
Ma ichpat lehu laachbarim. kach ochlim mimmidda muetet kemo mimmidda merubba. hilkach tisha chatzae kabbin leshana ven lechor ben laasara chorin:
Im hayta midda merubba. shehifkid etzlo harebe, measara chorin ulemala, lo yotzi lo chesronot:

Mippene shehen motirot. shebbimot haggoren keshemmafkidim hachittim, yeveshim, uvimot haggeshamim keshemmachziran, nofchot. uvaachilat achbarim enan nechsarin kol kach lechol kor vachor, dechulle hay lo achle achbarim measara chorin, hilkach nefichato mashlemet lema sheachbarim ochlim. veen halacha lo cherabbi yehuda velo cherabbi yochanan ben nuri. vechol hashshiurim hallalu beeretz yisrael uvime hattannaim. aval bishar aratzot uvazzemannim hallalu, hakkol kefi ma shergilim hazzeraim lechasser beotah medina uveoto zeman:
Chut hammishkolet. habbannaim machazikim beyadam chut uverosho oferet umoridim oto cheneged hakkotel lirot shello yehe akum:
Charashin. naggarin shel etz:
Veshel bannaim. habbonim hachomot haggevohot vehaggedolot. vechut hammishkolet deresha delo have ella shenem asar, mayre vimyuchad levinyanim ketannim:
Yater mikken. yoter mimmiddot ellu shemmanu chachamim bechol echad veechad, af al pi shehu rotze vekiyyuman, tahor oto haodef al hammidda velo have chibbur lichli:
Veshel sayyadim. hattachim pene hakkotel besid vegam hem tzerichim lemishkolet, vechen hatztzayyarim shemmetzayyerim tzura vakketalim:
Kol shehen. ben rav ben meat have chibbur:

Lo chatav lo et hakkoy. af al pi shekkatav lo shenehem, lo haya dato ella al vadday behema o vadday chayya. verambam peresh sheim katav lo behemto levad lo kana et hakkoy, deamrinan leh ayte reaya divhema hu, veim katav lo chayyato levad amrinan leh ayte reaya dechayya hu. nire middevarav sheim katav lo shenehen, kana mimma nafshach:

Im amar hareni nazir shezze chayya o vehema. ben sheamar hareni nazir shezze chayya ben sheamar hareni nazir shezze behema, hare ze nazir, disfek issura lechumra. vaafillu amar hareni nazir shezze chayya uvehema o shezze eno lo chayya velo vehema, hare ze nazir missafek:

Shave lailan. deazlinan batar chanata, umonin lo shalosh laarla mishsheat chanata. vechen larvai vechen lashsheviit, deim nechnat bashshishshit venigmar bashsheviit muttar, umikkol makom patur mimmaaser, dilinyan maaser azlinan batar lekita kedin yarak, vechevan denilkat bashsheviit patur mimmaaser:
Haochel teruma. gedola. zar sheachal teruma gedola veshogeg:
Uterumat maaser. maaser min hammaaser:
Uterumat maaser shel demay. hallokeach tevua meam haaretz, tzarich lehaferish terumat maaser, aval lo teruma gedola, shehayu hakkol zehirim bah:
Vehachalla vehabbikkurim. kol hane chamishsha chad ninhu, dechullehu ikkeru teruma, umishshem echad hem bain:
Neta revai. gamar kodesh kodesh mimmaaser sheni demosif chomesh. vetarvayhu nammi chad chashev lehu, demechad kera nafke kevan demimmaaser yalef:
Umaasar sheni shello. davka. mosif chomesh, deish mimmaasro ketiv:
Hekdesho. velo shel acherim, hammakdish ketiv:
Hannehene. beshogeg, chayyav karban meila vechomesh:
Lo yichadu lah habbealim makom. bevet shomer, lomar lo zavit zo hasheileni:
Letzarko. lehishtammesh bah:
Letzarkah. shehayta bemakom shekkerova lehishtabber:

Im mishshehinnichah. shekkilla tashmisho hinnichah bemakom mishtammer. ben shettiltelah mittechilla letzarko, ben shettiltelah letzarkah, patur. deamrinan mishshehechzirah hare hi birshut habbealim kevattechilla, veeno aleha ella keshomer chinnam ufatur al anseha, veaf al pi shello hodia labbealim lomar netaltiha vehechzartiha. veresha dematnitin rabbi yishmael hi, deamar begonev tale min haeder vehechziro limkomo shehu fatur delo bainan daat baalim. vehay dekatane lo yichadu lah habbealim makom, lo mibbaya kaamar, lo mibbaya yichadu lah habbealim makom vehechzirah limkomah leachar shennishtammesh bah letzarko shehu fatur, veaf al pi shello hodia labbealim, shehare hechzirah lammakom hammeyuchad lah, ella afillu lo yichadu lah habbealim makom, delav lemakom meyuchad lah hechzirah, patur, hoil vehechzirah lemakom mishtammer, delo bainan daat bealim:

Uven mishshehinnichah letzarko chayyav. sefa zo atan lerabbi akiva deamar begonev tale min haeder vehechziro limkomo veneenas, leolam hu chayyav, ad sheyyodia labbealim shegganav vehechzir. vehacha nammi leachar shennishtammesh bah letzarko venaasa gazlan aleha, af al pi shehinnichah bemakom hammishtammer, chayyav. vehay dekatane bassefa yichadu lah habbealim makom, lo mibbaya kaamar, lo mibbaya lo yichadu shehu chayyav mishshehinnichah leachar shennishtammesh letzarko, deha lo hinnichah bemakom hammeyuchad lah, ella afillu yichadu lah makom, shechazar vehinnichah bimkomah, chayyav, devainan daat bealim. veresha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva. vehachi mokminan lah baggemara:

Natan lo maot velo mashach hemennu perot yachol lachazor bo. ze vaze. vetakkanat chachamim hi. didvar tora maot konot, kidashkechan gabbe hekdesh dichtiv venatan hakkesef vekam lo, uma taam amru meshicha kona velo maot, gezera shemma yanniach lokeach mikkecho bevet mocher zeman merubbe, vetippol deleka bishchunat hammocher velo yachush litroach ulehatztzil, lefichach heemidum birshuto lachazor bo im yirtze, dechevan deim yityakkeru birshuto yityakker veyachzor bo min hammecher vihe hassachar shello, kedideh chashev lehu vetarach umatztzil:

Aval amru mi sheppara vechulei. af al pi sheyyachol lachazor bo, orrin oto bevet din veomrim alav mi sheppara middor hammabbul umiddor happallaga umeanshe sedom vaamora umin hammitzriyyim sheshshatfu bayyam, hu atid lippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo. veachar kach machazir lo et meotav:

Rabbi shimon omer kol shehakkesef beyado yado al haelyona. rabbi shimon ammilleteh detanna kamma kae deamar natan lo maot velo mashach mimmennu perot yachol lachazor bo ben mocher ben lokeach, vaata rabbi shimon lememar dezimnin demi shehakkesef beyado dehaynu hammocher shekkibbel et hakkesef yado al haelyona, uveyado lekayyem et hammecher im yirtze veen hallokeach yachol lachazor bo, kegon shehayta aliyyato shel lokeach sechura etzel hammocher, dehashta im hammocher rotze sheyyihye hammecher kayyam en hallokeach yachol lachazor bo af al pi shello mashach, detama may amur rabbanan meshicha kona velo maot, gezera shemma yomar lo mocher lallokeach nisrefu chittecha baaliyya, hacha daaliyya delokeach hi, i nafla deleka ihu tarach vemayte lah. veen halacha kerabbi shimon. ella af al pi shealiyyato shel lokeach sechura etzel hammocher, kol zeman shello mashach yachol lachazor bo ben lokeach ben mocher:

Hazzahav kone et hakkesef. kol davar shehu chashuv lihyot matbea vecharif linnaten behotzaa, din maot yesh lo, veeno kone et shekkenegdo sheeno chashuv matbea veeno charif behotzaa chemoto. umi sheen tivo chashuv vecharif, din perot yesh lo, umeshichato hu kiyyum davar. lefichach mikki mashach haechad dinre zahav, kana hashsheni dinre chesef bechol makom shehem, veen echad mehem yachol lachazor bo. dedinre zahav havu perot legabbe dinre chesef:

Vehakkesef eno kone et hazzahav. dedinre kesef shehem charifim behotzaa, din maot yesh lahem legabbe dinre zahav. veim mashach haechad dinar kesef, lo kana haacher dinar zahav ad sheyyimshoch, demaot enan konot. vehayenu taama nammi shennechoshet kone et hakkesef, difrutot shel nechoshet sheen tivan chashuv kol kach, havu pere legabbe dinre chesef, vehakkesef eno kone et hannechoshet:
Maot haraot. shennifselu:
Asimon. shennaasa bemiddat hammatbea hayyotze ella sheadayin lo tibbeu alav tzura:
Kol hammittaltelin konin ze et ze. im hechlif ellu beellu, kevan shemmashach haechad kana chavero. vehay kol, laatoye afillu kis male maot bechis male maot:
Marbin al hassachar. bischar hametanat meot hassechirut:

Veen marbin al hammecher. bischar hametanat hammikkach. vetama, mishshum dischirut enah mishtallemet ella levassof, hilkach ki shakel minneh sela bechodesh dahavu lehu shetem esre selaim en ze sechar hametanat maot, shehare lo nitchayyev leshallem lo sechirut ad sof hachodesh, vehay deamar leh im achshav titten li hare hi shellecha beeser selaim, i hava makdim leh hava machel leh middeme hassechirut umogar leh befachot mishshavyah. aval gabbe mecher, mishshemmashach hammikkach dino litten hammaot, vechi amar leh im meachshav titten hare hi lecha beelef zuz, hen hen dameha, vechi mattefe alayhu laggoren, sechar hametanat maot hu:

Machar lo et hassade vechulei. vehu haddin mittaltelin vechol sechora, im machar lo yoter mishshavyah bischar hametanat maot, asur, vehave avak ribbit middivrehem. vechol avak ribbit im natan enah yotza bedayyanim. deillu ribbit ketzutza deorayta yotza bedayyanim:

En mekabbelin tzon barzel. kol acharayut hannechasim al hammekabbel, vesham otam alav bemaot, vechol zeman sheen noten lo meotav cholkim hassachar. veaf al gav demishna yetera hi, deha tana leh leel en moshivim chenvani lemachatzit sachar mishshum dimkabbel aleh palga behefsed, vechol shekken hacha dekibbel kol haacharayut alav. nakat leh mishshum sefa, aval mekabbelim tzon barzel min hannachrim:

Middaat hannachri. kegon yisrael shellava maot minnachri beribbit uvikkesh lehacheziram lo, metzao yisrael acher veamar tenem li vaani eele lecha kederech sheatta maale lo. im heemido etzel nachri, af al pi sheyyisrael notnam lo bemitzvat hannachri, muttar. veim lo heemido etzel nachri, asur. dehu nihu deka mozif leh beribbit:
Haya hu techilla lakkotzrim. veyesh lo gadish vaadayin lo yatza hashshaar:

Posek immo. beeze shaar sheyyirtze, dechevan deyesh lo en kan ribbit, demeachshav oto gadish kanuy lo. veaf al gav delo mashach, kevan dechi en lo nammi lo hava ella avak ribbit derabbanan, ki yesh lo lo gazur:
Al heavit. keli gadol shetztzovrim bo et haanavim lifne dericha vehem mitchammemim lehotzi yenam yafe. veshel zetim karuy maatan:
Al habbetzim shel yotzer. im hichnis afar vaasao betzim laasot mehen kederot, posek immo al hakkederot beeze shaar sheyyirtze, veaf al pi shello yatza hashshaar:
Veal hassid. posek immo beeze shaar sheyyirtze mishsheyyeshakkeennu bechivshan haetzim vehaavanim lisrof velaasot mehen sid:

Vachachamim mattirin. ikka ben chachamim letanna kamma, detanna kamma kol yemot hashshana kaamar. ufaleg aleh rabbi yose veamar lo shena yemot hachamma velo shena yemot haggeshamim, ad sheyyihye lo lemocher zevel baashpot. vachachamim mattirin davka bimot hachamma, sheaf al pi sheen lo, yesh laacherim, shehakkol yesh lahen zevel, shekkevar nirkav venishshof bimot haggeshamim. aval bimot haggeshamim lo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Keshaar haggavoah. im yifchot hashshaar mimma shehu achshav, titten li keshaar hazzol. gavoah, hayenu bezol, shennotnin perot gevohim verabbim bedamim muatim:

Ten li chaze o ten li meotay. shehare lo mashach, veyachol lachazor bo, vaafillu mi sheppara lekka, hoil velo natan meotav al menat lekabbel achshav ella leachar zeman, uvetoch kach nishtanna hashshaar, setam dateh deeynash attara zila pasik. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haonaa arbaa chesef. arbaa maot kesef shehem shesh maot bedinar, vehassela arba dinarin:
Meesrim vearba kesef lassela. im haya hammikkach bidme hassela shehu esrim vearba maot, dehashta haveya onaa shetut lammikkach, chayyav lehashiv lo kol onaato arbaa chesef:
Ad matay muttar lehachazir. mi shennitanna. veha denakat leshon muttar, leashmoinan delekka afillu mi sheppara lehachazir hammikkach o sheyyitten lo onaato:
